items.title_en: Love in Hearts, Light in Eyes — The "Food With Love" Seattle Lunch Initiative Concludes Successfully
items.title_zh: 心中有爱 眼里有光——“Food With Love”西雅图爱心午餐行动圆满结束
items.body_en:
The “Food With Love” Greater Seattle Lunch Initiative, co-hosted by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA), Washington State Chinese Research Foundation (WSCRF) and Tsinghua GIX North America Center, has reached its successful milestone after months of inspiring chain of goodwill. On July 24, organizers, volunteers, municipal representatives and representatives of recipient organizations gathered for a heartfelt virtual celebration to mark the successful conclusion of this charitable campaign.

Throughout the initiative, a total of 21,661 meals were delivered, valued at $411,000, benefiting 35 recipient organizations. This project embodied the spirit of “Love in Hearts, Light in Eyes”, reminding everyone that beauty can still be found amid the prolonged pandemic.

The sudden outbreak of COVID-19 threatened our communities. Yet no matter how fast the virus spread, it could not outpace the outpouring of compassion. The lunch drive began with a handful of restaurants donating meals voluntarily and grew to involve more than a dozen of Seattle’s most influential Chinese restaurants. What started as a CCCWA-led effort expanded into a joint initiative with WSCRF and Tsinghua GIX North America Center. Contributions extended beyond restaurant donations to support from community groups including the New Immigrant Center and donors from all walks of life. Recipients also expanded from medical staff to frontline pandemic responders including healthcare workers, police officers and public health personnel.

This wave of kindness spread rapidly like rays of light, earning widespread recognition and positive feedback across the community. It stands as one of the most influential signature charitable initiatives during Seattle’s pandemic response.

The virtual celebration kicked off under the moderation of Ms. Man Wang, Vice President of WSCRC. First, Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA, delivered a summary of the initiative.

“Our initial goal for this compassion campaign was to deliver $400,000 worth of meals to frontline pandemic responders, and we surpassed that target by May 31. Upon achieving the first-phase objective, we launched a new mission for the second phase: You Help Them, We Help You. We called on the community to continue donating funds to support participating restaurants, covering part of their costs for donated meals — and we have successfully fulfilled this goal as well.”

She reflected emotionally:

“Over these months of this chain of goodwill, countless deeply touching stories unfolded. There were former recipients who stepped forward to become donors to the lunch program; caring individuals residing overseas who contributed generously to Seattle without ever meeting anyone here; and anonymous supporters purchasing meal vouchers through the Chowbus platform. Every story shines brightly throughout this campaign. Every small act of kindness merged into one great wave of compassion, uniting us as one community bound by love.”
“As many hands make light work.” Fueled by the boundless positive energy of the Food With Love initiative and these heartwarming stories of kindness, more organizations were inspired to join the cause. The Washington State Chinese Research Foundation (WSCRF) and Tsinghua GIX North America Center came on board as co-hosts and lent robust support to drive the charitable campaign forward.
WSCRF is the sister organization of the Washington State Chinese Council (WSCRC), dedicated to advancing educational and cultural exchanges and mutual understanding between Washington State and China. As one of the oldest statewide non-profit organizations fostering U.S.-China relations in the United States, its President J. Norwell Coquillard offered high praise for the program during the virtual celebration.

“Thank you to CCCWA for inviting us to be partners in this meal initiative. We firmly believe this program raises greater awareness of the contributions made by Chinese Americans and China-related organizations to the local community. It is truly inspiring to witness the selfless dedication of so many restaurants and volunteers. We look forward to further collaboration with CCCWA, Tsinghua GIX and Chinese community groups.”

Wenyan Guo, Representative of Tsinghua GIX North America Center, shared:
“I was deeply moved upon learning about the Food With Love initiative and hoped to join CCCWA and WSCRF in carrying out this meaningful work. Tsinghua GIX North America Center is an open educational and research platform with multicultural strengths, jointly established by Tsinghua University in China and the University of Washington in the United States with support from Microsoft Corporation. It strives to cultivate innovative leaders with global vision and explore solutions to a range of global challenges including sustainable development and mobile healthcare.”
Representatives from government agencies and organizations in Bellevue and Seattle also acknowledged and commended the significance of this initiative during the event. Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee, together with government representatives Natalie Thomson and Angela Miyamoto, delivered remarks.
Natalie Thomson and Angela Miyamoto expressed gratitude to participating restaurants for providing nourishing donated meals to multiple Community Living Connections sites across King County. These meals not only brought delicious cuisine that many homebound seniors and people with disabilities rarely get to enjoy, but also eased the burden on staff who care for them.

Conrad Lee stated in his address:

“The Food With Love initiative is incredibly inspiring. It unites our strength and brings our hearts closer together. It truly shows that in the face of the pandemic, we stand as one community and will overcome hardships side by side.”
On this occasion, he presented Community Contribution Awards to five restaurants and individuals: Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito, Summer Palace Peking Duck, Chowbus, and Sylvia Chin.
Attorney Qing Cai, one of the initiative founders and Lead of the Volunteer Legal Team, recounted the origins of the program and the handling of legal matters. He expressed satisfaction at the successful completion of the campaign. Xiaoyan Li, Lead of the Finance Team, participated as a volunteer representing the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club and Sunshine Youth Foundation. She shared that the drive received donations from all sectors of the community, totaling $63,579.50 in cash contributions. Of this amount, $38,979.50 was raised through the Sunshine Youth Foundation and $24,600 via WSCRF.

Ruoyao Li and Shuo Zhang, representatives of US Jingwei Investment, made an early lead donation of $10,000 at the launch of the initiative. Additional major donors included The Rieschel Foundation with $20,000, Seattle New Immigrant Center with $6,000, and Tuohong Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. with $6,000, alongside numerous individual contributors. Mr. Jiyuan Na, Lead of the Fundraising Team, thanked many individual donors including Mr. Huiwu Lai. Ms. Grace Gu, Lead of the Communications Team, acknowledged consistent media coverage and support throughout the campaign.

Ruoyao Li, representing donor US Jingwei Investment, joined the celebration remotely from China.

“I am deeply touched by the spirit of every participant in this initiative. I feel joyful and proud to stand alongside everyone to fight the pandemic amid this shared crisis and accomplish this charitable mission together.”

With 35 recipient organizations, outreach work was extremely demanding. Sylvia Chin, Outreach Lead and the sole individual recipient of the Community Contribution Award, shared stories of months of coordination with hospitals and other institutions. Website administrators Rhea Chen and Kevin Zhang volunteered while studying as college and high school students; their enthusiasm and efficiency drew widespread admiration.

The campaign’s success rested primarily on contributions from 13 participating restaurants. Anne Zhu, representative of Happy Lamb Hot Pot (formerly Little Sheep), Jason Huang from Liuyishou Hot Pot, Lucy Gao, founder of Boiling Fish Village, Kevin He, founder of IJ Sushi Burrito, and Patrick Ho, Manager of Summer Palace Peking Duck, spoke on behalf of all thirteen restaurants. They reflected on their reasons for joining the initiative, challenges encountered along the way, friendships forged with volunteer team members, the joy of reaching shared goals, and the overwhelming compassion from the broader community — making this experience unforgettable.

They shared heartfelt words:

“The pandemic delivered an unprecedented blow to the catering industry. Even so, our primary concern was not our own survival, but the safety of frontline pandemic responders. Only when they stay safe can they protect all of us. That has been our motivation throughout these months.”
Michelle, representative of Chowbus, commented:
“It has been a pleasure to achieve this goal together. We overcame numerous obstacles during meal deliveries and successfully fulfilled our distribution mission.”
Representatives from recipient organizations also delivered remarks to express their gratitude. Jae Lim, Diversity Program Manager at Swedish Health Services, and Braden Hirasawa, Center Manager at International Community Health Services, shared their appreciation. They noted that these delicious donated meals were deeply cherished by medical staff, who felt the warmth and kindness extended by the Chinese community.
Fengxi Luan, President of Seattle New Immigrant Center, congratulated the initiative on its successful conclusion. He shared that the New Immigrant Center was founded in 2014 and now boasts more than 1,000 member families. Numerous members of the Center took part in various pandemic response activities organized by the organization throughout the health crisis.

Qianqian Nie, President of the Seattle Entrepreneurship Association, the supporting organization, remarked:

“After reading the initiative appeal for the Food With Love campaign, we were deeply inspired and moved, so we stepped forward to lend our support to this program.”

The Food With Love initiative has officially drawn to a successful close. Yet the bonds forged by shared compassion will endure. Through months of side-by-side efforts, participants have built close, trusting partnerships. This group of volunteers united by kindness will continue moving forward, and the legacy of the Food With Love campaign will stand as a lasting testament to the Chinese community’s united pandemic relief efforts. Once again, we express our sincere gratitude to all these admirable people who carry love in their hearts and light in their eyes.

items.body_zh:
由华盛顿州中国总商会CCCWA、 华中基金会WSCRF和清华GIX北美中心联合主办的“Food With Love”大西雅图地区爱心午餐行动，在轰轰烈烈进行了几个月的爱心接力后，终于到达了胜利的终点。7月24日，活动主办方负责人、志愿者、市政代表、受捐单位代表欢聚一堂，用一个简单而充满爱的线上庆祝来为本次爱心活动画上圆满句号。整个爱心午餐活动共送出  21661份爱心午餐，价值41.1万美元，受赠单位35家。本次活动让大家深刻地感受到，心中有爱，眼里有光，即使在漫长的疫情期间，也能感受到世界的美好。

虽然突如其来的新冠病毒威胁我们的家园，然而病毒传播的速度再快，也赶不上我们爱心传播的速度。“爱心午餐”活动从开始的几个餐厅自发捐赠爱心餐，到西雅图最有影响力的十几家中餐厅共同上阵；从开始只有CCCWA牵头，到后来WSCRF华中基金会和清华GIX基金会联合主办；从餐厅捐赠到新移民之家等社团捐赠、社会各界捐赠；从捐送医护人员到如今捐赠给医护人员、警察、防疫人员等更多一线抗疫工作者……让这场爱心活动的影响力以如电光之照耀，带着满满的爱迅速蔓延，并在社会上引起极大的反响与好评，成为西雅图抗疫阶段最有影响力的品牌公益活动之一。

线上庆祝活动在WSCRC副会长王蔓女士主持下开始。首先CCCWA会长吕莉莉先对本次活动进行了总结：“这次爱心行动最初目标是向一线抗疫人员送出价值40万美元的爱心餐，截至5月31日已超额完成。第一阶段目标完成后，第二阶段又提出了‘你们帮助他们，我们帮助你们’ 的新目标，呼吁社会各界继续捐款支持已经参与热心义捐的餐厅，用所得善款补贴餐厅所捐餐食的部分成本，现在也都顺利完成目标。”她感慨：“这场爱心接力的几个月时间中，发生了很多让人热泪盈眶的故事，从曾经的受助者到如今也给爱心午餐献爱心的捐赠者，到人在国内只心系西雅图素未蒙面就放心捐赠的爱心人士，再到在Chowbus平台上匿名购买爱心盒饭的用户，每一个故事都是活动中的一个闪光点，把我们每个人的小爱心变成大爱心，成为一个爱的整体，一个爱的社区。”

“众人拾柴火焰高”，正是由于爱心午餐的无限正能量，正是因为这些感人心扉的爱心故事，感动了更多组织，让华中基金会WSCRF和清华GIX也以主办方身份加盟并鼎力推动爱心活动前进。


华中基金会是华中理事会（WSCRC）的姐妹组织，旨在增进华盛顿州和中国之间的教育文化交流与互相了解。作为美国州级历史最悠久的促进中美关系的非盈利组织，会长J. Norwell Coquillard也在线上庆祝活动中对本次活动高度赞扬，他说：“感谢CCCWA邀请我们成为爱心餐活动的合作伙伴。我们坚信这个活动能让更多人关注到华人及中国相关组织为当地社区所做的一切，看到那么的餐厅和志愿者为这个活动所做的无私奉献真的很令人感动，我们期待同CCCWA、清华GIX及华人社团的更多合作。”


清华GIX北美中心负责人郭文艳表示：“听到爱心午餐活动后备受感动，也希望和CCCWA、WSCRF一起做这件有意义的事情。清华GIX北美中心由中国的清华大学与美国的华盛顿大学，在微软公司支持下，合作搭建的具有多元文化优势的开放性教育和科研平台，致力于培养具有全球视野和创新精神的领军人才，探索解决一系列包括可持续发展、移动医疗在内的各类全球性挑战。”

来自Bellevue和Seattle政府或组织代表也在会上对本次活动的意义进行了肯定与赞扬。Bellevue市议员李瑞麟（Conrad Lee）、政府代表Natalie Thomson、Angela Miyamoto等进行了发言。NatalieThomson和AngelaMiyamoto感谢餐厅为King County多个Community Living Connections提供了美味的爱心餐。爱心餐不仅给这里行动不便的老人或残疾人士带去了同他们平常尝所未尝的美食，也为辛苦照顾老人们的服务人员缓解了压力。李瑞麟致辞说：“爱心午餐非常鼓舞人心，将大家的力量聚集起来，心也连得更近，让我们真正感受到了疫情面前，我们是一家人，我们共渡难关！”他特此向豆捞坊、IJ Sushi Burrito、颐和园北京烤鸭、Chowbus以及Sylvia Chin 5家餐厅或个人，颁发了社区贡献奖。

活动发起人之一、志愿者团队法律小组组长蔡清律师介绍了活动的发起缘由、法律事务的处理等问题，为活动顺利完成感到欣慰，财务组组长李晓艳代表西雅图地产投资俱乐部和阳光青少年基金会参加志愿者工作，她介绍本次活动得到了社会各界的捐赠，共收到现金捐款63579.5美金。其中通过阳光青少年基金会募捐到38979.5美金，通过WSCRF募捐到24600美金。美国经纬投资公司的代表李若垚、张硕伉俪在活动一开始，就率先领捐10000美金；The rieschel foundation  捐赠20000美金；西雅图新移民之家 捐赠6000美金；拓宏房地产开发有限公司捐赠6000美金；还有很多个人捐款。募捐组组长那济源先生感谢了包括来辉武先生等众多个人捐赠者，文宣组组长Grace Gu女士感谢了活动过程中得到的多家媒体的持续关注和报道。


捐赠单位美国经纬投资公司的代表李若垚也从国内参加了本次庆祝活动：“被爱心活动中每一位参与者的精神所感动，面对共同的危机，能够和大家站在一起携手抗击疫情，共同完成一个公益目标而感到开心自豪。”


这次活动有35个受赠单位，外联任务非常繁重，社区贡献奖唯一获奖个人外联组长Sylvia Chin讲述了这几个月来与医院等机构的联络故事。网站负责人Rhea Chen 、Kevin Zhang以大学生和高中生志愿者的身份参加活动，她们的工作热情和效率令人感动和赞叹。


这次活动能够成功，最主要的捐赠来自于13家爱心餐厅，快乐小羊（原小肥羊）餐厅代表Anne Zhu，刘一手负责人Jason Huang、沸腾鱼乡创始人Lucy Gao，IJ Sushi Burrito创始人Kevin He、颐和园北京烤鸭店店长Patrick Ho代表13家参加活动的餐厅发言，他们回忆起参加此次活动的初衷、在活动过程中遇到的困难、在活动过程中和志愿者团队一起建立的友谊、完成目标时的喜悦，以及感受到的来自整个社区的爱心，这一切使这段经历分外难忘。他们的肺腑之言“虽然疫情给餐饮行业带来了前所未有的重创，但是此时我们想到的不是自己能否存活下来，而是担心一线抗疫工作者的安危，只有他们安全了，才能更好地守护我们，这也是过去几个月中我们坚持的动力。”Chowbus负责人Michelle 说：“很高兴和大家共同实现了这个目标。虽然在配送爱心餐中遇到很多挑战与困难，但是我们都一一克服，胜利地完成本次配送任务。”

受捐机构代表Swedish Health Services 多元化项目经理Jae Lim和International Community Health Services 健康中心经理Braden Hirasawa也发言对活动表示感谢，他们说，这些非常美味的爱心餐品，让受捐助的医护人员感激不尽，让他们感受到来自华人社区的爱心。

为此次活动助力不少的新移民之家会长栾逢喜祝贺此次活动圆满成功，并介绍移民之家成立于2014年，已经有超过一千个家庭会员，新移民之家的众多会员在此次疫情中参与移民之家组织的多个抗疫活动。

协办单位西雅图创业协会会长聂倩倩说：“西雅图创业协会在看到爱心午餐倡议书被感染和感动，也发挥一臂之力帮助本次活动。”

“爱心午餐”活动至此完美落下帷幕，但是因爱而相识、聚集在一起的人们不会走散。经过几个月的并肩作战，大家都已经成为密切可信赖的伙伴，相信这支爱心队伍还将继续走下去，而爱心午餐活动的影响力也将一直留在华人齐心抗疫的丰碑中。再次感谢这群心中有爱、眼里有光的可爱可敬的人们。

items.title_en: CCCWA and WSCRC Co-Host the 2020 Chinese Catering Entrepreneurship Forum (Session II)
items.title_zh: CCCWA 和WSCRC联合主办2020 中餐业创业论坛 （第二期）
items.body_en:
On August 7, 2020, the second session of the 2020 Washington State Chinese Catering Entrepreneurship Forum was successfully held. Centering on the challenges and opportunities brought by the pandemic to the Chinese food industry, forum speakers engaged in in-depth exchanges covering multiple perspectives: urban planning and architectural design, commercial real estate investment, consumer data analytics from food delivery platforms, legal matters related to catering investment, and the practical operation of restaurant brands.

Hui Tian
President, Studio 19 Architects

Architect Hui Tian shared insights from urban planning and architectural design perspectives. He noted that updated city zoning regulations have fueled growing municipal demand for catering establishments. Meanwhile, the catering sector and commercial real estate enjoy a mutually beneficial relationship, and the development of restaurants is closely intertwined with urban expansion.

Larry Eu
CEO, Great Earth Realty

Larry shared experience and advice regarding shifting commercial real estate investment trends, site selection for restaurant long-term development, and strategies for restaurant tenants negotiating and executing commercial lease agreements.

Michelle Lei
Seattle Regional General Manager, Chowbus Inc.

Speaking on behalf of food delivery platform Chowbus, Michelle presented market insights derived from marketing and consumption data of restaurants and customers. She pointed out that Chinese restaurants are steadily expanding their non-Asian customer base, and brand recognition together with food quality are key to boosting revenue and reaching broader audiences.

Jason Huang
Seattle Representative, LIUYISHOU HOT POT

Drawing on over 30 years of experience in catering management, Jason summarized opportunities and challenges facing Chinese restaurants amid the pandemic. He shared comprehensive operational experience covering restaurant management, product standardization, cost structure, service quality control, and critical evaluation criteria for brand franchising.

David Li
Marketing Manager, Happy Lamb Hot Pot

From the standpoint of launching new catering brands, David discussed how emerging brands balanced government mandates and consumer demands during the pandemic. He elaborated on strategies for expanding into the North American consumer market, brand marketing, high-standard product standardization, and potential investment and growth directions for the future.

Attorney Qing Cai
Cai & Associates, P.C.

Attorney Qing Cai offered legal perspectives, sharing practical experience concerning restaurant franchising models, relevant government permitting procedures, and commercial lease contracts for catering businesses.

Panel participants exchanged ideas, shared expertise, and held thorough discussions on the future of the catering industry. CCCWA aims for this forum to serve as an efficient, high-quality networking platform for restaurant operators, investors interested in the food sector, and industry practitioners. It seeks to assist catering businesses in navigating the difficult pandemic period and foster a new wave of investment in the restaurant industry in the near future.

The forum was hosted by Michelle Zou, Founder of Pacific Consulting. Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State), and Man Wang, Vice President of WSCRC (Washington State Chinese Council), attended the event and delivered remarks on behalf of the co-host organizations.
items.body_zh:
2020年8月7日，2020华州中餐业创业论坛第二期顺利举办，论坛嘉宾们围绕疫情给中餐业带来的挑战与机遇，从城市规划、建筑设计；地产投资；送餐企业的消费者数据分析；餐饮业投资法律相关事宜；以及餐饮品牌实际运营等多个角度，进行了深入的分享沟通。


Studio 19 Architects 总裁

田晖

 

田晖建筑设计师从城市规划、建筑设计的角度分享了由于城市Zoning提升，城市对餐饮业的需求也在增加；同时餐饮业与商业地产拥有相辅相成互惠互利的关系，餐饮业的发展与城市的发展拓展紧密相关。

 

Great Earth Realty CEO

Larry Eu

 

Larry 从商业地产投资趋势变化，餐饮业企业中长期发展店面位置选择，餐饮业企业作为租户在店面租赁合同的谈判与签署的策略等角度分享了经验与建议。

 

Chowbus Inc.西雅图地区总经理

Michelle Lei

 

Michelle从Chowbus送餐企业的角度，分享了通过分析餐饮企业、消费者的营销及消费数据所得到的市场信息，提到了中餐业在稳步拓展非亚裔客户群体，品牌中餐知名度与餐品质量是提升销售额拓宽销售群体的重点。

 

刘一手（LIUYISHOU HOT POT）西雅图负责人 

Jason Huang

 

Jason从拥有30余年餐饮企业经营管理的角度，总结了中餐业在疫情环境下面临的机遇与挑战，详细分享了餐饮业企业经营、产品标准化、运营成本结构、服务标准管控、品牌加盟关键考察点等全方面的餐饮企业运营经验。

 

快乐小羊（Happy Lamb Hot Pot）市场经理

David Li

 

David从餐饮新品牌打造的角度，分享了疫情期间新品牌企业在应对政府要求与消费者需求之间的平衡措施，详细分析了北美消费者市场拓展方式、品牌营销方案、产品标准化高品质管控、以及未来潜在的投资与拓展方向。

 

蔡和蔡律师事务所（Cai&Associates）

蔡清律师

 

蔡清律师从法律角度，从餐饮企业加盟模式、政府相关审核批准流程、餐饮业店面租赁合同等多方面，总结并分享了相关经验经历。

 

与会嘉宾们相互沟通、经验共享、共同对餐饮业未来的发展进行了深入的探讨与交流。CCCWA希望此次论坛，对各餐饮企业、对餐饮业感兴趣的投资人、以及对相关产业从业者，提供了高效高质量的交流共享平台及机会，帮助各餐饮企业顺利度过艰苦的疫情期，并能在不久的将来带来餐饮业投资的新热潮。

 

论坛由太平洋咨询创始人 Michelle Zou主持，CCCWA（华盛顿州中国总商会）会长吕莉莉女士、WSCRC（华盛顿州中国理事会）副会长王蔓出席论坛并代表主办单位讲话。

items.title_en: U.S. Representative Adam Smith and Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee Visit CCCWA
items.title_zh: 联邦众议员Adam Smith先生和Bellevue市政议员Conrad Lee先生来访CCCWA
items.body_en:
Representative Smith serves Washington State’s 9th Congressional District and chairs the Armed Services Committee. He also serves as Co-Chair of the Effective Foreign Assistance Caucus, which he helped establish. A longstanding advocate for strengthening U.S. diplomacy and international development, Representative Smith holds many important viewpoints on how to improve U.S.-China relations.

Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee has consistently cared for and supported the development of the local Chinese community, backing numerous public welfare initiatives organized by the Chinese community.
items.body_zh:
2022 年2月 25日，联邦众议员Adam Smith先生和Bellevue市政议员Conrad Lee 先生来访华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA），给会员们送来新春祝福，并对大家关心的中美关系、俄乌战争、社区安全等问题，与来自计算机科技、房地产开发、建材、国际贸易、投资等多个行业的会员单位代表进行了座谈。史密斯众议员分享了他对关键国家安全问题以及影响美中关系的问题的看法。Bellevue市政议员Conrad Lee 先生主持会谈。

史密斯议员代表华盛顿州的第9国会选区，并担任武装部队的主席。史密斯众议员还担任有效对外援助国会核心小组的联合主席，这个小组是他帮助创建的核心小组。作为加强美国外交与发展的长期倡导者，史密斯众议员就如何改善美中关系有很多重要看法。

Bellevue市政议员Conred Lee先生一直关心和支持当地华裔社区的发展，支持了华裔社区的大量公益活动。

他们还倾听了参会代表的一些商务方面的困难和挑战,并给出切实可行的建议,认为普吉特湾地区未来长远发展有极大潜力，鼓励大家克服暂时的困难，取得更大的商业成就。

items.title_en: Your Input Matters! Join the Virtual Community Meeting for Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan!
items.title_zh: 您的意见至关重要！参与Bellevue2044 综合规划市民线上见面会！
items.body_en:
The City of Bellevue is hosting a special Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan community outreach session exclusively for Chinese community members, and all Bellevue stakeholders are cordially invited to attend.
Staff from relevant City of Bellevue departments and City Councilmembers will be present at this session to engage in direct dialogue with you. You will also have the opportunity to complete related surveys and share your perspectives on housing issues in Bellevue.

Event Details


Topic: Bellevue 2044 Information Session for Chinese Community Members
Date: Thursday, March 9, 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM
Format: Virtual meeting via Zoom
Registration Link: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bellevue-2044-planning-for-the-future--tickets-557302927057 (Copy and paste the link into your browser to open it)

What Is a Comprehensive Plan?


A Comprehensive Plan is a vital resource utilized by the City Council, boards, commissions and city staff to make key decisions covering housing, transportation, parks, public services, economic development and more. Comprehensive Plan updates take place only once every 7 to 10 years. Your participation and feedback are invaluable to building a safe, convenient and healthy living and working environment for you and younger generations over the next 10 to 20 years.
This core document outlines the city’s long-term vision and lays out actionable guidance to achieve it. City Councilmembers, board, commission members and municipal staff rely on this document to shape major policies around housing, transportation, parks and other critical areas. The City’s motivation to update its Comprehensive Plan is to preserve and elevate the high quality of life residents enjoy in Bellevue.

The goals and policies defined within the plan guarantee residents access to:
  • A diverse range of affordable housing options for all income brackets
  • Abundant recreational opportunities
  • Access to parks, natural resources and green spaces
  • Career opportunities and economic growth prospects
  • Safe, convenient travel by car, bicycle, foot and public transit
  • Clean air, clean water and a healthy environment
  • Additional community priorities
Your Input Is Critical

As we all know, building a vibrant Chinese community requires active participation from every individual. The Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan Community Meeting is a uniquely meaningful event tailored for the Chinese community. Your suggestions and needs will be heard directly by City of Bellevue department staff and City Councilmembers.

For yourself and every Chinese resident in Bellevue, we all share a responsibility to take part in this event and work together to foster a safe and thriving Chinese community.
items.body_zh:
Bellevue市政府专为华人社区成员举行 Bellevue 2044 综合规划市民见面会，诚邀所有Bellevue利益相关者参加。

Bellevue市相关部门的工作人员以及市议员会参加本次见面会，直接与您对话。在这次见面会，您还将有机会填写相关的调查问卷，表达您对Bellevue住房问题的看法。

主题：Bellevue市政府华人社区成员举行 Bellevue 2044 信息会议

时间：3 月 9 日（周四），晚上 6:00-7:30

形式：Zoom线上会议

注册链接：https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bellevue-2044-planning-for-the-future--tickets-557302927057（复制链接在浏览器打开）


  什么是综合规划  


综合规划是一个重要工具，供市议会、理事会和委员会以及市政府工作人员使用，以做出住房、交通、公园、公众服务、经济等方面的重要决策。这样的规划每7-10年才进行一次，为了自己以及年轻一代未来10-20年有一个安全、便捷、健康的生活、工作环境，您的参与和意见至关重要！
此计划是一份核心文件，概述了未来的愿景，并为实现愿景指明方向。文件供市议会、理事会和委员会以及市政府工作人员使用，以做出住房、交通、公园等方面的重要决策。市政府要更新其综合计划 (Comprehensive Plan) 的宗旨是为了人们在 Bellevue 享有的高品质生活。

计划中明确的目标和政策可确保人们获得：

o   不同收入层级皆可负担得起的各种住房方案。
o   各种娱乐机会。
o   使用公园自然资源和绿色空间。
o   获得工作和经济发展机会。
o   能够安全方便地开车、骑自行车、步行及乘坐公共交通工具。
o   获得清洁的空气、水和良好的环境。
o   其他问题。 

  您的意见至关重要  


我们都知道华人社区的建设需要每个人的积极参与，Bellevue 2044 综合规划市民见面会正是一个面向华人举办的意义非凡的活动，您的建议和需求都将被Bellevue市相关部门的工作人员以及市议员直接听到。

为了您和Bellevue的每位华人，我们都有责任积极参与这次的活动，为创造一个安全、幸福的华人社区共同努力。

items.title_en: The safety seminar co-hosted by CCCWA and the Bellevue Police Department concluded successfully.
items.title_zh: CCCWA与贝尔维尤市警察局联合主办的安全讲座成功落幕
items.body_en:
The seminar featured a tight agenda, with all discussion topics closely relevant to daily life and work. The responses provided by police officers and safety specialists were highly actionable and earned widespread acclaim.
The final audience question was: “What will Bellevue police do in the event of an active school shooting?” Assistant Chief Popochock responded, “Officers will charge straight into the school. We will take the bullets so the children do not.”
The audience was deeply moved. Many shared notes of gratitude to the officers who protect community safety and thanked them for delivering such a practical seminar.
Following the event, numerous attendees commented that the seminar was enormously helpful to participants. Equally important, it fostered stronger connections and trust between law enforcement and the community. Attendees feel safer living and working in Bellevue and have greater pride in the city.

moderator
PIO Meeghan Black
items.body_zh:
2022年5月31日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会与贝尔维尤市警察局（BellevuePoliceDepartment）联合主办的安全讲座成功举办。

贝尔维尤市警察局派出9位警员和安全专家的强大阵容参与这次活动，就听众提出的如何使用武器、如何提高自卫能力、如何快速有效地报警、如何识别假警察等日常工作和生活中的三十多个安全问题进行了解答， **重点讲解了企业主可以定期采取的预防犯罪措施、店铺遇到抢劫怎么办、办公楼、公寓楼及周边地区的预防犯罪措施等等商务人员关注的安全问题**。现场听众较多，大家积极互动，气氛热烈。

安全讲座线上现场

本次讲座活动议程紧凑，讨论的问题都和日常的生活工作息息相关，警员和安全专家们回答的也特别具有可操作性，获得了广泛好评。**当最后一个问题“如果发生校园枪击案，Bellevue的警察会怎么办？”Assistant Chief Popochock回答“警察一定会冲进学校，让子弹射在我们身上，而不是射到孩子们身上”**，听众们深受感动，纷纷留言感谢保卫社区安全的警员们，也感激他们带来这么实用的讲座。会后多位参加者认为此次活动不仅对听众非常有帮助，而且对警民之间建立良好的联系和信任有很好的帮助作用，对在Bellevue居住或工作感觉更安全，为我们的城市感到更自豪。

警察局长Wendell Shirley出席活动并做开场讲话，活动的主持人由PIO Meeghan Black担任。

items.title_en: Counselor Wu Peimin and Consul Fu Lin from the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco were invited to attend a forum with members of the Washington State Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Seattle.
items.title_zh: 旧金山总领馆邬沛民参赞和付琳领事与华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA）会员在西雅图座谈
items.body_en:
On the afternoon of April 13, 2023, Counselor Wu Peimin and Consul Fu Lin from the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco held a discussion with members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) in Seattle. The participating members represented a wide range of sectors including real estate development, finance, seafood processing and trade, catering, information technology, silk manufacturing, legal services and design services.

Representatives from real estate firm Gemdale Properties, architectural design studio MZA, as well as commercial real estate brokerage and lending services provider CBRE shared that the current economic landscape poses severe challenges for the industry. Persistently high interest rates and construction costs, elevated vacancy rates in commercial real estate, drastic fluctuations in asset values, and mounting pressures on developers regarding cost control and sales have drastically dampened new construction intentions. Overall, residential real estate outperforms commercial real estate, while affordable essential housing fares better than high-end luxury properties.

The management of Happy Lamb North America recounted the opportunities and hardships the catering sector endured throughout the pandemic. While restaurant foot traffic has largely rebounded to pre-pandemic levels, consumer spending habits have undergone lasting shifts as a result of the health crisis. Happy Lamb now operates 37 locations across North America.

A representative from seafood trader Risun Company shared that pandemic-era public health restrictions in China and broken global supply chains forced many of their clients to switch to suppliers in other countries, triggering a sharp drop in trade orders that will take an extended period to recover from.

Representatives from IT enterprises noted that strained China-U.S. relations have compelled clients to bar service provision based in China. As a result, these firms have downsized their mainland Chinese branches and launched new operations in countries such as Mexico and India.

Members also cited emerging cross-border hurdles as cautionary tales for fellow chamber participants. One notable case involved shipments of ketchup detained by U.S. customs solely due to labeling indicating Xinjiang, China as a production origin, an outcome tied to U.S. anti-forced labor legislation. Attendees also called for more direct flights between China and the United States to facilitate travel for business professionals and accelerate the revival of people-to-people economic and cultural exchanges between the two nations.

A representative of ICBC US presented the bank’s newly launched service offerings, while a delegate from Yilin Investment recounted the firm’s growth trajectory in the United States and its successful collaborative ventures with other chamber members.
The open and lively discussion saw participants speak freely. Counselor Wu Peimin commended the chamber’s strong cohesion and praised its members for their deep local roots, diverse expertise and remarkable achievements across respective industries. He also shared case studies of enterprises operating in regions including California for reference, encouraging attendees to overcome prevailing economic headwinds and actively pursue breakthroughs and growth amid the downturn.

Ms. Lili Lü, incumbent President of CCCWA, extended gratitude to Counselor Wu Peimin and Consul Fu Lin for taking time from their busy schedules to join the forum, as well as to all members for their active engagement in chamber events. She expressed hope that the chamber platform would continue to enable robust information sharing, foster partnerships and drive mutual prosperity for all members.
items.body_zh:
2023年4月13日下午，旧金山总领馆邬沛民参赞和付琳领事在西雅图与华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA）会员座谈。与会会员来自房地产开发、金融、海产品加工及贸易、餐饮、计算机、丝绸加工、法律、设计服务等多个行业。

房地产行业金地地产、建筑设计MZA公司、及商业地产经纪及贷款服务公司CBRE代表分表讲述目前经济环境下利率高企、建造成本居高不下，商业地产空置率较高、资产价值剧烈波动、开发企业后续在成本管控、销售等问题上面临较大压力，目前开工意愿较低，总的看来住宅要优于商业、刚需产品优于高端产品。

餐饮行业快乐小羊北美公司负责人讲述餐饮行业在疫情期间的机遇与挑战，目前餐厅行业已基本恢复到疫情前的客流量，但疫情也导致大家的消费习惯发生了一些变化，目前快乐小羊在北美已有37家店。

经营水产品贸易的日升公司代表分享了疫情期间因中国疫情管控、链断裂导致很多客户无奈转向其他国家货源供应商，贸易订单大幅减少，恢复需要较长时间。

IT行业公司代表讲述由于中美关系影响，其客户要求不能在中国提供服务，他们只能收缩中国境内分公司规模，转向在墨西哥、印度等国家开设公司。

会员们提及他们遇到的一些新问题例如番茄酱因产地标注了中国新疆导致被扣在海关，原因竟然是和反强迫劳动法相关等案例，讲出来给商会会员们借鉴，也呼吁增加中美之间的直飞航班，让商务人士往返更便捷、让中美民间经济文化交流更快恢复。

工银美国代表也介绍了一些新增服务，一林投资代表讲述其在美发展历程及在商会与其他会员单位的成功合作。

大家畅所欲言，气氛活跃，邬培民参赞高度评价商会的凝聚力，也赞扬会员们深耕本地，各有所长，在各自的领域取得的突出成就，并且分享其他地区如加州一些企业的案例给大家参考，鼓励大家在经济低迷期克服困难，努力寻求突破和发展。

商会现任会长吕莉莉女士感谢邬沛民参赞和付琳领事百忙中来访，感谢各位会员积极参与商会活动，期待大家通过商会平台更多地分享信息，达成合作、共同发展。

items.title_en: Event Preview | An In-Depth Look at FinCEN's RRE Reporting Rule and Asset Protection for Chinese American Families
items.title_zh: 活动预告 |深度解析 FinCEN RRE 申报规则与华人家庭资产保护
items.body_en:
Effective March 1, 2026, the U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) officially rolled out its Residential Real Estate Reporting Rule (RRE Rule). This federal regulation impacts not only first-time homebuyers but also property owners who hold residential assets via LLCs for privacy protection, or families planning to transfer real estate into trusts for generational wealth succession.

Statistics show that 20,000 to 30,000 title transfers involving legal entities or trusts take place in Washington State annually, all now subject to this new federal mandate. Previously, Washington state law classified such transfers as a Mere Change in Form — exempt from Real Estate Excise Tax (REET) when beneficial ownership remained unchangedapps.leg.w.... Under the new RRE Rule, however, these same transactions trigger mandatory federal reporting requirements for all non-mortgaged transfers. Inaccurate filings or deliberate failure to report may trigger rigorous anti-money laundering (AML) audits and severe criminal penalties.

A large share of Chinese-American households in Washington own residential properties. Many investors place rental homes under LLC ownership to isolate personal liability. Meanwhile, Washington’s estate tax drives numerous families to transfer real estate into trusts for smooth intergenerational asset transfer. While state law waives transfer taxes for these "mere form changes," the federal government treats all such zero-loan internal transfers as reportable transactions under the RRE Rule.

To unpack this complex new regulation for local Chinese community members, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) has assembled a panel of industry experts:

  • Attorney Alex Cai of Cai & Associates Law Firm
  • Bowic Tse, Industry Specialist from Old Republic Title
  • Allison Fang, Credit Specialist at ICBC USA

This session will break down the regulatory mismatch between Washington state tax statutes and federal RRE reporting rules, supported by real-world case studies.

Core Discussion Highlights from Expert Panel

  1. Why internal transfers with no cash consideration are the highest-risk reporting category
  2. Clear breakdown of exempt vs. high-risk reportable transfers between individuals, LLCs, revocable trusts and irrevocable trusts
  3. Guidance for real estate agents to guide clients through compliant closings and avoid secondary liability under the federal reporting cascade framework
  4. Full list of required documentation and official filing procedures
  5. Financial compliance & lending solutions: holistic mortgage financing for new immigrants and local residents. ICBC USA will share updated underwriting trends for residential mortgages, commercial real estate loans and construction loans.

Hot Q&A Topics Covered by Attorney Alex Cai

  • I transferred my personal house to my wholly-owned LLC with zero money exchanged — why is a federal report required?
  • Key reporting differences between transferring property to your own revocable trust versus gifting real estate to a children’s trust
  • Why seller-financed or private-loan property purchases are categorized as all-cash reportable transactions
  • How federal authorities conduct full beneficial ownership tracing if a property owner fails to file a report
  • Legal definition of the primary mandatory reporting party; whether self-filing by property owners is legally recognized

Event Details

Time: Thursday, March 26, 2:40 PM – 4:40 PM (Pacific Time) Venue: Lake Hills Library 15590 Lake Hills Blvd, Bellevue, WA 98007

Organizer: Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) [LOGO] Co-Organizer: Seattle Real Estate Investment Club [LOGO]

Official Industry Terminology Reference

  1. FinCEN: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network 美国财政部金融犯罪执法局（RRE 规则发布机构）
  2. RRE Rule: Residential Real Estate Reporting Rule 住宅房地产申报规则
  3. Mere Change in Form 形式变更（华盛顿州不动产消费税豁免法定术语）
  4. Real Estate Excise Tax (REET) 华盛顿州房产过户消费税
  5. reporting cascade 阶梯责任制（联邦 RRE 规则申报责任优先级机制）
  6. revocable trust /irrevocable trust 可撤销信托 / 不可撤销信托
  7. beneficial ownership tracing 资产穿透式权属核查
  8. anti-money laundering (AML) 反洗钱合规
  9. title company /settlement agent 产权公司 / 过户结算代理人
  10. non-financed transfer 无贷款全款资产转让（RRE 规则监管核心交易类型）
items.body_zh:
自 2026 年 3 月 1 日起，美国正式实施“住宅房地产申报规则”（RRE Rule） 。该规则不仅影响初次购房者，更深度波及通过 LLC 持有房产以保护隐私，或正在考虑将房产转入家庭信托以实现财富传承的群体 。

根据统计，华盛顿州每年约有20,000 至 30,000 件 涉及实体或信托的产权转让受到此新规直接影响。过去在华州法律下被视为“形式变更”（Mere Change in Form）且免除过户税的产权转让，现在均面临联邦层面的强制合规申报 。任何申报不当或瞒报，都可能触发反洗钱合规的严厉审计与刑事处罚 。

华州华人群体拥有住宅房比例较高，且当住宅作为投资房时，通常习惯将其转至 LLC 名下以风险隔离 。受华盛顿州遗产税的影响，许多家庭选择将房产“搬进”信托以实现财富平稳传承 。过去在华州法律下属于“形式变更”（Mere Change in Form）且免过户税的产权转让，现在在联邦眼中均属于“无银行贷款”的强制申报交易 。

为此，CCCWA华商会诚邀蔡和蔡律师事务所（Cai & Associates）蔡清律师（Alex Cai），联手Old Republic Title产权公司专家Bowic Tse (谢绍霖) 先生及工银美国信贷专员Allison Fang 女士，为您深度拆解新规。我们将探讨华州法律与联邦申报规则之间的“错位”，并分享具体案例 。

 专家团核心分享亮点 

  • 为什么“没有金钱交易”的内部转让反而是申报重灾区？ 

  • 个人、LLC、可撤销信托与不可撤销信托之间的转让，哪些是“豁免区”，哪些是“红线区”？ 

  • 房地产经纪人如何引导客户完成合规交易，避免在阶梯责任制下的连带风险。

  • 申报要求及具体资料。

  • 金融合规与融资：为新移民及本地居民提供全方位融资服务。工银美国将分享在房贷产品、商业地产贷款及建筑贷款的最新审批趋势。


 蔡律师还将为您解答以下热点问题 

  • 我把房子转进自己的 LLC，没有任何金钱往来，为什么要报？ 

  • 转入“可撤销信托”与赠与“子女信托”在申报上有何本质区别？ 

  • 通过“卖方融资”或“私人借贷”购房，为什么被视为现金交易？ 

  • 我不报，政府怎么会知道？联邦是如何实现对资产持有人的全方位穿透？

  • 谁是法律定义的第一申报人？我自己申报能否获得法律认可？


时间：2026年 3月26日下午2:45-4:45

地点： 15590 Lake Hills Blvd, Bellevue, WA 98007  (Lake Hills Library   ) 

主办：CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会（LOGO）

协办：西雅图地产投资俱乐部（LOGO）

items.title_en: Event Preview | Seattle's Latest Scam Tactics and High-Risk Traps: A Seminar on Common Anti-Fraud Methods

items.body_en:
Anti-Fraud Online Seminar Notice

Telecom and online financial scams have surged across the Greater Seattle Area with increasingly sophisticated tactics, ranging from fake investment schemes to pig-butchering romance scams that are extremely hard to guard against. Multiple high-value fraud cases targeting Chinese residents have been reported solely within Bellevue.

To address this growing crisis, Bellevue Police Department is co-hosting a bilingual anti-fraud webinar together with the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA), EmP, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, CIE, Hengda Academy and Little Masters.

What You Will Learn at This Seminar

  1. Newest scam tactics and high-risk traps targeting local residents
  2. Practical ways to protect yourself from fraud
  3. How to seek help and file police reports when encountering suspicious activities
  4. Strategies to safeguard your family’s assets and personal finances

The session will be delivered in both English and Chinese, welcoming elderly community members with limited English proficiency to join.

Event Information

Date & Time: Wednesday, October 8, 7:00 PM Format: Zoom Online Webinar

Registration Instructions

Email your registration request to bellevuepd@bellevuewa.gov (emails written in Chinese or English are both accepted). Only registered participants will receive the Zoom meeting ID and passcode via email.

Survey Link

Scan the QR code or copy the link below to complete the questionnaire: https://forms.gle/TMsXb4i4iNb5SeCF7

特此Bellevue 警方联合CCCWA华商会，EmP，西雅图移民之家，CIE，恒达学院，小大师，举办一场反诈主题讲座。通过讲座您将了解到：最新诈骗手法和高危陷阱，常用防骗方法，遇到可疑情况如何求助和报警，如何守护自己与家人的财产安全。讲座将会采取双语形式，欢迎不懂英语的老年人一起来听。

items.title_en: CCCWA Real Estate Development and Investment Salon, Session 4: 2025 Residential Real Estate Market Trends in the U.S. and Washington State
items.title_zh: CCCWA房地产开发与投资沙龙第四期：2025年美国及华州住宅地产的市场趋势
items.body_en:
The volatile shifts of the real estate market constantly capture widespread public attention. A recent report by KUOW revealed that active housing inventory in Seattle exceeded the number of prospective buyers by approximately 10% this April, officially pushing the local market into a buyer’s market.

Home prices are declining in cities that once saw explosive construction booms, including Austin, Nashville and Phoenix, as well as several Florida cities frequently hit by hurricanes and floods. Even amid sky-high mortgage rates that dampen housing demand, the ratio of available homes to potential buyers in Miami has hit 3 to 1. What does the future hold for Washington State’s real estate market? How can investors navigate property investments amid the current market climate?

This bilingual Chinese-English seminar features three seasoned real estate brokers and market analysts with cross-border living and professional experience across multiple regions.

Seminar Agenda

  1. U.S. and Washington State real estate market shifts as of June 2025
  2. Residential market trends in core King County cities: Seattle, Bellevue, Tacoma and surrounding areas
  3. Untapped investment opportunities within Lewis County, Washington
  4. Strategic real estate investment approaches for a cooling market cycle
  5. How to select high-quality investment properties to generate steady rental income alongside long-term property value appreciation

Max Vogt

Realtor & Owner of Windermere Centralia City Council Member, Centralia

Max boasts nearly 40 years of experience in the real estate industry. He launched his real estate career in Cincinnati, Ohio back in 1984, and has practiced real estate in Washington State for more than 30 years. He served as President of the Lewis County Realtors Association in 2021 and was honored as Realtor of the Year in 2022. In addition, he has held office as a Centralia City Council Member since 2015 and previously served as Mayor of Centralia.

Max has owned Windermere Centralia since May 2000. The brokerage employs dozens of licensed real estate agents and ranks as the top-selling real estate firm in Centralia.

Cong Zhao

Licensed Realtor, Best Choice Real Estate

While working in energy trading, Cong Zhao bought and sold investment properties across three states, which sparked his passion for real estate. Having resided in four U.S. states and traveled extensively to visit friends while researching local housing markets nationwide, he possesses in-depth knowledge of regional real estate trends and enjoys sharing his professional insights with clients and peers. He prides himself on listening closely to clients’ unique needs and delivering tailored solutions that create tangible value for every buyer and seller.

Alican Bodur

Realtor & Market Analyst, Windermere Real Estate

Raised in a multi-generational real estate family in Turkey, Alican witnessed firsthand how property decisions shape people’s lives and build intergenerational wealth. Today, he brings that same passion to his career, delivering strategic, business-savvy real estate advisory services to clients and partners.

He holds a degree in Industrial Engineering, a background focused on streamlining complex systems to boost efficiency and deliver measurable results. He later earned his MBA, where he mastered cutting-edge marketing and sales frameworks for leading enterprises. Alican applies this data-driven strategic mindset to every real estate engagement.

Event Details

Date & Time: June 26, 2025, 11:45 AM – 1:45 PM Venue: 411 West Main Street, Centralia, WA 98531 Phone: (360) 736-3300

Acknowledgements

Riverside Gardens, a residential community featuring 89 single-family homes and townhomes, generously sponsored food and beverages for this event.
items.body_zh:
房地产市场的风云变幻，总是牵动着无数人的心。近日，KUOW 报道指出，今年 4 月西雅图的房源数量比购房者数量多出约 10%，迈入买方市场行列。

奥斯汀、纳什维尔和凤凰城等经历过狂热的建筑热潮的城市，以及飓风和洪涝灾害频发的佛罗里达州一些城市房价正在下跌。甚至在抵押贷款利率高企抑制需求的当下，迈阿密房产市场上待售房屋数量与潜在购房者的比例已达到 3:1，华盛顿州房地产市场未来走势如何？在这样的市场环境中应该如何进行房地产投资？

本次讲座由三位有不同国家和地区生活经历、经验丰富的地产经纪人和分析师主讲，中英双语。

 活动内容  

1，2025年6月美国及华州的房地产市场变化。

2，华州King County重点城市Seattle、Bellevue、Tacoma 等地住宅地产的市场变化。

3，华州Lewis County市场机会。

4，市场下行周期的地产投资策略分析。

5，如何用优质房地产投资获得稳定的租金回报同时兼顾物业升值？

 主讲人 

Max Vogt 

地产经纪人和Windermere Centralia分公司拥有人。

Centrallia市议员。

Max拥有近40年的房地产行业经验，从1984年开始从事房地产行业，职业生涯始于俄亥俄州辛辛那提市。在华盛顿州从事房地产行业已有30多年。2021年，他担任刘易斯县房地产经纪人协会主席，并于2022年被评为年度优秀房地产经纪人。自2015年起，他还担任Centralia市的市议员，并曾任Centralia市的市长。

他从2000年5月开始拥有Windermere Centralia分公司，Windermere Centralia团队有几十名持牌经纪人，在Centralia市是销售额最大的地产经纪公司。

Cong Zhao
Best Choice 地产经纪人 

当Cong Zhao从事能源交易业务时，曾亲自在三个不同的州买卖房产，也因此爱上了房地产行业。作为一位曾在四个不同州生活、并曾走访多个州拜访当地朋友、研究各地房地产市场的人，他各地市场的特点十分了解，也乐于与客户和朋友们分享他的见解。擅长倾听客户的需求，为客户创造价值。

LICAN BODUR 
Windermere经纪人及分析师

Alican在土耳其一个房地产世家长大，他亲眼见证了房地产决策如何深刻影响人们的生活，并塑造代代相传的财富与传承。如今，他将同样的热情投入到工作中，为客户和合作伙伴带来兼具策略性思维和商业洞察的服务。

Alican拥有工业工程背景，长期致力于优化复杂系统以提高效率并取得成果。同时，他还获得了MBA学位，期间深入掌握了领先企业的市场营销和销售策略。因此，他将这一套以数据为驱动的战略方法应用于房地产领域。

活动地点：411 West Main Street  Centralia, Washington 98531

联系电话：60-736-3300

items.title_en: Event Preview | Safeguarding the US Expansion of Chinese Multinational Companies -- A Legal Seminar
items.title_zh: 活动预告 | 为中资跨国企业在美国发展保驾护航——相关法律讲座
items.body_en:
Changes in the current international landscape have brought both tremendous opportunities and challenges for Chinese multinational companies expanding in the United States. TikTok, the international version of Douyin, has taken North America by storm; fast-fashion brand Shein has filed for a US listing; and Pinduoduo's cross-border platform Temu has become the most-downloaded shopping app in the US market -- all setting examples of Chinese companies "going global." However, in this process of "going global," companies will inevitably face legal challenges. To address this, CCCWA has specially invited the Chamber's General Legal Counsel, Attorney Cao Xiaohe, to share insights and lead a discussion on immigration planning for multinational companies going global. **Speaker: Attorney Cao Xiaohe** **Founder, Law Offices of Xiaohe Cao (USA)** **Founder, International Law Society** CCCWA General Legal Counsel Attorney Cao Xiaohe holds a Bachelor of Laws in International Economic Law from the China University of Political Science and Law and a Juris Doctor from the United States, and is licensed to practice law in both China and the US. For 18 years she has focused on US immigration law, representing hundreds of investors through numerous regional centers and direct investment immigration programs, and helping corporate executives and skilled professionals settle in the United States. Drawing on US policy, she has designed immigration plans for individuals of extraordinary ability and National Interest Waiver applicants, and has provided integrated planning for companies' short- and long-term work and visitor visas. For over a decade she has appeared as an immigration expert guest on Sino Radio and Seattle Chinese Radio, and as an expert guest for the "Attorney Cao's Mailbox" program. **Seminar Overview** This seminar aims to share and analyze practical advice on the immigration policy, business environment, and legal issues encountered during immigration planning or when settling in the United States. The intended audience includes executives of multinational companies, technical experts, investors, entrepreneurs, and professionals across industries hoping to "go global." **Understanding Immigration Policy and Its Changes: Designing Multinational Staff Transfers and US Recruitment** In today's globalized business environment, a thorough understanding of US immigration options is essential to career development. This seminar will offer entrepreneurs, executives, and professionals diverse advice and support for pathways to the United States, covering comprehensive solutions ranging from temporary work visas (such as H-1B, L-1, and O categories) to permanent residency (such as EB-1A, EB-1C, EB-5, PERM, and NIW). **Event Time: October 3, 3:00 PM (US time)** **Event Location: Mari Bellevue (The Sky Club)** **10232 NE 10th St, Bellevue, WA 98004** **Parking: Park in the Mira Flat garage. From the intersection of 10th St and 103rd St, turn onto 103rd St and continue straight for about 100 meters; the garage entrance is on the left. Walk from there to MARI Phase II.** MARI The Sky Club **Event Sponsor: MARI Boutique School-District Residences**

items.title_en: Event Preview | Seminar on the Relationship Between US Property Title-Holding Methods and Family Wealth Succession
items.title_zh: 活动预告 | 美国房产产权持有方式与家庭财富传承的关系分享会
items.body_en:
Due to factors such as immigration policy, educational goals, investment returns, asset protection, and permanent ownership rights, a high proportion of Chinese individuals in the United States purchase homes to live in or rent out. Real estate has always been a major component of Chinese family wealth. However, because the US property title system and its related tax, transfer, gift, and inheritance rules differ significantly from those in China, the manner in which US property is held and disposed of can have a substantial effect on whether family wealth grows or shrinks. The organizer is therefore holding this seminar and has invited Attorney Cai Qing to explain these issues. **![](/assets/uploads/news/wechat-2024-07-18-1-1.webp)** **Speaker** **Attorney Cai Qing** **Cai & Cai Law Offices** Attorney Cai Qing is a licensed attorney in Washington State who provides services for clients' cross-border wealth succession matters; helps clients draft trusts, prenuptial agreements, wills, and financial powers of attorney; and assists clients with Washington State property title change documents and registration procedures. **Seminar Topics** 1. Comparison of property ownership methods in China and the United States 2. A detailed explanation of property title-holding methods in Washington State 3. Advantages and disadvantages of holding title as an individual, a married couple, a company, or a trust 4. How to qualify for exemptions from the real estate excise tax when changing property title in Washington State 5. Key considerations when buying, holding, selling, gifting, and inheriting property in Washington State 6. Title-holding considerations when parents provide funds for their children to purchase a home 7. Inheritance issues for Washington State residents holding property both in-state and out-of-state 8. The pros and cons of disposing of property through a will, a trust, a prenuptial agreement, or a transfer-on-death deed **How to Use Financing to Invest in US Real Estate in a High-Interest-Rate Environment?** **Steve Lo** **Business Relationship Manager, Pacific Northwest Region, East West Bank** Steve has worked in banking for over 20 years and is an accomplished international banker with a strong track record of driving outstanding revenue growth through careful relationship cultivation. He has extensive knowledge of asset-based lending, client management, international trade finance, and global correspondent banking. **Topics** • Bridge to Home Loan mortgage financing • Low down payment loans • Traditional fixed-rate loans • Flexible loan terms • Home equity loans • Competitive interest rates • Home purchases, refinancing, and cash-out refinancing **Event Time** Friday, August 2, 2024, 10:00 AM-12:00 PM **Event Location** 12509 Bel-Red Rd. #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 **Host** CCCWA - Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State **Co-Organizers** Seattle Real Estate Investors Club; AAIFPA - Asian American Insurance and Financial Professionals Association, Northwest Chapter

items.title_en: CCCWA Member Salon | "Spring Warmth in the Emerald City, Beauty in Togetherness" Women Entrepreneurs Gathering
items.title_zh: CCCWA会员沙龙 | “春暖翠城 美雅与共” 女企业家聚会
items.body_en:
On the afternoon of March 10 (Pacific Time, USA), the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) hosted a female entrepreneurs’ gathering titled "Spring Warmth in Emerald City, Harmony Among Elegant Ladies" at the rooftop clubhouse of The Emerald luxury apartment complex in Seattle.

This forum was co-hosted by Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA, and Ms. Michelle Zou (Yingyi Zou), Global Trainer & Talent Coach at Microsoft and certified international instructor of the HAS Happiness Research Institute.

▲ Left in photo: Ms. Lili Lü; Right in photo: Ms. Yingyi Zou

Ms. Yingyi Zou shared Dr. Shahar’s positive psychology theories of happiness and explained simple, actionable ways to integrate happiness practices into daily life. She also led a fun interactive icebreaker game to help attendees relax and connect quickly. She guided all participating female entrepreneurs to reflect on their entrepreneurial journeys and life experiences, fostering deeper mutual understanding among the group.

This event was sponsored and headlined by Nini Wu, a Private Bank Wealth Planning Advisor at Morgan Stanley. A CFA charterholder with over ten years of experience in wealth and asset management across China and the United States, she shared her insights on the current landscape and emerging trends of a wide range of investment vehicles, including real estate, public market equities, pre-IPO opportunities, and digital assets, alongside core investment philosophies.

Ms. Nini Wu 

took the floor as one of the speakers. Coco Zhu, a Washington-state licensed permanent makeup artist and makeup stylist, and Aimi Jiang, a beauty expert specializing in anti-aging medical aesthetics, also shared updates on the medical beauty industry plus practical anti-aging and skincare tips.

The female entrepreneurs in attendance showed tremendous interest in all discussion topics at the forum. They spoke freely and exchanged ideas covering business management, investment and wealth planning, balanced wellbeing, children’s education and many other subjects.

Following the forum, participants toured The Emerald, an oceanfront luxury apartment complex developed by Create World America Real Estate Management, a CCCWA member company, and took group photos together at the clubhouse.
items.body_zh:

邹英毅讲述沙哈尔博士的幸福学及如何将幸福的方法简单易行地运用到日常生活中，并用一个非常有趣的游戏方式使大家快速破冰，引导参会的女企业家回顾创业历程及生活感悟，相互加深了解。

现场与会女企业家们对此次座谈会交流的相关主题表现出了非常浓厚的兴趣，大家畅所欲言，交流了企业管理、投资理财、幸福生活、子女教育等多领域话题。会后，大家参观了会员单位拓宏美国房地产开发公司开发的美丽岸海景公寓，并在会所合影留念。

items.title_zh: 活动回顾|美国及全球金融和房地产市场最新解读与展望线上讲座
items.body_en:
Co-hosted by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) and East West Bank, this online webinar was held on November 10 (U.S. Pacific Time, November 11 Beijing Time) and concluded successfully. Dr. Chung-Hsin Hsu, Chief Economist of East West Bank, delivered an in-depth live presentation covering the current U.S. financial landscape, federal rate hikes, inflation trends, and the future trajectory of real estate markets.

Core Discussion Highlights

I. U.S. Macroeconomic Outlook

1. How Long Will the Federal Reserve Maintain High Interest Rates?

The U.S. will sustain elevated interest rates for an extended period. While headline inflation has fallen from 9% to 4%, the initial 9% peak inflation stemmed from two separate drivers: 3 percentage points triggered by the Russia-Ukraine war, which pushed up energy and food prices, and another 3 percentage points caused by restricted full-capacity production at Chinese factories late last year.

Therefore, the decline in inflation was not driven by rate hikes. Given sufficient time, inflation would have naturally cooled off on its own.

The U.S. is currently facing a structural labor shortage: unemployment stands at a historic low, while wage growth remains robust. Following three years of remote work during the pandemic, many Americans aged around 60 opted for early retirement. Meanwhile, younger workers increasingly favor gig work and are reluctant to return to traditional full-time employment.

No aggressive rate cuts are expected in 2024. Significant rate reductions will likely arrive after the inauguration of the new U.S. president in 2025. Donald Trump has a high chance of winning the presidency again, and substantial rate cuts under his administration will fuel bull runs in both the stock and real estate markets.

2. Duration of High Rates & Impacts on Real Estate and Equities

Investors should avoid excessive optimism and speculative buying in 2024, as the stock market may still test bottom levels. High interest rates are projected to persist for more than another year, with benchmark rates hovering between 5% and 5.5%. Long-duration bond yields present a viable investment option; betting on rate cuts carries excessive risks.

From a long-term perspective, the incoming administration will inevitably push interest rates lower. The U.S. government’s annual fiscal revenue is barely enough to cover interest payments on national debt, so the new president will have strong incentives to ease rates to sustain government spending. Rate cuts will trigger bull markets in stocks and real estate, yet sharp short-term volatility is unlikely, and investors should temper expectations for rapid rate reductions.

II. China’s Future Economic Development

Many economists warn that China’s economy may follow Japan’s path of stagnation, where a real estate bubble triggered three decades of economic decline. However, China’s elevated housing prices represent a social friction issue rather than a systemic economic crisis, and predictions of a “Japan-style lost decade” amount to conspiracy theories.

Chinese authorities have actively pushed forward deleveraging policies. Household mortgage leverage in China remains relatively low; excessive debt risks are concentrated among real estate developers. Regulators rolled out the Three Red Lines policy in two phases to transfer high-leverage, non-compliant developers to lower-debt peers, mitigating systemic risks and preventing a real estate meltdown抖音百科.

Cultural differences shape asset allocation preferences: Chinese households traditionally allocate wealth to residential real estate, Americans favor equities, and Indian investors prioritize gold. If Chinese authorities can redirect household savings from property to primary and secondary capital markets, it will greatly support China’s long-term economic growth.

China is currently experiencing low inflation. Although local government fiscal conditions face pressure, central government revenue remains robust. The central bank can deploy monetary easing via liquidity injections without stoking runaway inflation.

On the global stage, China aims to expand sovereign bond issuance to boost the international status of the Renminbi and advance RMB internationalization, positioning the currency as the world’s secondary reserve currency after the U.S. dollar. Successful global bond issuance will also lift the A-share market and broader domestic economic performance.

Live Q&A Session

Q: Is now a good time to bottom-fish U.S. real estate?

Dr. Hsu: Single-family homes have not been severely impacted by rate hikes and carry minimal selling pressure, making steep discounted purchases difficult. A repeat of the massive housing market crash seen in 2007–2008 is not anticipated.

Q: What economic impacts will the Israel-Palestine conflict bring globally?

Dr. Hsu: The most direct consequence is prolonged inflationary pressure. If the conflict draws Central European nations into the Middle East standoff, energy prices will surge sharply. Negatively, the crisis will sustain U.S. inflation; on the positive side, it may ease geopolitical tensions between China and the U.S.

Q: Is this an ideal window to invest in AI stocks?

Dr. Hsu: Current market valuations for AI are driven largely by speculative expectations rather than tangible commercial applications, and the technology will not fundamentally transform daily life in the short run. Similar to the early internet era, sustainable AI industry growth will arrive in the second and third development waves. AI will remain a dominant megatrend over the next 10–20 years, yet short-term investment risks are elevated as the industry is still far from full maturity.

Q: How should investors structure medium-to-long-term asset allocations amid the current global environment? What weightings should apply to developed versus emerging markets?

Dr. Hsu: Market cycles rotate between developed and emerging markets. Developed markets delivered outsized returns over the past decade, yet emerging markets are likely to outperform in the next ten years.

Emerging markets currently trade at historically low P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratios, underestimating their growth potential, while valuations in developed markets remain stretched. Cyclically, emerging markets hold greater upside potential.

Additionally, small and medium-sized resource-rich nations have experienced rapid economic expansion amid U.S.-China competition over the past five years, driving up commodity prices.

Q: What is the long-term outlook for U.S. real estate?

Dr. Hsu: 2024 will be dominated by market volatility. A new real estate bull cycle will likely emerge only after the new president takes office and implements fresh policies in 2025. For now, investors should prioritize school-district homes and properties aligned with personal living demand.

Q: Stock market forecast for 2024–2025

Dr. Hsu: Equities are expected to trade sideways with significant volatility throughout 2024. Investors should adopt a conservative buying strategy, as no sustained long-term bull catalysts are projected.

由CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会携手华美银行于美国时间11月10日（中国11月11日）举办的美国及全球金融和房地产市场最新解读与展望线上讲座活动圆满结束。本次活动由主讲人华美银行首席经济学家许仲翔博士带来了目前美国金融市场、政府加息、通货膨胀以及未来房地产走势等的精彩现场演讲。


 重点内容分享 

美国宏观经济的情况

1、美国升息会升多久

美国高利息水平会维持相对的久，虽然通货膨胀率从9%降至4%，但是之前9%的通货膨胀率里面的3%是俄乌战争造成的，从能源，粮食方面引发的通货膨胀，另外3%的原因是去年尾端，中国很多工厂不能全产能出货，导致的通货膨胀。

所以美国通货膨胀率的下降，并不是升息带来的影响，时间拉的够长，通货膨胀率会自然而然下降。

美国目前面临的是结构性劳动力衰退，失业率历史新低，工资薪酬高涨，疫情影响下，很多60岁左右的美国人，在居家工作3年之后直接选择退休，而年轻人更多选择打零工，不愿意重新返回传统的工作模式。

2024年预计不会有大幅降息的情况，可能要到2025年新任总统履职或者上任之后，川普有很大几率跳届之后再次当选，会大幅压低利率，带来股市和房地产的牛市行情。

2、高利率水平会维持多久，对房地产，对股市的影响

目前来看，不要对于2024年盲目乐观，不要盲目追高，股市仍旧有筑底的可能性。可能维持高利率还要1年多，5%-5.5%的利率，长债收入也是个不错的选择，不需要去赌降息，风险较大。

长期来看，新上任的总统必然会降低利率，如今美国每年的财政收入光偿还利息可能都会存在问题，新上任总统不会让自己没有钱花，利率下降，股市和房市肯定会带来一波牛市。但是短期来看，不会出现剧烈波动，大家对于降息不用期望过高。

中国经济未来发展

现在有很多经济学家担心中国经济走向日本化，日本房地产泡沫化带来日本30年的经济衰退，中国房地产的贵是个社会矛盾问题，并没有上升到社会经济问题，日本化的经济走向也是一种阴谋论。

政府一直非常积极的在去杠杆化，中国人本身购买房产的杠杆是很低的，杠杆主要集中在开发商，第一和第二时间政府发布三条红线把很多不合规，杠杆过高的房地产商转移给杠杆低的公司，降低不可控风险，降低房地产引爆的风险。

中国人喜欢存钱在房地产，美国人喜欢存钱在股票，印度人喜欢存钱在黄金，中国政府如果能够让大家不把钱存在房地产，而是把钱投到一级市场和二级市场，那么对中国长期发展是更有效的。

中国目前处于通胀水平低情况，虽然说地方财政不是特别好，但是中国中央财政收入较好，可以通过印钞票放水促进经济，而不会引起通膨的情况。

中国在国际上主要还是想发债，提高人民币在国际上的影响力，使人民币国际化，成为国际“第二美元”。中国发债成功，也将会促进A股股市和经济。

线上问答

Q：关于美国房产市场抄底？

许：美国Single Family并没有受到这次升息的影响，也没有售出压力，如果想要低价买入还是不太容易实现的，也不需要担心类似于07,08年房价大跌的情况出现。

Q：巴以战争对于世界经济有什么影响？

许：巴以战争带来最明显的影响是，它会让通货膨胀的压力持续，如果中东把整个中欧拉进来，对于能源的影响是显著的。从负面来讲，会延续美国的通货膨胀，从正面来讲，会缓和中美之间的关系。

Q：现在是一个很好的时间买AI吗？

许：AI市场预期的比重大于实际应用的比重，短期内并不会对生活有本质性改变，类似于Internet，往往崛起都是在第二波，第三波，AI绝对是未来10年，20年的趋势，但是短期来看风险性太高，距离产业真正成熟还有一定时间。

Q：在现在的全球环境下，如何思考资产中长期配置？发达市场和新兴市场的配置比例？

许：如果看大方向，发达市场和新兴市场是风水轮流转，在过去10年里面，发达市场占据主流，获利较高，后面10年，回到新兴市场的概率较高。

原因是市盈率（P/E）相对历史低点，低估了新兴市场的成长率，发达市场市盈率较高，根据市场的周期性来说新兴市场的潜力更大。

再者，在过去5年，中国和美国角力的过程中，很多拥有资源的中小国家发展很快，原物料的价格也哄抬上来。

Q：美国未来房地产趋势

许：2024年预计是振荡为主，还是需要等2025年新总统上台之后的新政策，才可能会有新一波房地产牛市，大家现在可以主要以学区房和自身需求为主。

Q：2024-2025年股票走势分析

许：2024年大概率是振荡，以比较保守的态度购买，预计不会有长期上涨的题材

items.title_en: Event Preview: Seminar on the Best Options for International Students to Stay in the U.S.!
items.title_zh: 活动预告：国际留学生最佳留美方案讲座！
items.body_en:
Time flies, and graduation season is drawing to a close. Have you mapped out your long-term U.S. residency plan in advance?

Co-hosted by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) and Law Offices of Xiaohe Cao, this online seminar will take place on September 1 (U.S. Pacific Time, September 2 Beijing Time). It is designed to provide comprehensive guidance and support for international students who intend to stay in the U.S. The session will analyze multiple legal pathways to U.S. permanent residency from various perspectives, helping attendees select the most suitable immigration route.

Seminar Agenda

1. NIW (National Interest Waiver)

Also known as the advanced skilled talent immigration category, NIW falls under the EB-2 employment-based immigrant visa subclass for professionals with advanced degrees or exceptional ability. Eligible applicants who meet EB-2 qualifications and satisfy the National Interest Waiver criteria may file immigrant petitions directly with USCIS. The application process is streamlined with typical adjudication timelines of several months. No U.S. employer sponsorship is required, and individuals may submit petitions independently.

2. EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program (New 2022 Act, No Visa Backlogs, Concurrent Filing)

The EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act signed by President Biden in March 2022 reserves 3,200 visa numbers annually for three categories of set-aside projects free of immigrant visa backlogs. Qualified applicants physically present in the U.S. may file Form I-526E (investor petition) and Form I-485 (adjustment of status application) concurrently. International students may directly apply for EB-5 set-aside projects. Upon receiving an Employment Authorization Document (EAD), holders are legally permitted to work without participating in the H-1B lottery. This resolves two major pain points for students seeking U.S. work authorization: fierce H-1B lottery competition and lengthy visa backlogs.

3. IEP (International Entrepreneur Program)

The International Entrepreneur Program enables foreign founders to launch businesses that generate new U.S. employment opportunities. Founders are initially granted a 30-month period of authorized stay and may work full-time for their own startup. Each qualifying new venture can sponsor 1–3 international student entrepreneurs for permanent resident status, with comparatively low thresholds for job creation and investment capital.

4. Startup Ventures Under OPT Status

F-1 visa students may launch their own businesses during their Optional Practical Training (OPT) term. They may operate and manage a startup provided they hold valid business licenses, conduct work closely related to their academic degree program, and fully comply with U.S. immigration regulations. This pathway involves numerous procedural details and compliance risks, requiring consultation with a licensed immigration attorney.

Additional Alternatives

Other viable immigration options will also be covered, including the O-1 visa for individuals with extraordinary ability.

Firm Introduction: Law Offices of Xiaohe Cao

Law Offices of Xiaohe Cao is a seasoned law firm specializing in U.S. immigration and commercial legal services.

Core Practice Areas

  1. Immigration Law: Investment immigration, extraordinary ability petitions, National Interest Waiver, skilled employment-based immigration, family-sponsored immigration, all temporary work visas, immigration appeals and litigation.
  2. Commercial Law: Retained corporate legal counsel, e-commerce consulting, business formation, equity transfer, real estate closing transactions.
  3. Cross-Border Litigation: Enforcement of Chinese civil judgments in U.S. courts.

In partnership with Seattle Business Center, the firm also offers remote cross-border video notarization, three-tier document authentication, and virtual office services for domestic and overseas clients.

Seminar Schedule

  • Pacific Time (Seattle, USA): 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM, September 1
  • Beijing Time (China): 8:30 AM – 10:00 AM, September 2

Online Attendance

Copy and paste the link into your browser to join the webinar; you may also log in via the Zoom mobile app using the meeting ID and passcode below: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85277056882?pwd=M2ZDRWpTckg3OWt3dXFkQ21xTWNuQT09 Zoom Meeting ID: 852 7705 6882 Zoom Passcode: 885175

In-Person Attendance

Limited spots available for on-site participation. Please call to reserve your seat in advance. Contact Phone: (425) 455-9898 Venue: Suite 918, U.S. Bank Building, 10800 NE 8th Street, Bellevue, WA 98004
items.body_zh:
时光飞逝，毕业季即将结束，是否已经提前做好留美规划。此次由CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会、曹霄鹤律师事务所于美国时间9月1日（北京时间9月2日）联合举办国际留学生最佳留美方案讲座。旨在为有意向留在美国的留学生提供帮助和支持，从不同角度分析一些留美方式，帮助选择更适合的留美方案。

活动内容预告：

NIW(国家利益豁免移民)

NIW国家利益豁免移民也称高级技术人才移民，申请人须符合EB-2（具有高等学位的专业人士/特殊能力专业人士）资格，并达到NIW（国家利益豁免）标准，可对移民局直接提出移民申请。审批流程简洁，通常数月即可获批，且不需要美国雇主担保，可自行申请。

EB-5（新法案、无排期、双递交）

2022年3月拜登总统签署的最新EB-5法案中，为三类“签证预留项目”预留3200个免排期名额。可以在美国境内同时递交I-526申请和I-485转换身份申请。国际留学生可直接申请预留项目的EB-5，在拿到EAD工卡后即可工作，无需H1B抽签，解决了留学生想通过H1B留美抽签难、等待排期长的问题。

IER(国际企业家特许项目)

IEP允许外籍创业者将商业理念创造更多的就业机会。创业者首次将获得30个月的居留期限，并有权为自己创业的公司工作。每个初创企业可以有1-3个国际留学生/企业家获得移民身份。对于创造的就业机会数量和投资金额要求不高。

Startup(OPT身份创业)

F-1留学生在OPT期间可自行创业，在能够证明自己拥有营业执照并从事与学生学位课程相关的业务和遵守移民法的情况下参与企业的创立经营。具体操作和注意事项较多，需咨询专业律师。

还有其他选择，例如O1等等。

曹霄鹤律师事务所简介

items.title_en: Event Recap: CCCWA and WSCRC Co-Host the 2020 Chinese Restaurant Industry Entrepreneurship Forum (Session 2)
items.title_zh: 活动回顾：CCCWA 和WSCRC联合主办2020 中餐业创业论坛 （第二期）
items.body_en:
On August 7, 2020, the second session of the 2020 Washington State Chinese Restaurant Industry Entrepreneurship Forum was successfully held. Forum guests engaged in in-depth discussion around the challenges and opportunities the pandemic has brought to the Chinese restaurant industry, covering topics such as urban planning and architectural design, real estate investment, consumer data analysis for food delivery companies, legal matters related to restaurant industry investment, and the actual operation of restaurant brands. **President of Studio 19 Architects** **Tian Hui** Architect Tian Hui shared her perspective on urban planning and architectural design, noting that as city zoning is upgraded, demand for restaurants in cities is also increasing; at the same time, the restaurant industry and commercial real estate have a mutually reinforcing, mutually beneficial relationship, and the growth of the restaurant industry is closely tied to urban development and expansion. **CEO of Great Earth Realty** **Larry Eu** Larry shared his experience and advice on trends in commercial real estate investment, how restaurant companies choose store locations for medium- to long-term development, and strategies restaurant companies can use as tenants when negotiating and signing store lease agreements. **General Manager, Seattle Region, Chowbus Inc.** **Michelle Lei** From the perspective of the food delivery company Chowbus, Michelle shared market insights gained by analyzing data on restaurants and consumer marketing and spending, noting that Chinese restaurants are steadily expanding their non-Asian customer base, and that brand recognition and food quality are key to increasing sales and broadening the customer base. **Seattle-Area Manager, LIUYISHOU HOT POT** **Jason Huang** Drawing on more than 30 years of experience managing restaurant businesses, Jason summarized the opportunities and challenges facing the Chinese restaurant industry amid the pandemic, and shared in detail his all-around experience in restaurant operations, product standardization, operating cost structure, service standard control, and key considerations for brand franchising. **Marketing Manager, Happy Lamb Hot Pot** **David Li** From the perspective of building a new restaurant brand, David shared the measures new brands took during the pandemic to balance government requirements with consumer demand, and analyzed in detail approaches to expanding the North American consumer market, brand marketing plans, high-quality product standardization control, and potential future directions for investment and expansion. **Cai & Associates** **Attorney Cai Qing** From a legal perspective, Attorney Cai Qing summarized and shared relevant experience on topics including restaurant franchise models, government review and approval processes, and restaurant lease agreements. The attending guests communicated with one another, shared their experience, and engaged in in-depth discussion on the future development of the restaurant industry. CCCWA hopes this forum provided restaurant businesses, investors interested in the restaurant industry, and industry professionals with an efficient, high-quality platform and opportunity for exchange, helping restaurant businesses make it through this difficult pandemic period and paving the way for a new wave of restaurant industry investment in the near future. The forum was hosted by Michelle Zou, founder of Pacific Consulting, and was attended by CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) President Ms. Lu Lili and WSCRC (Washington State China Relations Council) Vice President Wang Man, who spoke on behalf of the host organizations.

2020年8月7日，2020华州中餐业创业论坛第二期顺利举办，论坛嘉宾们围绕疫情给中餐业带来的挑战与机遇，从城市规划、建筑设计；地产投资；送餐企业的消费者数据分析；餐饮业投资法律相关事宜；以及餐饮品牌实际运营等多个角度，进行了深入的分享沟通。

**Studio 19 Architects 总裁**

**田晖** 

田晖建筑设计师从城市规划、建筑设计的角度分享了由于城市Zoning提升，城市对餐饮业的需求也在增加；同时餐饮业与商业地产拥有相辅相成互惠互利的关系，餐饮业的发展与城市的发展拓展紧密相关。

**Great Earth Realty CEO**

**Larry Eu** 

Larry 从商业地产投资趋势变化，餐饮业企业中长期发展店面位置选择，餐饮业企业作为租户在店面租赁合同的谈判与签署的策略等角度分享了经验与建议。

**Chowbus Inc.西雅图地区总经理**

**Michelle Lei** 

Michelle从Chowbus送餐企业的角度，分享了通过分析餐饮企业、消费者的营销及消费数据所得到的市场信息，提到了中餐业在稳步拓展非亚裔客户群体，品牌中餐知名度与餐品质量是提升销售额拓宽销售群体的重点。



**刘一手（LIUYISHOU HOT POT）西雅图负责人**

**Jason Huang** 

Jason从拥有30余年餐饮企业经营管理的角度，总结了中餐业在疫情环境下面临的机遇与挑战，详细分享了餐饮业企业经营、产品标准化、运营成本结构、服务标准管控、品牌加盟关键考察点等全方面的餐饮企业运营经验。

**快乐小羊（Happy Lamb Hot Pot）市场经理**

David从餐饮新品牌打造的角度，分享了疫情期间新品牌企业在应对政府要求与消费者需求之间的平衡措施，详细分析了北美消费者市场拓展方式、品牌营销方案、产品标准化高品质管控、以及未来潜在的投资与拓展方向。

蔡清律师从法律角度，从餐饮企业加盟模式、政府相关审核批准流程、餐饮业店面租赁合同等多方面，总结并分享了相关经验经历。

与会嘉宾们相互沟通、经验共享、共同对餐饮业未来的发展进行了深入的探讨与交流。CCCWA希望此次论坛，对各餐饮企业、对餐饮业感兴趣的投资人、以及对相关产业从业者，提供了高效高质量的交流共享平台及机会，帮助各餐饮企业顺利度过艰苦的疫情期，并能在不久的将来带来餐饮业投资的新热潮。

items.title_en: Event Recap: CCCWA and Bellevue Police Department Co-Host Successful Safety Seminar
items.title_zh: 活动回顾：CCCWA与贝尔维尤市警察局联合主办的安全讲座成功落幕
items.body_en:
On May 31, 2022, CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) and the Bellevue Police Department successfully co-hosted a safety seminar. The Bellevue Police Department sent a strong lineup of nine officers and safety experts to take part in the event, answering more than thirty safety questions from the audience covering everyday work and life topics such as how to use weapons, how to improve self-defense skills, how to call the police quickly and effectively, and how to identify fake police officers, **with particular focus on the crime-prevention measures business owners can take on a regular basis, what to do if a store is robbed, and crime-prevention measures for office buildings, apartment buildings, and the surrounding areas — safety issues of particular concern to business professionals.** The turnout was large, and the audience engaged enthusiastically, creating a lively atmosphere. Live view of the safety seminar This seminar's agenda was tightly packed, and the questions discussed were all closely tied to everyday life and work; the officers' and safety experts' answers were highly practical and were widely praised. **When the final question — "If there were a school shooting, what would Bellevue police do?" — was asked, Assistant Chief Popochock answered, "The police will absolutely run into the school and let the bullets hit us instead of the children."** The audience was deeply moved, and many left comments thanking the officers for protecting community safety and for delivering such a practical seminar. After the event, many attendees felt that it was not only very helpful to the audience but also helped build strong ties and trust between police and the community, making them feel safer living or working in Bellevue and prouder of our city. Police Chief Wendell Shirley attended the event and gave opening remarks, and the event was hosted by PIO Meeghan Black. Host: PIO Meeghan Black Assistant Chief Andrew Popochock Captain David Sanabria Major Debbie Christopherson Safety Expert Ruby Daly CCCWA's current president, Ms. Lu Lili, expressed the Chamber's deep gratitude on behalf of the organization for the strong lineup sent by the Bellevue Police Department, and also gave special thanks to co-organizing partners including Seattle Immigrant Home, the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, the Seattle Entrepreneurs Association, and the Sunshine Youth Education Development Foundation.

2022年5月31日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会与贝尔维尤市警察局（BellevuePoliceDepartment）联合主办的安全讲座成功举办。

贝尔维尤市警察局派出9位警员和安全专家的强大阵容参与这次活动，就听众提出的如何使用武器、如何提高自卫能力、如何快速有效地报警、如何识别假警察等日常工作和生活中的三十多个安全问题进行了解答， **重点讲解了企业主可以定期采取的预防犯罪措施、店铺遇到抢劫怎么办、办公楼、公寓楼及周边地区的预防犯罪措施等等商务人员关注的安全问题**。现场听众较多，大家积极互动，气氛热烈。

安全讲座线上现场

本次讲座活动议程紧凑，讨论的问题都和日常的生活工作息息相关，警员和安全专家们回答的也特别具有可操作性，获得了广泛好评。**当最后一个问题“如果发生校园枪击案，Bellevue的警察会怎么办？”Assistant Chief Popochock回答“警察一定会冲进学校，让子弹射在我们身上，而不是射到孩子们身上”**，听众们深受感动，纷纷留言感谢保卫社区安全的警员们，也感激他们带来这么实用的讲座。会后多位参加者认为此次活动不仅对听众非常有帮助，而且对警民之间建立良好的联系和信任有很好的帮助作用，对在Bellevue居住或工作感觉更安全，为我们的城市感到更自豪。

警察局长Wendell Shirley出席活动并做开场讲话，活动的主持人由PIO Meeghan Black担任。

items.title_en: Event Recap | Your Voice Matters! Join the Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan Online Community Meeting!
items.title_zh: 活动回顾 | 您的意见至关重要！参与Bellevue2044 综合规划市民线上见面会！
items.body_en:
The City of Bellevue is holding a Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan community meeting specifically for members of the Chinese community, and warmly invites all Bellevue stakeholders to attend. Staff from relevant City of Bellevue departments and city councilmembers will attend this meeting to speak with you directly. At the meeting, you will also have the opportunity to fill out a related survey and share your views on housing issues in Bellevue. Topic: City of Bellevue Bellevue 2044 Information Session for Members of the Chinese Community Time: Thursday, March 9, 6:00-7:30 PM Format: Online via Zoom Registration link: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bellevue-2044-planning-for-the-future--tickets-557302927057 (copy the link and open it in your browser) **What Is the Comprehensive Plan** The Comprehensive Plan is an important tool used by the City Council, boards and commissions, and city staff to make key decisions on housing, transportation, parks, public services, the economy, and more. Such planning happens only once every 7-10 years, so for yourself and for the next generation to enjoy a safe, convenient, and healthy environment to live and work in over the next 10-20 years, your participation and input are essential! This plan is a core document that outlines the city's vision for the future and charts the course for achieving it. It is used by the City Council, boards and commissions, and city staff to make important decisions on housing, transportation, parks, and more. The city is updating its Comprehensive Plan for the sake of the high quality of life that people enjoy in Bellevue. **The goals and policies set out in the plan help ensure that people have access to:** o A range of housing options affordable across different income levels. o A variety of recreational opportunities. o Access to parks' natural resources and green spaces. o Access to jobs and economic development opportunities. o The ability to safely and conveniently drive, bike, walk, and use public transportation. o Clean air, clean water, and a healthy environment. o Other issues. **Your Input Matters** We all know that building the Chinese community requires everyone's active participation, and the Bellevue 2044 Comprehensive Plan community meeting is a meaningful event held specifically for the Chinese community — your suggestions and needs will be heard directly by City of Bellevue staff and city councilmembers. For yourself and for every member of the Chinese community in Bellevue, we all have a responsibility to actively take part in this event and work together to create a safe and happy Chinese community.

Bellevue市政府专为华人社区成员举行 Bellevue 2044 综合规划市民见面会，诚邀所有Bellevue利益相关者参加。

Bellevue市相关部门的工作人员以及市议员会参加本次见面会，直接与您对话。在这次见面会，您还将有机会填写相关的调查问卷，表达您对Bellevue住房问题的看法。

主题：Bellevue市政府华人社区成员举行 Bellevue 2044 信息会议

时间：3 月 9 日（周四），晚上 6:00-7:30

形式：Zoom线上会议

注册链接：https://www.eventbrite.com/e/bellevue-2044-planning-for-the-future--tickets-557302927057（复制链接在浏览器打开）

**什么是综合规划** 

综合规划是一个重要工具，供市议会、理事会和委员会以及市政府工作人员使用，以做出住房、交通、公园、公众服务、经济等方面的重要决策。这样的规划每7-10年才进行一次，为了自己以及年轻一代未来10-20年有一个安全、便捷、健康的生活、工作环境，您的参与和意见至关重要！此计划是一份核心文件，概述了未来的愿景，并为实现愿景指明方向。文件供市议会、理事会和委员会以及市政府工作人员使用，以做出住房、交通、公园等方面的重要决策。市政府要更新其综合计划(Comprehensive Plan) 的宗旨是为了人们在 Bellevue 享有的高品质生活。 **计划中明确的目标和政策可确保人们获得：** o 不同收入层级皆可负担得起的各种住房方案。 o 各种娱乐机会。 o 使用公园自然资源和绿色空间。 o 获得工作和经济发展机会。 o能够安全方便地开车、骑自行车、步行及乘坐公共交通工具。 o 获得清洁的空气、水和良好的环境。 o 其他问题。

**您的意见至关重要** 

我们都知道华人社区的建设需要每个人的积极参与，Bellevue 2044综合规划市民见面会正是一个面向华人举办的意义非凡的活动，您的建议和需求都将被Bellevue市相关部门的工作人员以及市议员直接听到。为了您和Bellevue的每位华人，我们都有责任积极参与这次的活动，为创造一个安全、幸福的华人社区共同努力。
