items.title_en: Event Announcement: "Immunity and Health" Special Wellness Salon
items.title_zh: 活动预告：“免疫力与健康”专场健康沙龙
items.body_en:
Professor Liu Jie (**a leading figure in the field of immunotherapy for cancer prevention and treatment, a "National-Level" honoree of the New Century Talents Project, a recipient of the State Council's Special Government Allowance, and a Chang Jiang Scholar Distinguished Professor**) delivered a public welfare lecture in Seattle as early as 2018 titled **"Early Diagnosis and Precision Treatment of Cancer Based on Big Data and Artificial Intelligence."** In that lecture, he also discussed **simple, practical ways to boost immunity, prevent cancer, and improve overall bodily function and health in daily life.** Many attendees - especially busy business professionals under heavy work pressure - reported that they benefited greatly from the lecture, and many went on to pass these health principles along to those around them, with many people benefiting as a result of that public lecture. By popular request, the Chamber is once again inviting Professor Liu Jie to deliver an outstanding lecture titled **"Immunity and Health Special Wellness Salon"** on **May 9 (Beijing time)**. In addition to **presenting the latest research and clinical advances in precision cancer treatment**, this lecture will also include **targeted content on effective ways to boost immunity after recovering from COVID-19**. This event will be held both online and in person; please reserve your seat in advance. **About the Speaker** Professor Liu Jie Liu Jie holds an M.D., is a professor, chief physician, and doctoral supervisor, and heads the National Innovative Research Group for New Strategies in Immunotherapy. He is a Chang Jiang Scholar Distinguished Professor and a recipient of the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars; a "National-Level" honoree under the Organization Department's New Century Talents Project; a recipient of the State Council's Special Government Allowance; Director of the Institute of Immune Phenotyping at the Shanghai International Human Phenome Institute; Professor of Immunology at Fudan University, as well as Professor at its Institute of Metabolism and Department of Genetics; Director of the Institute of Digestive Diseases at Fudan University and Director of the Department of Gastroenterology at Huashan Hospital, its affiliated hospital; Director of the Shanghai Center for Intelligent Oncology Drug Engineering Research; Head of the Shanghai Double First-Class Immunology Interdisciplinary Innovation Research Institute; Leader of a Shanghai High-Level University Innovation Strategy Team; an Outstanding Academic Leader in Shanghai; and a Shanghai Leading Talent. His research focuses on immune recovery and reconstruction strategies, and comprehensive disease diagnosis and treatment based on immune homeostasis. He has established a system for assessing and intervening in immune aging and biological age; created a new non-invasive diagnostic method (liquid biopsy) based on epigenetic modification; and developed a PDX-based approach for selecting precision cancer treatment plans and a comprehensive immune reconstruction strategy for cancer, achieving strong clinical results. He has built a fourth-generation secretory CAR-T therapy targeting solid tumors, achieving a breakthrough in CAR-T immunotherapy for solid tumors, and has conducted AI-based research into personalized neoantigen cancer vaccines. His clinical case study published in Nature Reviews Clinical Oncology has been adopted as continuing medical education (CME) material for U.S. clinicians. He has led numerous national key research projects and has published more than 150 SCI papers, including in journals such as Cell and Nature sub-journals. He has received the National Science and Technology Progress Award (First Class) and other honors, and serves as an international editorial board member for GUT, an editorial board member for the British Journal of Pharmacology, and Deputy Editor-in-Chief of Nutrition & Metabolism. He holds the title of Chang Jiang Scholar and serves as an expert reviewer for national science and technology awards and national fund projects. **Event Time** May 9, 2023, 9:30 AM Beijing time (6:30 PM Seattle time, May 8) **In-Person Venue** Feiyin Biotech: Academic Exchange Hall, 22nd Floor, Building 2, Future Entrepreneurship Plaza, No. 3 Gangxing Road, High-Tech Zone, Jinan, Shandong Province **Ways to Join Online** 1. Press and hold the QR code on WeChat to register. 2. Open Tencent Meeting on your phone and enter Meeting ID: 946-349-819 to register. 3. Copy the link and open it in your browser: https://meeting.tencent.com/dw/8xymG8KGP5MI **Organizers** **CCCWA - China Chamber of Commerce of Washington State** **Feiyin Biotechnology Co., Ltd.** **New Home (USA) Real Estate Development Management Co.** **Co-Organizers** **Shandong Shenghan International Hospital** **Jinan Quanmei Yangguang Catering Group**

刘杰教授（ **免疫疗法预防及治疗肿瘤领域的领军人物、新世纪百千万人才工程“国家级”人选、国务院“特殊政府津贴”获得者、长江学者特聘教授**）早在2018年就在西雅图做过题为 **“基于大数据和人工智能的肿瘤早期诊断及精准治疗”的公益演讲**，演讲中，还讲述了在日常生活 **中如何通过简单易行的方式增强免疫力，预防癌症，增强身体机能和健康**。

众多听众，尤其是工作压力大、工作繁忙的商务人士在讲座后反馈受益匪浅，后续大家又把这些健康理念传递给身边的人，很多人因那场公益讲座而受益。

应大家要求，商会再次邀请刘杰教授在 **北京时间5月9日** 带来精彩的“ **免疫力与健康专场健康沙龙** ”讲座，除了 **介绍癌症精准治疗的最新科研及临床进展** 、此次讲座还会有 **针对性地增加关于感染新冠康复后有效提高免疫力的方式** 等内容，此次活动为线上线下同时进行，请提前预约座位。

**主讲人介绍** 

刘杰，医学博士，教授，主任医师，博士生导师，国家免疫治疗新策略“创新研究群体”负责人，国家“长江学者”特聘教授，及“杰出青年基金”获得者；中组部百千万人才工程“国家级”人选；国务院特殊政府津贴获得者；上海国际人类表型组研究院免疫表型研究所所长，复旦大学免疫学系教授，及代谢研究院和遗传学系教授，复旦大学消化病研究所所长，附属华山医院消化科主任；上海智能肿瘤药物工程研究中心主任；上海双一流免疫交叉科学创新研究院负责人；上海高水平高等院校创新战略团队负责人；上海市优秀学科带头人；上海市领军人才。研究方向为免疫康复及重建策略；基于免疫稳态的疾病综合诊疗。建立了免疫衰老及生物年龄评估及干预体系；创立了基于表观基因修饰的无创诊断（液体活检）新方法；开展了基于PDX的肿瘤精准治疗方案选择及肿瘤的综合免疫重建策略，取得较佳疗效；构建了第四代针对实体瘤的新型分泌型CART，使实体瘤的CART免疫治疗获得突破。开展了基于人工智能的肿瘤个体化新抗原疫苗研究。在Nature临床实践肿瘤发表的临床病例研究被推举为美国临床医师继续医学教育教材（CME）。承担多项国家级重点项目，先后发表SCI论文150余篇，包括Cell，Nature 子刊等，获国家科技进步一等奖等奖项，为GUT国际编委，British Journal of Pharmacology编委，Nutrition& Metabolism 副主编。担任长江学者，国家科技奖及国家基金项目评审专家等。 ‍

2023年3月20日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会举办了线下金融讲座，由商会理事单位工银美国对近期热点金融事件及政策进行分析，并讲解了账户服务方案。

items.title_en: Grateful for the Journey, Together Toward the Future | CCCWA Members Attend Private Preview of MARI Apartments Phase II Ahead of Its Launch
items.title_zh: 感恩同行，共鉴未来|CCCWA商会会员莅临美丽都公寓二期（MARI）开盘前内部品鉴会
items.body_en:
On the afternoon of April 18, 2023, CCCWA held a pre-launch gathering for board member company TOP International USA's MARI Apartments Phase II, a boutique development in Bellevue's Meilidu school-district community, with numerous members in attendance. The event was held at the MARI sales office, where guests toured the model units and heard remarks from project General Manager Yicheng Yang and Ming Zhang, President of architecture firm MZA, introducing the project. The development is located in the core of downtown Bellevue, within a top-ranked school district, with views of Mount Rainier and Lake Washington. It features well-proportioned floor plans and a full suite of amenities including a clubhouse and fitness center, with interior finishes carefully selected from around the world. **Holly Yang, a commercial real estate broker with member company Kidder Mathews, warmly congratulated MARI on its upcoming launch.** As a partner in TOP International USA's land acquisition process, she was involved throughout the acquisition of the site, and has watched TOP International USA grow into a truly local company since arriving in Seattle in 2014 - having managed five projects and successfully completed construction of three high-end apartment buildings. She expressed great happiness and pride at this achievement. **Ms. Yan of the City of Bellevue Planning Department also shared some stories from MARI's permitting process, expressing her pleasure that the project is nearing completion and heading to market, and thanking TOP International USA for its contributions to economic development and job creation in Bellevue.** **Current Chamber President Lyu Lili, who also previously served as General Manager of TOP International USA's development management company, shared some stories from the land acquisition and early stages of the project, and expressed special thanks to member companies such as MZA for their support. She noted that this project stands as a model of successful collaboration among Chamber members, and spoke highly of the project shareholders' sense of responsibility and commitment.** Attending guests offered their congratulations, delighted to witness this important milestone for the Meilidu project, and looked forward to seeing more Chamber members forge partnerships through the Chamber's platform and achieve even broader business success together.

items.title_en: Can a U.S. Asset Protection Trust Help Shield Your Assets?
items.title_zh: 美国资产保护信托能帮助资产隔离吗？
items.body_en:
**Can a U.S. asset protection trust help shield your assets?** **Lessons from the failed asset-shielding case involving Zhang Lan's family trust - how to ensure the assets in your U.S. trust are secure.** The recent case in which **Zhang Lan's family trust was "pierced," which trended on social media, drew intense attention from the Chinese community in the U.S.** Many members who have already established, or are planning to establish, a family trust have expressed interest in learning whether assets placed in a U.S. trust can actually achieve effective asset segregation. On March 31, 2023, CCCWA held an information session, inviting attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Associates, P.C. to share his experience handling clients' cross-border assets and using U.S. trusts to protect and segregate assets. **Attorney Cai Qing shared numerous case studies to clearly explain the following topics:** 1. Common methods of asset protection in the U.S. 2. Whether a conventional trust can protect trust assets 3. An overview of U.S. law on asset protection trusts 4. The current state of asset protection law in Washington State 5. The requirements, restrictions, and exceptions involved in setting up a U.S. asset protection trust for asset segregation 6. The relationships among the settlor, trustee, beneficiary, investment advisor, and protector of a U.S. asset protection trust 7. Key tax considerations when establishing a U.S. asset protection trust This event was held both online and in person, with a lively atmosphere as attendees actively engaged, asked questions, shared their own experiences, and joined in discussion. Afterward, everyone expressed heartfelt thanks to attorney Cai for his outstanding and generous presentation.

items.title_en: How to Safeguard Your Assets? - CCCWA Financial Seminar
items.title_zh: 如何保障资金安全？——CCCWA金融讲座
items.body_en:
In March 2023, multiple financial institutions collapsed: Silicon Valley Bank of the United States entered liquidation, while Signature Bank was shut down over "systemic risks". The crisis kept spreading, and on March 19, UBS Group, Switzerland’s largest bank, announced its acquisition of the crisis-stricken Credit Suisse.

Against the backdrop of such volatile global financial conditions, how can investors safeguard their capital?

On March 20, 2023, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) hosted an offline financial seminar. ICBC USA, a council member entity of the Chamber, delivered an analysis of recent hot-button financial events and relevant policies, alongside an introduction to account service solutions.

The seminar reviewed the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, dissecting its root causes and spillover impacts on the global economy. From the perspective of capital safety protection, it elaborated on Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) coverage, insurance limits, and key criteria for bank selection.

The seminar also outlined the core strengths of ICBC USA: it holds an A- credit rating from S&P Global Ratings, and maintains a local professional team of 300 staff offering bilingual Chinese-English customer support. Its deposit interest rates are highly competitive compared with major U.S. domestic banks, featuring an annual percentage yield (APY) of 3.5% on personal demand deposits and up to 3.7% APY on business demand deposits. Rigorous risk management protocols are implemented to secure clients’ funds and deliver stable financial services.

ICBC USA provides a wide array of exclusive specialized services, detailed as follows:

  • Cross-border Inward Remittance for Business Accounts via ICBC China-U.S. Express Remittance: Zero transaction fees.
  • Corporate Cash Management Services: Support remote check deposits and streamlined small-value payments.
  • Personal Credit Cards: Applications available without a U.S. Social Security Number (SSN); domestic Chinese credit records are accepted; dual-channel access covering VISA and UnionPay networks.
  • Personal Mortgage Loans: Applications accessible without an SSN; domestic Chinese credit histories, payroll statements and financial asset documents are recognized. Maximum loan-to-value ratio stands at 70%, with a loan cap of USD 3.5 million.
  • Student Checking Accounts for International Students: Accounts can be opened prior to arrival in the U.S., enabling direct fund transfers and tuition/fee payments.

  • Overview of the WW5 Grant Program
  • Eligibility criteria and permitted uses of grant funds
  • How to obtain a Unique Entity ID (UEI), the federal business identification system launched in April 2022
  • Required financial documents and other application prerequisites

items.title_en: Chinese Americans Should Stay Alert to Telecom and Online Fraud
items.title_zh: 在美华人需谨慎防范电信网络诈骗
items.body_en:
Typical Case 1: Fake Law Enforcement Officers at Your Door

In May 2021, an elderly woman K residing in the San Francisco Bay Area received a phone call from someone claiming to be a Chinese police officer. The caller alleged she was involved in a crime committed in China and demanded that she transfer all her savings to an account designated by the police for security verification. The caller also threatened to notify U.S. law enforcement to take enforcement action against her.

A few days later, several individuals claiming to be U.S. police officers showed up at Ms. K’s residence to "process the case". They guided her on-site to transfer approximately $200,000 — her life savings — to the so-called secure account, and confiscated her passport, green card and Social Security (SSN) card. It was only after her family alerted her that Ms. K realized she had fallen victim to a scam. By then, the fake "police officers" could no longer be reached, and the receiving bank informed her that the funds had quickly been transferred overseas by the criminals.

Fraud Prevention Reminders

Scammers commonly fabricate criminal charges against victims to instill fear. If you abide by the law, never believe allegations that you are implicated in a case you have absolutely no connection with. U.S. law enforcement follows formal legal procedures for arrests and deportations. Do not trust anyone over the phone claiming to be an official, regardless of their excuses or intimidation tactics. Never believe threats of arrest or deportation made via phone calls, and do not panic as a result. Most importantly, never rush to transfer money under pressure without first consulting family or friends.

Typical Case 2: "Hello, We Have a Parcel for You"

In August 2021, Ms. L, a Bay Area resident, received a call from an individual posing as a DHL customer service representative. The caller claimed a parcel shipped from China to her contained 24 undeclared Chinese passports, which violated relevant laws. The scammer accurately recited Ms. L’s address and full name, provided unfamiliar sender information, and offered to transfer her call to a local Chinese police station to file a report.

Though Ms. L remained alert and hung up immediately, the fake customer service staff continued calling her for days, emphasizing the severity of the alleged violation and warning that she would face legal liability. This is a classic telecom fraud tactic. The best course of action is to ignore and decline all such suspicious calls.

Fraud Prevention Reminders

Recently, an increasing number of Chinese citizens have reported scams where fraudsters impersonate couriers such as DHL and FedEx, falsely claiming their parcels have issues. Scammers fabricate criminal accusations to intimidate victims. Law enforcement authorities in China never conduct investigations via the internet, phone calls, chat apps, fax or other remote channels. They will never send legal documents including wanted notices, detention warrants or arrest warrants to suspects through private online communication. If you comply with all laws and regulations, dismiss any claims that you are tied to an unrelated criminal case.
items.body_zh:
典型案例一：来的不是客


2021年5月，在旧金山湾区居住的一位老年女士K，接自称中国警方电话表示，她涉嫌在中国犯罪，必须把名下所有存款转至警方指定账户进行安全验证。来电者还称将通报美国警方进行执法。几日后，数位自称美国警方的人来到K的住所进行“办案”，现场指导K女士把约20万美元毕生积蓄转至所谓安全账户，并收走K女士护照、绿卡、SSN卡。直到K女士在家人提醒下发觉遭遇诈骗后，已无法联系到所谓“警方”，联系收款银行被告知该款项已很快被犯罪分子跨境转出。




防范提醒


诈骗分子的常用套路是编造你涉嫌犯罪的故事情节，给你造成心理恐惧。只要你遵纪守法，就不要听信任何你从未有任何涉入可能的“案件”。美国执法部门对当事人进行拘捕、遣返有既定程序，不要轻信电话中任何人声称的“官方背景”，无论对方以何种理由，向你施加何种压力，不要相信任何通过电话声称要对你进行拘捕、遣返的说法，更不要因此惊慌失措。尤其是不要在未与亲友进行充分沟通商量的情况下，迫于压力而匆忙决定汇款。



典型案例二：您好！有您的快递


2021年8月，在旧金山湾区居住的L女士，她接到自称DHL公司的客服电话，称她名下有一个从中国来美国的异常包裹，内有24本未申报的中国护照，违反了有关法律。来电人详细说出了L女士的地址和姓名等信息，提供了陌生的“寄件人”信息，并称可以帮L女士转接电话至中国当地派出所报警。C女士十分警觉，挂掉电话，但“客服人员”连续多日不停地致电，表示情况十分严重，L女士需承担法律后果。此系典型电信诈骗，最好的做法就是不信、不接听有关来电。




防范提醒


近来，中国公民关于遭遇诈骗集团假冒DHL、FedEx快递公司以包裹异常等理由行骗的现象不断增加。诈骗分子的常用套路是编造你涉嫌犯罪的故事情节，给你造成心理恐惧。中国执法部门也绝对不会通过网络、电话、聊天工具、传真等形式办案，不会通过这些渠道点对点地给违法犯罪当事人发送通缉令、拘留证、逮捕证等法律文书。只要你遵纪守法，就不要听信任何你从未有任何涉入可能的“案件”。

items.title_en: Washington State Chinese American Real Estate Developers Industry Salon Successfully Held
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州房地产开发商行业分析沙龙活动成功举办
items.body_en:
On September 8, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) resumed in-person events with a successful industry analysis salon for Chinese-American real estate developers operating in Washington State.

Since Washington State issued stay-at-home orders in March 2020, all CCCWA gatherings had been held virtually. This marked the chamber’s first offline event following the pandemic. Attendance was capped at 15 guests, and the salon was hosted at the scenic Bellevue Botanical Garden.

More than ten Chinese-American real estate development firms active across Washington State joined the gathering. Participants shared updates on their respective projects throughout the pandemic, shifts in financial markets and land transaction landscapes, as well as granular lessons learned regarding financing, planning permit approvals, construction costs, project timelines, and post-completion tax abatement policies encountered during real estate development.

Attendees engaged in lively exchanges, comparing the similarities and differences between the real estate markets of the Greater Seattle Area and the United States as a whole, as well as divergent trends in suburban versus urban markets within Greater Seattle. They also discussed market shifts across various asset classes including industrial real estate, hotels, office buildings, rental apartments, and for-sale condominiums.

Driven by abundant market liquidity and historically low interest rates nationwide, the U.S. real estate market enjoyed robust performance. Starting in late spring of that year, the Greater Seattle Area saw a rapid recovery in commercial real estate, paired with vigorous land trading activity. Performance across most property types rebounded to pre-pandemic levels and even hit new highs. From a long-term perspective, participants maintained an overwhelmingly optimistic outlook on Greater Seattle’s real estate prospects.

This event was co-hosted by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) and the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, with MZA Architects and Kidder Mathews, a commercial real estate brokerage firm, serving as co-organizers.
items.body_zh:
9月8日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会重启线下聚会活动，成功举办了华盛顿州华裔地产开发商行业分析沙龙。自2020年3月华州颁发居家令以来，CCCWA的聚会活动都是线上聚会形式，这是疫情后的第一次线下聚会，这次聚会总人数控制在15人，地点选在了风景优美的贝尔维尤植物园。


超过10家活跃在华盛顿州的华裔房地产开发公司参加了聚会，大家分享了疫情期间各自的项目进展情况，金融市场、土地交易市场的变化，以及在具体开发过程中融资、规划审批、建造成本、工期、建成后税收减免政策等方面一些细节性的经验和教训。

大家热烈互动，讨论比较了大西雅图地区和全美国房地产市场的异同、大西雅图地区郊区市场和市区市场的不同变化，工业地产、酒店、办公楼、出租型公寓、销售型公寓等多种业态的市场变化。


在当前市场流动性充裕、利率水平较低的情况下，全美房地产市场走势良好。今年春末开始，大西雅图地区商业地产复苏速度很快，土地市场交易活跃，多种业态的地产恢复到疫情前的水平甚至再创新高。从长期来看，大家对大西雅图地区的房地产市场仍然非常看好。


本次活动由CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会和西雅图地产投资俱乐部联合主办，由MZA建筑设计事务所和基德（Kidder Mathews）商业地产经纪公司协办。

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Unites Community Against COVID-19
items.title_zh: 华州中华总商会基金会团结社区共抗新冠疫情
items.summary_en: CCCWA Foundation coordinated with local businesses and volunteers across Greater Seattle to support communities affected by COVID-19.
items.summary_zh: CCCWA与西雅图地区各个企业和志愿者协调配合，支持受COVID-19影响的社区。
items.body_en:
When COVID-19 swept through Washington State in early 2020, the Chinese-American community faced unique challenges — stigma, language barriers, economic hardship, and uncertainty. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) mobilized quickly, coordinating a wide-ranging community relief effort through its foundation arm.

Working alongside local businesses, volunteers, and community partners across Greater Seattle, CCCWA helped organize and fund multiple parallel initiatives designed to address the most urgent needs of its members and the broader community.

## Food with Love (爱心午餐)

One of CCCWA's most visible relief programs was "Food with Love" (爱心午餐) — a charity meal initiative that organized Chinese restaurants to prepare and deliver hundreds of free meals daily to frontline workers at local hospitals, police stations, and fire departments. The program served a dual purpose: supporting healthcare and public safety workers during an exhausting crisis, and keeping Chinese-owned restaurants operating at a time when dining rooms were closed and revenue had collapsed.

Volunteer drivers, coordinated through CCCWA's network, picked up prepared meals from participating restaurants each day and delivered them across Seattle, Bellevue, and surrounding areas. Among the participating restaurants was Chowbus, whose delivery team became a regular presence at hospital entrances, becoming emblematic of the community's spirit of care and generosity.

## Fundraising and Community Outreach

CCCWA launched a fundraising campaign to sustain the Food with Love initiative and provide emergency financial support to member businesses and families in need. The campaign received support from community donors across Washington State and beyond, reflecting the deep ties within the Chinese-American business community.

At the same time, CCCWA worked to combat misinformation and provide accurate public health information to Chinese-language audiences, partnering with healthcare professionals and government agencies to produce bilingual content on COVID prevention, testing, and available resources.

## Media Recognition

The scale and impact of CCCWA's COVID relief efforts drew widespread attention. KIRO 7 News covered the "Food with Love" initiative in a multi-part series, introducing Seattle viewers to the restaurants and volunteers at the heart of the program and highlighting the Chinese-American community's contribution to the city's pandemic response.

CCCWA's relief work during COVID-19 became a defining moment for the organization, demonstrating its capacity to mobilize quickly, serve a broad constituency, and forge lasting partnerships with government, media, and the broader Seattle business community.
items.body_zh:
2020年初，新冠疫情席卷华盛顿州，华裔美国人社区面临着独特的挑战——污名化、语言障碍、经济困难和不确定性。华州中华总商会（CCCWA）迅速行动，通过其基金会部门协调开展了一场覆盖面广泛的社区救助行动。

华州中华总商会与大西雅图地区的本地企业、志愿者及社区合作伙伴携手，协助组织并资助了多项并行开展的行动计划，以应对会员及广大社区最迫切的需求。

## 爱心午餐（Food with Love）

华州中华总商会最具影响力的救助项目之一便是“爱心午餐”（Food with Love）——这是一项慈善送餐行动，组织多家中餐馆每日为本地医院、警察局和消防局的一线工作人员准备并配送数百份免费餐食。该项目具有双重意义：一方面在这场令人身心俱疲的危机中支持医护及公共安全工作者，另一方面在堂食停摆、营收锐减之际，帮助华人餐馆维持运营。

通过华州中华总商会网络协调的志愿者司机每天从参与餐馆取餐，配送至西雅图、贝尔维尤及周边地区。参与该项目的餐馆之一便是Chowbus，其配送团队频繁出现在各医院门口，成为社区关爱与慷慨精神的象征。

## 募捐与社区宣传

华州中华总商会发起了一项募捐活动，以维持“爱心午餐”项目的持续运作，并为有需要的会员企业和家庭提供紧急资金支持。该活动得到了来自华盛顿州乃至更广泛地区社区捐助者的支持，充分体现了华裔美国商业社区内部的深厚联系。

与此同时，华州中华总商会致力于打击不实信息，为华语受众提供准确的公共卫生信息，并与医疗专业人士及政府机构合作，制作有关新冠预防、检测及可用资源的双语内容。

## 媒体报道

华州中华总商会新冠救助行动的规模与影响力引起了广泛关注。KIRO 7新闻台以多集系列报道的形式对“爱心午餐”项目进行了报道，向西雅图观众介绍了该项目背后的餐馆与志愿者，并突显了华裔美国人社区在这座城市抗疫工作中所做出的贡献。

华州中华总商会在新冠疫情期间开展的救助工作，成为该机构发展历程中具有里程碑意义的时刻，充分展现了其快速动员、服务广大群体，以及与政府、媒体和西雅图更广泛商界建立持久合作关系的能力。

items.title_en: CCCWA's 15th 'Star of the Week' Guests Give a Timely Introduction to SBA PPP Loan Applications
items.title_zh: 第15期CCCWA“每周一星”嘉宾及时分享联邦中小型企业管理局（SBA）发放PPP贷款申请介绍
items.summary_en: This episode's guests, a professional team from a bank, introduce the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan forgiveness process from the US Small Business Administration (SBA), helping small and medium businesses get through the economic hardship of the pandemic.
items.summary_zh: 本期嘉宾来自银行的专业团队，为大家介绍美国联邦小企业局（SBA）发放了PPP（Paycheck Protection...
items.body_en:
This episode's guests, a professional team from a bank, introduce the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan forgiveness process from the US Small Business Administration (SBA), helping small and medium businesses get through the economic hardship of the pandemic.

Eligible uses of PPP loan forgiveness amounts: at least 60% of the loan must be used for employee payroll; the remaining 40% can be used for non-payroll expenses such as rent and utilities.

PPP loan forgiveness application process: submit a forgiveness application to your designated bank in advance; fill out the application form truthfully based on your company's actual circumstances at the time of application; if the PPP loan is not fully disbursed as required within the deadline, the remaining balance will accrue 1% interest.

Key points to watch for in the forgiveness process: keep all application materials for at least 5 years; keep detailed, traceable records of all payment transactions for at least 5 years; monitor official government websites for the latest updates.

items.title_en: CCCWA "Weekly Star" Session 14 Guest Yiping Chan: The Current State of U.S.-China Relations and Its Implications for Chinese Americans
items.title_zh: 第14期CCCWA“每周一星”嘉宾 陈宇平：分享当前中美关系及其对在美华人的启示
items.body_en:
Against the backdrop of mounting challenges to amicable China-U.S. relations, how can we collaborate objectively and rationally based on facts to safeguard bilateral economic and trade cooperation, and foster sound and stable development of China-U.S. ties? What impacts will U.S.-China trade disputes and other related factors have on Chinese Americans? This lecture will cover the following topics:

  1. Impacts of China’s rapid development on China-U.S. relations
  2. U.S.-China trade conflicts and their repercussions
  3. The rise and fall of nations and the emerging new global order
  4. Current U.S. economic volatility and presidential elections
  5. History, challenges and takeaways for Chinese Americans

Guest Speaker: Yi Ping (Y.P.) Chan

Founder of Chanden Corporation, which specializes in investment and business consulting between China and the United States. He also serves as CEO and major shareholder of Avidian Technologies, a Seattle-based software company.

Mr. Chan holds multiple academic advisory roles: Member of the Advisory Board at UW Bothell School of Business, Visiting Lecturer at the Darden School of Business, Advisory Board Member and Lecturer at the Alberts Center for Global Business at Seattle University, Corporate Practice Mentor for MBA students at Tianjin University, and Adjunct Professor at Southwest University of Science and Technology in China.

He is a co-author of business case studies and articles published by Darden Business Publishing and The Washington Post.

He earned an MBA and a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering from Columbia University in the United States.

For more information: www.linkedin.com/in/ychan94

1.      中国的高速发展对中美关系的影响

2.      中美贸易冲突及影响

items.title_en: United in Combating COVID-19, Forging a New Future for Dining — CCCWA Successfully Hosts Phase 1 of the 2020 Chinese Restaurant Entrepreneurship Forum
items.title_zh: 携手抗疫后，餐聚新未来——CCCWA 2020中餐业创业论坛第一期顺利举办
items.body_en:
The first session of the forum brought together participants from all sectors of the food and beverage industrial chain, covering restaurants, real estate, design, renovation, licensing, logistics, and legal services across both the United States and China. Attendees jointly discussed the challenges and opportunities facing entrepreneurs launching Chinese restaurants overseas, collaborating to boost the development of the Chinese food industry in Washington State.

Kevin He, Founder of IJ Sushi Burrito

IJ Sushi Burrito is a Japanese quick-service restaurant targeting young customers. Kevin, the owner with three local locations, shared his keys to success: clearly defining your core customer base and selecting restaurant locations tailored to your target demographic.

Holly Yang (Xiaohong Yang), Vice President and Partner at Kidder Mathews Commercial Real Estate

Holly leads Kidder Mathews’ Asia Pacific team, which specializes in representing Chinese investors in commercial real estate acquisitions and leasing transactions. She shared that anyone investing in the food and beverage industry must prepare a comprehensive business plan covering precise consumer targeting, capital investment planning, restaurant design, and the professional reputation of brokerage agents. These factors directly determine whether investors can secure ideal restaurant spaces and negotiate favorable lease agreements smoothly.

Jing Li, Manager of GC2 Design Studio

She also emphasized that the layout, business credibility and brand recognition of catering enterprises play a vital role in securing lease agreements for prime locations. During renovation, special attention must be paid to the layout of kitchen equipment to fully meet the health department’s regulatory standards.

Shiqing Liang, Founder of J&J Chinese Restaurant (Bai Wei Xuan)

When opening a Chinese restaurant in the U.S., you may engage accountants and attorneys to apply for all catering-related licenses, which include:

  1. Washington State Business License
  2. Retail Sales Permit
  3. County or Municipal Local Business Permit for the restaurant location
  4. City Fire Safety Certificate
  5. Health Department Food Service Permit
  6. Outdoor Signage Permit
  7. Liquor License

Wilson, Founder of Sizzling Pot King (Fu Rong Xiang)

With three operating restaurants under his belt and hands-on experience guiding the launch of seven additional dining venues, Wilson shared valuable insights from his extensive industry experience. He advised buyers of existing restaurant assets to carefully assess whether the on-site kitchen equipment meets the unique operational demands of Chinese cuisine.

He further stressed that license applications cannot be treated lightly for a smooth restaurant launch and operation. Business owners should start the application process well in advance and provide thorough, detailed descriptions of all core business activities to avoid unnecessary delays in permit review and approval.

Lucy, Founder of Frying Fish (Fei Teng Yu Xiang)

Lucy holds the view that specialists excel in their respective fields, so professional tasks should be entrusted to qualified experts. This covers pre-opening preparations including permit applications, site selection and lease negotiations, as well as restaurant interior design.

During daily restaurant operations, incentive systems should be implemented for chefs and front-of-house staff to retain top talent. Consistent retention of skilled employees safeguards food quality and service standards, which in turn boosts restaurant profitability and brand reputation.

Michelle Lei, General Manager of Chow Bus Inc. for the Seattle Region

Founded in Chicago in 2015, Chow Bus Inc. now provides Chinese food delivery services in more than 20 cities with large Chinese communities across the United States, Canada and Australia. Its core mission is to help Chinese catering businesses expand their customer reach. Especially amid the pandemic, the service allowed quarantined customers to still enjoy authentic Chinese cuisine at home.

The company plans to launch an online pre-order and pre-payment system for scheduled dine-in visits in the future. This feature will cut down customers’ waiting time on-site, reduce restaurants’ staffing demands, and lift restaurants’ table turnover rate.

Attorney Charlie Cai, Cai & Associates Law Firm

  1. Lawful U.S. residents may participate in restaurant operations through equity investment.
  2. Non-U.S. residents investing in the food and beverage industry may travel to the U.S. on a short-term B-1 business visa to inspect and research restaurant operations, while receiving salaries from their companies based in China.
  3. Non-U.S. residents who hold over 50% controlling ownership of a restaurant and participate in its daily management, and whose overseas companies own over 50% of the U.S. restaurant business, with at least one year of relevant management experience at the overseas U.S.-affiliated company within the past three years, are eligible to apply for an L-1A Intracompany Manager Visa to work in the U.S. They may bring their immediate family members. Spouses accompanying the visa holder are legally permitted to work in the U.S., and minor children may attend U.S. schools legally. Qualified applicants may later apply for a green card.
  4. Non-U.S. citizens from countries with E-Treaty trade agreements with the United States who own more than 50% of a restaurant business may apply for an E-2 Treaty Investor Visa to enter the U.S.
  5. Managers of multinational corporations with extensive administrative experience, or professionals holding specialized proprietary catering knowledge or technical expertise within such multinationals, may apply for an L-1B Intracompany Specialized Knowledge Worker Visa and bring their immediate family members. Accompanying spouses are authorized to work in the U.S., and minor children have legal access to local schooling.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) hopes this industry forum will serve as a starting point to deliver actionable guidance to all catering businesses. By establishing a dedicated exchange platform for Washington’s Chinese restaurant community, CCCWA aims to attract renowned Chinese food brands to set up operations in Washington State, foster cross-border communication within the global catering sector, and further flourish the Chinese food industry.
items.body_zh:
论坛第一期围绕餐饮业相关链的各行各业，函盖美中两国的餐厅，地产，设计，装修，执照、物流和法律等多个领域，共同探讨海外中餐创业面临的问题和机遇，携手提升华盛顿州中餐业的发展。

IJ Sushi Burrito创始人Kevin He
IJ Sushi Burrito 是以年轻人为主要食客的日式快餐，在本地拥有三家分店的业主Kevin分享成功经验是要明确客主体户群，从而针对消费人群选择餐厅的地址。

Kidder Mathews商业地产（基德）公司副总裁，

合伙人：Holly Yang （杨晓红） 

Holly领导的基德商业地产亚太团队专注代理中国投资者的商业地产收购以及租赁。Holly分享投资餐饮业要有明确的商业企划书，包括消费者精确定位，资金投入、餐馆的设计、代理人的专业声誉等。这些因素直接影响到投资人是否可以成功选址而且是否可以顺利地谈下租赁合同。

GC2构成设计公司经理：李静

同样强调餐饮企业的格局、信用、品牌知名度对顺利获得热门地段的租赁合同有着重要影响。在装修过程中一定要注意厨房设备的布置并满足卫生局的要求。

百味轩（J&J Chinese Restaurant）创始人：梁诗晴

美国开中餐厅可以通过会计师和律师申请餐饮业相关的执照， 包括：

1）华盛顿州营业执照；2）零售许可证；3）餐厅所在郡或城市的许可证；4）餐厅所在城市的消防证；5）卫生许可证；6）广告牌许可证；7）酒牌；

芙蓉湘（Sizzling Pot King）创始人Wilson

拥有三家餐厅并参与指导七家餐厅开业经验，拥有丰富经验的Wilson分享了在购买现成餐厅时，要考虑到现有的餐厅设备是否符合中餐的需要，同时指出为了餐厅的正常开业运营，执照的申请不容马虎，时间上要及早准备，餐厅的主要经营范围要详尽描述，以避免拖延审批时间。

沸腾渔乡（FRYING FISH）创始人Lucy

Lucy认为术业有专攻，专业的事情要委托专业人士处理：例如许可证申请、餐厅的选址和租赁、餐厅的设计等前期准备事项。在餐厅营运过程中，对待厨师、店面员工们都要有奖励机制以保留优秀员工，保证菜色质量和服务品质从而提高餐厅的盈利和品牌。

Chow Bus Inc.西雅图地区总经理Michelle Lei

公司2015年成立于芝加哥，现在美、加、澳等国20多个华人聚居的城市提供中餐配送服务， 主旨是帮助中餐业扩展业务，特别在疫情期间也为客户在家隔离时仍然可以享受到美食的乐趣。

公司展望今后开发在网络上提前下菜单并支付，定时到餐厅就餐，以节约食客排队等候时间和减少店面人员配置，同时增加餐厅的翻台频率。

蔡和蔡律师事务所（Cai & Associates）Charlie Cai律师

1）美国合法居民可以通过投资入股的方式参与经营

2）非美国居民投资餐饮业，可以通过B1商务签证短期来美考察、调研餐厅的运营，在中国公司领取工资。
3) 非美国居民投资餐饮业获50%以上的控股参与餐厅运营，并且在美国境外的公司控股50%以上以及有在最近的3年内至少满1年的相关的美国海外公司管理经验，便可以申请L1A高级管理人签证赴美并可携带家眷同行。同行的夫妻可以在美国合法工作，同行的未成年子女可以在美国合法上学。符合条件的可以申请绿卡。
4）来自与美国有E-Trading合作国家的非美国居民投资餐饮业获50%以上的控股，可以申请E2签证赴美。
5) 有丰富管理经验的跨国公司管理人士或在此跨国公司拥有公司内部独特餐饮知识或技术的人士可申请L1B签证赴美并可携带家眷同行。同行的夫妻可以在美国合法工作，同行的未成年子女可以在美国合法上学。


CCCWA希望此次行业交流论坛抛砖引玉，能够找到方向帮助到各餐饮企业。同时通过论坛打造华盛顿州中餐业交流平台，推动中国餐饮业著名品牌落地华州，加强世界餐饮业交流，繁荣中餐领域。

items.title_en: 13th CCCWA 'Star of the Week' Guest: Tracey Shares an Overview of Various Investment Portfolio Strategies in the US
items.title_zh: 第13期CCCWA“每周一星”嘉宾：Tracey 分享美国多种投资组合方式简介
items.summary_en: Tracey, a doctorate in Electrical Engineering with a tech background who now works in financial services, joined CCCWA this week to introduce common investment approaches in the US, analyzing the risk, return, and tax rate of different investment vehicles. Tracey explained the Rule of 72 for investment returns.
items.summary_zh: 电子工程博士 Tracey 有着高科技背景，现从事金融服务业， ​本周做客CCCWA 为大家介绍在美国常见的投资方式，分析不同投资工具的风险、回报率、缴税率。Tracey向大家解释了投资回报率的72法则，通过分享实例，对比不同投资工具各自的主要优胜性和局限性以便帮助大家了解在不同阶段适合的投资选择。
items.body_en:
Tracey, a doctorate in Electrical Engineering with a tech background who now works in financial services, joined CCCWA this week to introduce common investment approaches in the US, analyzing the risk, return, and tax rate of different investment vehicles. Tracey explained the Rule of 72 for investment returns, and through real examples, compared the main strengths and limitations of different investment tools to help everyone understand which options fit different life stages.

Government bonds: a relatively stable investment, with fully tax-free returns.
Bank CDs (certificates of deposit): low risk but lower returns.
Stocks and futures: easy to trade, high risk and high return — due to market unpredictability, can also yield no return or negative growth in the short term.

Real estate investment: a particularly popular investment choice among Chinese investors. Tracey gave a detailed analysis: returns vary significantly by location; the greater Seattle real estate market has outperformed the national average over the past 10 years. Inheriting property requires paying estate taxes upfront. Real estate development projects require significant upfront capital, have a relatively long cash cycle, and access to cash on short notice can be limited. Real estate is also sensitive to environmental factors and dependent on regional population growth.

Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs): no need to personally manage property or physical asset management — instead, entrust it to a professional real estate investment fund or property management company, invest in a REIT fund, and receive a fixed annual return.

Indexed annuities: a good fit for those approaching retirement age, offering guaranteed growth income; since taxes are only paid on withdrawal, the effective tax rate can be lowered. This is a US financial product that foreign nationals can also purchase.

IUL (Indexed Universal Life) whole life plan: a multi-purpose insurance plan with zero investment risk, guaranteeing minimum annual growth income, guaranteeing wealth transfer with zero estate tax, and providing critical illness insurance and long-term care coverage. Assets held within an IUL do not affect scholarship applications, and IUL assets are protected from lawsuits.

Tracey emphasized several key considerations for investing: your risk tolerance; whether there is principal protection; whether it affects eligibility for education scholarships; how to properly plan for wealth transfer while legally avoiding estate tax; and the effective tax rate on investment returns.

Attendees thanked Tracey for her careful preparation and expert explanation, which opened up many new ways of thinking about investment options. Tracey reminded everyone: there is no perfect investment vehicle — only a thoughtfully tailored combination of options that matches your needs at each stage of life.

items.body_zh:
电子工程博士Tracey有着高科技背景，现从事金融服务业，本周做客CCCWA为大家介绍在美国常见的投资方式，分析不同投资工具的风险、回报率、缴税率。Tracey向大家解释了投资回报率的72法则，通过分享实例，对比不同投资工具各自的主要优胜性和局限性以便帮助大家了解在不同阶段适合的投资选择。

政府债券：比较稳定的投资,并且投资收益是完全免税的。 银行的定期存款：低风险但回报率较低。 股票、期货：易操作，高风险高回报，由于市场的不可预见性，短期也会没有回报或负增值。

房地产投资：针对华人比较普遍喜爱的投资方式， Tracey作了比较详细的分析：投资回报需要因地点而异，大西雅图房地产市场过去10年回报率高于全美平均水平。房产的继承需要预先交清遗产税。开发房地产项目先期资金投入比较大，现金周期运作相对比较长，急需调动现金会受到限制。容易受到环境的影响，依赖地区的人口增长速度。 房地产投资基金 (REITS)：不用亲自管理房产投资或实体物业管理，交给专业的地产投资基金公司或物业管理公司，投入REITS基金，每年有固定回报。

指数年金(Annuity)：比较适合接近退休年龄人士的投资方式，是一种可以保底的增值收入，收益等取钱时才交税可以降低缴税率。 这是一款外国人也可以购买的美国金融产品。IUL全保计划 （Index Universal Life):多功能的保险计划，投资零风险，每年保障最低增值收入，保障财富传承零遗产税， 提供包含重大疾病保险，和长期护理的费用。 IUL里面的资产额不影响申请奖学金 IUL里面的资产额免于被诉讼。

Tracey强调：投资考虑的几个要点：风险承受力是否有本金保护是否会影响教育奖学金的申请如何处理好财富传承，合法避免遗产税投资回报的实际缴税率

参会的朋友们感谢Trancy精心的准备和专业的讲解，为大家开阔了投资渠道的多种思路。 Tracey 提醒大家： 没有十全十美的投资工具，只有结合不同阶段的需求，针对性地巧妙配置出最合适的投资方式。

items.title_en: 11th 'Star of the Week' — Jason Moore of Local Real Estate Firm Windermere Shares the Latest on Greater Seattle Residential Real Estate Investment
items.title_zh: 第11期“每周一星”--来自本地房地产Windermere 的Jason Moore分享大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的新信息
items.summary_en: This episode's guest is Jason Moore, founder of Seattle real estate firm Windermere Real Estate/PSR Inc., who, along with colleague Laura Yang, hosted a session sharing the latest information on greater Seattle residential real estate investment.
items.summary_zh: 本期做客嘉宾是来自西雅图房地产公司Windermere Real Estat/PSR Inc. 创始人Jason Moore，他与同事Laura Yang主持分享大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的最新信息。...
items.body_en:
Our featured guest for this session was Jason Moore, Founder of Seattle-based Windermere Real Estate / PSR Inc. Together with his colleague Laura Yang, he hosted a sharing session covering the latest updates on residential real estate investment across the Greater Seattle Area.

Windermere accounts for nearly one-quarter of all residential transaction volume in the local market, whether buyers or sellers are involved in the deal.

Jason explained that a housing market is classified as a buyer’s market when local residential inventory exceeds three months’ supply. The last buyer’s market here dated back to 2011. Since the subsequent real estate recovery, limited housing stock has kept Greater Seattle firmly in a seller’s market.

Driven by pandemic-related economic shifts, demand for luxury lakefront homes and high-density upscale downtown condominiums has shown signs of cooling. Nevertheless, Greater Seattle’s diversified economy — supported by a large pool of high-income tech industry professionals — sustains strong homebuying demand, so the pandemic’s overall impact on mainstream residential housing remains modest. Addressing attendees’ interest in the Spring District, Jason noted its thoughtfully planned layout, convenient surrounding retail amenities and transportation links, predicting robust market potential for the area moving forward.

Millennials represent the primary group of first-time homebuyers, making up 46% of all property purchasers in Greater Seattle and serving as a powerful driving force for the residential market. Jason expressed an optimistic long-to-medium-term outlook for the region’s housing sector.

Attendees participated in lively discussions throughout the evening and extended their gratitude to the two Windermere speakers. The guests prepared extensive supporting materials, compiled decades of market data, and presented professional charts, enabling participants to gain a comprehensive grasp of the latest residential real estate investment trends in the Greater Seattle Area.
items.body_zh:
本期做客嘉宾是来自西雅图房地产公司Windermere Real Estat/PSR Inc. 创始人Jason Moore，他与同事Laura Yang主持分享大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的最新信息。

在住宅市场交易中无论购买或销售，Windermere 公司的成交量占据本地市场总额的近四分之一。

Jason提到当本地住宅市场的库存超过3个月，可以认为是买方市场。最近一次的买方市场发生在2011年，自从上次房地产反弹后，由于市场房源短缺，大西雅图地区的住宅市场维持在卖方市场。

受到疫情和经济的影响，湖边高端豪宅或市区高密度高级公寓的需求体现放缓的趋势。然而，大西雅图由于产业多样化，特别是集中高科技企业的高收入人群，对购房的需求迫切，因此疫情对普通住房市场影响有限。针对朋友们关注的Spring District, Jason认为当地规划设计完善，周围商业、交通便利，今后极具市场潜力。

千禧一代将成为刚需购房的主要市场，大西雅图地区46%购房者为千禧一代，因此对住宅市场是强劲的推动力。Jason对本地区住宅市场的中长期展望持乐观态度。

当晚大家积极参加讨论，并且感谢来自Windermere的两位嘉宾，他们认真为大家准备了充足的资料，收集了多年的数据，制作成专业的图表，让大家对大西雅图地区住宅地产投资的最新信息获得全面了解。

This episode's speaker, designer Jing Li, shared online about GC2 Design's creative and construction services, spanning the full pipeline from creative concept to completed construction, striving to deliver the most optimized design solutions and top-quality construction for clients. items.title_en: KIRO 7 News Series Covers CCCWA's 'Food with Love' and Other Pandemic Relief Efforts
items.title_zh: Kiro7 News 系列报道CCCWA“Food with Love"等 抗击疫情公益活动
items.body_en:
Faced with the sudden outbreak of COVID-19, member companies of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State (CCCWA) demonstrated strong corporate social responsibility across all industries. They actively coordinated their domestic and overseas branches to source pandemic relief supplies, which were donated free of charge to institutions severely impacted by the virus.

After donating medical supplies such as masks and protective gowns to medical facilities, CCCWA rallied a group of compassionate local Chinese restaurants to deliver $400,000 worth of complimentary meals to frontline healthcare workers fighting the pandemic.

Local Seattle news station Kiro7 News conducted exclusive interviews with Doulao Fang, one of the restaurants that spearheaded the meal donation initiative, alongside CCCWA President Ms. Lili Lü and chamber member Attorney Qing Cai, and ran a special feature story covering the campaign.

Kiro7 News Report 1: CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) and its series of public welfare initiatives including the "Food with Love" meal donation program launched during the COVID-19 response.

Kiro7 News Report 2: Journalist Deedee Sun reports that restaurants including Doulao Fang prioritized community safety and frontline pandemic responders despite their own severe operational hardships brought on by the COVID-19 crisis. Kiro7 News Report 4: The "Food with Love" charity program is on track to fulfill its goal of delivering meals worth $400,000 to frontline pandemic workers. Kiro7 News Report 5: The "Food with Love" campaign raises funds to offset food preparation costs for participating charity restaurants, uniting the whole community to pass on kindness on a larger scale.
items.body_zh:
面对突如其来的新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会各会员单位在各个领域发挥出了企业社会责任感，积极协调公司海内外分支机构进行相关物资采购，并无偿捐赠给有需求的疫情严重的机构。在向医疗机构捐赠口罩、防护服等医疗物资之后，CCCWA又组织了一批优秀而有爱的餐饮企业向抗疫一线的医护人员捐赠价值40万美元的爱心午餐。


 西雅图本地的电视台Kiro7 News 特地采访了参与活动的餐厅发起餐厅之一“豆捞坊”和CCCWA会长吕莉莉女士及会员蔡清律师，并作了专题报导。


Kiro7 News 报道 1- CCCWA （Chinese Chamber of Commerce in washington State ）在抗击疫情期间组织的“Food with love”爱心餐等系列公益活动

Kiro7 News 报道 2- 记者Deedee Sun讲述豆捞坊等餐厅在疫情冲击下不顾自身餐厅生存困难，心系社区安危和抗疫前线 Kiro7 News 报道 4- “Food with Love”公益活动给一线抗疫人员送出40万爱心餐目标即将完成 Kiro7 News报道5-“ Food with Love”活动募集资金，以分担爱心餐厅的制作成本，全社会一起把爱心放大。

That evening, Mr. Pei shared his firsthand experience providing world-class operations management consulting to multinational companies such as Coca-Cola, Heinz, DuPont, and AkzoNobel, as well as China Resources and COFCO, and his unique insights on corporate change management.

items.title_en: Now It's Time to Take Up the Baton from the Caring Restaurants!
items.title_zh: 现在，是时候接过爱心餐厅的接力棒了！
items.body_en:
As temperatures climbed in Seattle throughout May, the Food with Love free meal campaign gained greater momentum alongside the warmer weather. Over more than a month of operation, 13 local restaurants partnered with professional food delivery platform Chowbus to deliver over 17,000 complimentary boxed meals to 26 recipient facilities and community members, feeding more than 1,000 pandemic frontliners.

The initiative started with just three participating restaurants and has since expanded to more than a dozen. Meal recipients also grew from solely medical staff to a broader group of frontline responders including medical workers, police officers and public health officials. Today, the Food with Love program stands as one of the most influential flagship charity campaigns launched in Seattle amid the COVID-19 crisis.

This charity campaign also deeply resonated with local Seattle residents. Many were moved by the organizers’ selfless good works after learning about the free meal initiative and rushed to join in support. Numerous heartwarming stories of kindness being passed along unfolded during this period. The meals touched the community, and the community’s participation, in turn, touched the event organizers. This cycle of mutual gratitude and encouragement reminds us that every participant, regardless of their role, stands united as one community supporting each other through difficult times.

Story 1: Former Recipient Turns into a Donor

“I’ve been hoping to find the people who helped me four years ago, and when I saw the Love Meal campaign online, I knew I had to take this chance to repay their kindness.” This message was sent by Ms. L to Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA and overall coordinator of the Food with Love program.

Four years prior, Ms. L’s life took an unexpected turn for the worse. Back then, Ms. Lü raised a relief fund on her behalf through the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, one of the participating organizations of this charity drive. For four years, Ms. L had been thinking about how she could give back to the community. Upon seeing coverage of the Love Meal initiative in local media, she immediately donated $500. “I’m grateful to everyone who stood by me when I was at my lowest. Now I want to pass that warmth on to others,” she said. The meal campaign operates like a baton of compassion, meant to be handed endlessly to more people and carry kindness far into the future.

Story 2: Based in China, Hearts Tied to Seattle

Ruoyao Li and Shuo Zhang, a couple residing in China, donated $10,000 to the campaign organizing committee as soon as they learned about the Food with Love program, to cover ingredient costs for participating restaurants.

The couple shared, “Frontline medical workers and restaurant staff alike bore heavy burdens during the pandemic, and every restaurant joining this donation drive embodies extraordinary generosity. We were deeply moved by these ordinary yet profoundly touching acts of care. Though we cannot be there in person, our hearts remain closely connected to Seattle and its wonderful residents.”

Story 3: A Wish to Send Heartfelt Meals to Medical Staff

“The Chowbus app lets users pre-purchase donated meals for police officers, emergency hotline responders, ICU and ER frontline medical teams, and mobile COVID testing stations. My work schedule keeps me from volunteering on-site, but buying donated meals is my way to back this program and thank all frontline healthcare heroes. This indirect participation is still an act of love,” read a note left by a user who purchased ten complimentary meal vouchers in one go via Chowbus. These boxed meals carry no monetary value—only priceless compassion.

Chowbus: The Critical Bridge Spreading Kindness

Chowbus played an irreplaceable role in this community-wide meal donation relay. It connected over a dozen volunteer restaurants preparing free meals on one end, and more than 20 frontline recipient facilities on the other, serving as the core logistics backbone of the Food with Love campaign.

Participating restaurants also expressed sincere gratitude to Chowbus for its reliable, all-weather delivery service that ensured meals reached communities far and wide. Chowbus staff worked grueling hours from dawn till dusk, shuttling between restaurants and delivery sites covering Renton in the south, Everett in the north, Issaquah in the east, and all neighborhoods of Seattle in the west. Round trips to the farthest recipient hospitals could exceed 100 miles, with some single delivery runs taking a minimum of three hours from pickup to drop-off.

On an average day, Chowbus delivered 400 to 500 meal boxes, with its peak volume hitting 580 meals dispatched to 14 separate locations in a single day, seven days a week without interruption. Delivery teams never complained, readily accepting every order no matter how many meals or how long the route. When restaurant staff needed extra hands, Chowbus employees arrived equipped with protective gear to assist with food packing and loading before transporting steaming hot meals to their destinations. To date, Chowbus has delivered more than 17,000 meals to thousands of pandemic frontline workers.

Standing Together Through Hardship to Support Our Charitable Restaurants

“I hope I can keep enjoying food from these generous restaurants after the pandemic,” “We simply cannot let these kind-hearted eateries go out of business!” Countless netizens voiced such heartfelt remarks after seeing the meals prepared by participating restaurants.

Indeed, it is now our turn to repay these catering businesses with kindness. The pandemic dealt an unprecedented heavy blow to Seattle’s food and beverage industry. Over those two grueling months, local restaurants scrambled to stay afloat—some ramped up takeout delivery services, while others pivoted to selling fresh produce group buys. Every operator was fighting tooth and nail to survive.

Even amid their own severe financial strain, the 13 restaurants that joined the Food with Love campaign put their own struggles aside. For more than a month, they persisted in preparing free hot meals for frontline pandemic responders day in and day out.

Looking at these meals, you can’t help but admire how much care these community-minded restaurants put into their work. It felt less like a charity meal program and more like a culinary competition showcasing their finest skills.

Frontline pandemic workers raved about the donated meals and shared glowing tributes to the restaurants on social media, commenting, “This is the best Chinese food we’ve ever had,” and “These meals made me fall in love with Asian cuisine.” As members of the Chinese community, we felt immense pride reading these words.

“The Food with Love campaign has entered its second phase, and the baton of kindness is now passed to the general public. We hope to rally community-wide support to amplify the restaurants’ generosity and help these charitable eateries recover swiftly from pandemic losses.” The event organizers are calling on everyone to stand with these restaurants and keep the cycle of compassion going.

To preserve these admirable local restaurants so we can continue enjoying their dishes long after the pandemic, we urge all residents to carry forward this spirit of care by ordering takeout from participating venues. For every $50 spent at these partner restaurants via Chowbus, the restaurant will donate one complimentary meal to frontline workers. Whether you place a regular dine-in or delivery order or make a direct donation through Chowbus, every contribution is a meaningful gesture of support for both frontline responders and our community restaurants.

Thirteen Participating Charitable Restaurants

  1. IJ Sushi Burrito
  2. J&J Chinese Restaurant (Bai Wei Xuan)
  3. Frying Fish (Fei Teng Yu Xiang)
  4. Sizzling Pot King (Fu Rong Xiang)
  5. Happy Lamb Hot Pot
  6. Liuyishou Hot Pot
  7. Old Town Hot Pot No.9
  8. Shanghai Taste
  9. Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant
  10. Panda Dim Sum
  11. Doulao Fang
  12. Rongcheng Hot Pot
  13. Tamarindos Indian Restaurant

Charitable Restaurants Available on the Chowbus App

Doulao Fang, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Frying Fish (Fei Teng Yu Xiang), Sizzling Pot King (Fu Rong Xiang), Old Town Hot Pot No.9, Shanghai Taste
items.body_zh:
5月的西雅图逐渐炎热，爱心午餐活动也随着5月的天气继续升温。在活动进行的这一个多月时间里，13家餐厅通过专业外卖平台chowbus 将1.7万多份免费爱心盒饭送到26家受赠单位和社区成员手里，让1000多名一线抗疫者享用到爱心午餐。从一开始爱心午餐只有三家餐厅参与，到现在已经有十多家餐厅参与；从捐送医护人员到如今捐赠给医护人员、警察、防疫人员等更多一线抗疫工作者，爱心午餐活动经已经成为西雅图抗疫活动中最有影响力的品牌公益活动之一。 这次活动也感染了生活在西雅图的当地民众。很多人在看到有关爱心午餐的活动后都被组织者的义举所感动，也纷纷云集响应。在这段时间，也发生了不少让组织者感动的爱心传递的故事。爱心午餐活动感动民众，民众参与感动活动组织方。正是这种相互感动、相互鼓舞的故事，让大家感受到，无论是怎样的参与者，我们都是相濡以沫的一家人。


故事一：曾经的受助者，如今的捐赠者


 “这四年来一直想找到当初帮助过我的人，刚好在网上看到爱心午餐活动，一定要借活动了却心愿。”这是爱心午餐活动总指挥、CCCWA 商会会长吕莉莉收到的一条来自L女士的微信消息。原来，L女士在四年前生活突然遭遇变故，当时吕莉莉代表本次爱心活动的参与单位之一西雅图地产投资俱乐部募集了一笔爱心捐款给她。这四年来，L女士一直想着该用怎样的形式回馈社会，当她在媒体看到爱心午餐活动时立刻捐赠500美金。她说：“感谢在我绝望时帮助过我的人，现在我想把爱心传递下去。”这次爱心餐活动正如爱的接力棒，希望棒棒相传，传递给更多人，传递得更久、更远。



故事二：人在中国，心系西雅图


一对生活在国内的夫妇李若垚、张硕，听说爱心午餐活动后立即向活动组委会捐赠1万美金，用于帮助爱心餐厅承担一些原材料成本。这对夫妇说：“医护人员和餐厅员工都是在非常时期抗击疫情的重要力量，而这些参与捐赠的爱心餐厅也个个都有侠骨豪情。我们被这些平凡、朴素而又伟大的爱心故事所感动，虽然我们人不能来，但是心系西雅图这片土地和这些可爱的人。”



故事三：想让医护人员也能吃到我的爱心盒饭


“看到chowbus APP上也可以选择捐一顿爱心餐给警察以及前线指挥热线，捐给ICU、ER的一线医护人员，捐给移动监测站时，我想虽然自己由于工作关系没时间直接参与爱心午餐活动中，但是也可以通过捐爱心餐这种方式来表达对活动的支持、对一线医务工作者的感谢。为他们在chowbus上捐赠一些爱心盒饭，这种间接参与也是爱。”这是一位一口气在chowbus上买了10份爱心盒饭的用户留言。这不是传递有价的盒饭，而是传递无价的爱心。



chowbus做传递爱心的桥梁


在这场爱心午餐接力赛中，chowbus起了关键性作用。它一端连接制作爱心午餐的十几家餐厅，一端连接着二十多家一线受助单位，成为这场爱心午餐活动中最重要的桥梁。在此，爱心餐厅们也感谢chowbus的使命必达，是chowbus风雨无阻把大家的爱心送到更多、更远的地方。chowbus的工作人员每天披星载月从早忙到晚上穿梭在餐厅和送餐点之间，南到Renton，北到Everett, 东到Issaquah，西到Seattle全覆盖，最远的受捐医院往返路程加起来得一百多英里，有的一单任务从取餐到送餐完成的时间加起来至少花费三个小时。平均每天，chowbus运送四五百份盒饭，最多时需要一天将580个盒饭送达14个不同地方，而且每周七天不停歇。但是，chowbus配送人员毫无怨言，再多的餐、再远的路他们都欣然接受。当爱心午餐餐厅需要帮忙时，chowbus的员工就会带上防护品，帮助餐厅打包、装车，带着热气腾腾的饭盒前往目的地。如今chowbus已经将一万多份盒饭送到上千名一线抗疫人员手中。


与爱心餐厅丹舟共济


“希望在疫情之后还能吃到这些爱心餐厅的美食”，“绝对不能让这些爱心餐厅倒下去！”……当网友们看到爱心餐厅们制作的美食后，很多网友发出这样的呼声！


是的，现在是时候用爱来回馈这些爱心餐厅了！我们知道，疫情给西雅图的餐饮行业带来了前所未有的重创。这两个月以来，有的餐厅努力送外卖，有的餐厅转型搞起了生鲜团购，大家都在想方设法生存下来。即使餐饮行业捉襟见肘的日子里，这13家参与爱心午餐活动的餐厅依然不顾自身安危，在过去的一个多月时间里坚持为一线抗疫工作者制作免费的爱心午餐。

看到这些美食你是不是都在感慨爱心餐厅的用心，这哪里像是做爱心午餐，简直是爱心餐厅的厨艺大赛！每当看到一线抗疫工作者对这些爱心午餐赞不绝口，在社交媒体上给爱心餐厅的各种告白：“这是我们吃过的最好吃的中餐”，“因为这些爱心午餐让我爱上了亚洲美食”等等，身为华人的我们也为之骄傲。

“现在爱心午餐活动进入第二阶段，爱心的接力棒传递到大众手中，希望发动社会力量将餐厅的爱心放大，用社会的力量帮助这些爱心餐厅从疫情打击中快速恢复。”在此，爱心午餐的主办方也呼吁大众一起帮助爱心餐厅，将爱心传递下去。


为了能让我们留住这些可敬的爱心餐厅，为了让我们在疫情后还能吃到这些餐厅的美食，恳请大家接过爱心接力棒，多点外卖支持这些爱心餐厅。现在只要在chowbus上的爱心餐厅每消费$50美金，这些爱心餐厅将配捐赠出一份爱心午餐。为了身在前线的抗疫战士们，也为了这些爱心餐厅，无论您是在chowbus上消费，还是在chowbus上选择直接捐赠，都是为爱点赞！


十三家爱心餐厅名称：

豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、刘一手、沸腾鱼乡、颐和园海鲜酒楼、蓉城老火锅、上海味道坊、芙蓉湘、小肥羊（快乐小羊）、百味轩、九号巷火锅、熊猫点心、Tamarindos Indian 餐厅


已在chowbus APP上线的爱心餐厅：

豆捞坊、刘一手、沸腾鱼乡、芙蓉湘、九号巷火锅、上海味道坊

items.title_en: WSCRF Teams up with CCCWA to Support Local Businesses and Feed Frontline Workers

items.summary_en: The Washington State China Relations Fund (WSCRF), the charitable arm of the Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC), has joined forces with the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington...
items.summary_zh: 华盛顿州中国关系理事会（WSCRC）旗下的慈善机构——华盛顿州中国关系基金会（WSCRF），近日与华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA）携手，在为奋战在抗疫一线的工作者提供餐食的同时，也支持本地餐厅的生存与发展。
items.body_en:
The Washington State China Relations Fund (WSCRF), the charitable arm of the Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC), has joined forces with the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) to provide meals to frontline workers fighting Covid-19 while simultaneously supporting local restaurants. CCCWA and partnering organizations and restaurants initiated their “Food with Love” Program on March 30, 2020 ([https://foodwithlovecovid19.com](https://wscrc.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cebf8a47fb72b3eacf0298b96&id=a1996545d7&e=a749ac4648)). The program recruited 15 local restaurants to prepare meals to be delivered to frontline healthcare workers and first responders at over 20 hospitals, police stations and mobile testing sites. To date over 11,000 meals have been delivered. The program is scheduled to run until the end of May. The meals delivered to date have been financed by donations from the restaurants themselves, an in-kind contribution from Chowbus, a food delivery system, and by cash donations. To meet the initial target of raising $400,000 to providing 17,500 meals by June 30, 2020, the program needs to raise an additional $58,000 to complete its objective. The WSCRC and WSCRF, recognizing the great efforts by the Chinese Community in Washington State to pitch in to defeat the virus, encourage its members and partners to support this effort. The WSCRF is able to receive donations and issue a tax-deductible receipt. We appreciate your support. Please contact us if you know of any restaurants who might be interested in participating in this effort.

You could help this effort through the following channels:

PayPal: Send payment to [[email protected]](https://wscrc.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cebf8a47fb72b3eacf0298b96&id=cba0436963&e=a749ac4648) Check Payment: Make Check Payable to: Washington State China Relations Fund Address: 1301 5th Ave, Suite 1500 Seattle, WA 98101 Bank Transfer: Bank Name: East West Bank Account Name: Washington State China Relations Fund Routing Number: 125108492 Account Number: 8662009086 To receive tax-exemption receipt, please provide the donor’s name, email and contact number when making the donation. For more information and questions, please contact [[email protected]](https://wscrc.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cebf8a47fb72b3eacf0298b96&id=8180ca8108&e=a749ac4648). We hope that you and your family stay safe and healthy. Thank you for your kind support. Contact us: [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) 206-441-4419 Mailing Address: 1301 5th Ave NE, Suite 1500 Seattle, WA 98101

items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _May 7, 2020 04:40_ Lecture content: • Market trends under the shadow of COVID-19 • Market outlook after the pandemic • Commercial Real Estate 101 • Success stories and analysis • Common misconceptions in commercial real estate investment Speaker: Holly Yang, CCIM, First Vice President, Partner. Ms. Holly Yang is a well-known expert in Seattle's commercial real estate field, deeply versed in Chinese and American languages, business culture, and regulations. In 2019, Ms. Yang was named "Most Influential Commercial Real Estate Leader of the Year" by a national business weekly. In 2018, she received the "Top 10 Outstanding Women in U.S. Real Estate" award from a real estate news outlet. She is the first Chinese person in the Seattle area to earn the CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member) designation. In nearly 15 years in the field, she has helped countless overseas investors achieve precise cross-border investment matches and maximize their returns. Ms. Yang has been interviewed by many major media outlets, including the well-known BISNOW and the Puget Sound Business Journal, and has been invited to major business forums to give market-trend forecasts, legal lectures, and international business courses. In her work, Ms. Yang upholds a professional attitude of pursuing excellence; in life, she is passionate about charity and advancing U.S.-China cultural exchange. Founded more than 40 years ago, Kidder Mathews is a leading commercial real estate firm on the West Coast, now operating across Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington. Kidder Mathews' Greater Seattle China services provide outstanding real estate consulting and brokerage services to Chinese investors, developers, and tenants. items.title_en: Chowbus: The Messengers of Love Shuttling Daily Between Restaurants, Hospitals, and Police Stations
items.title_zh: Chowbus: 每天穿梭在餐厅和医院、警察局之间的爱的使者
items.body_en:
“If the participating restaurants are the needle of the Food with Love campaign, then Chowbus delivery service is the thread. Thanks to Chowbus connecting all parts of the initiative, the whole program ran seamlessly and formed a heartwarming donation effort,” remarked the organizing committee of the Food with Love campaign on Chowbus’ pivotal role.

In this relay of kindness, Chowbus links more than a dozen restaurants preparing free meals on one side, and over ten frontline response facilities including the UW Virology Laboratory, Bellevue Police Department, plus mobile COVID testing sites on the other, serving as the most critical backbone of the charity program.

To date, Chowbus has delivered more than 5,000 complimentary meals to medical institutions, police stations and other frontline facilities. Over the coming month, it will continue to provide professional delivery services to bring meals to all beneficiary organizations.

Chowbus signed on to the Food with Love charity campaign right from its launch, and Michelle, Chowbus’ lead representative, stepped up to serve as the overall coordinator of the program’s delivery team.

Michelle shared, “I was deeply moved by the selfless generosity of local restaurants, and I wanted to leverage our platform’s resources and strengths to help fulfill this shared mission. While most people stayed safely indoors amid lockdowns, medical staff, police officers and other essential workers still had to show up for their jobs. We hoped to bring them warmth and comfort, letting them know the community stands behind them as they protect all of us.”

Delivery Service Connects Restaurants and Frontline Workers

Chowbus staff poured tremendous labor into this meal donation initiative, and the company even sacrificed its own revenue to support this public welfare effort. Despite the pandemic driving a sharp surge in its regular food delivery business in the short term, Chowbus maintained top-tier service for everyday customers while expanding its capacity for the charity program. It hired extra delivery drivers and mobilized back-office administrative staff to provide on-demand support for the meal drive, ensuring every donation order was completed with consistent quality and quantity.

Every day, Chowbus completes delivery runs for hundreds of complimentary charity meals. Its staff must first pick up food separately from each participating restaurant before delivering the meals to various hospitals, police stations and mobile COVID testing sites spread widely across the region. Recipient facilities are geographically dispersed; round trips to the farthest hospitals exceed 100 miles in total, and some single delivery assignments take at least three hours from food pickup to drop-off. Still, Chowbus delivery couriers never voiced complaints, readily accepting every order regardless of volume or travel distance. When hospitals imposed strict rules on delivery times and food temperature compliance, the team always delivered meals fully meeting health safety temperature standards right on schedule. Whenever restaurant staff needed assistance during packing, Chowbus employees arrived wearing proper personal protective equipment to help box meals and load vehicles, then transported piping-hot food to delivery destinations. Michelle also extended gratitude to partner restaurants including Doulao Fang, IJ Sushi, Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant, Rongcheng Old Hot Pot, Frying Fish and Liuyishou Hot Pot, stating that seamless coordination between all parties ensured timely delivery of every charitable meal.

The Platform Connects the Public with Charity Meals

Chowbus serves as a dual-linking force for the initiative: its delivery fleet bridges volunteer restaurants and frontline essential workers, while its digital website and mobile app connect local residents to the meal donation program.

After media coverage of Food with Love went live, countless community members expressed their wish to donate free meals to frontliners. In response, Chowbus launched dedicated donation portals on its official website and mobile app. Users could purchase donated meals for police officers, emergency dispatch hotline staff, ICU and ER medical teams, mobile testing station workers, or submit monetary donations of any amount. The donation feature was instantly well-received upon launch, with dozens of complimentary meals purchased in one single order by an anonymous user. The platform also raised over $3,000 in public cash donations. Michelle personally led by donating $500, and all collected funds were transferred to the campaign’s finance team to fund more free meals for frontline responders.

Every time medical staff and police officers received the complimentary meals from Chowbus delivery drivers, bright, grateful smiles spread across their faces. They shared that these heartfelt meals brought them immense warmth and further fueled their resolve to keep fighting the pandemic.

Just last week, officers at the Bellevue Police Department posted a thank-you note on Facebook after receiving their first batch of donated meals, expressing sincere gratitude to Chowbus and all participating restaurants.

Chowbus’s eye-catching red insulated delivery bags will continue to be a common sight at police stations, hospitals and testing sites in the days ahead. If you would like to add your own donation to those delivery bags, download the Chowbus App right away to purchase a heartfelt meal for the frontline workers protecting our Seattle community.

“如果说参加捐赠的餐厅是爱心午餐活动的‘针’，那么Chowbus的配送就是这次活动的‘线’，经过Chowbus穿针引线，将整个活动组织得有条不紊，构成这次爱心午餐捐赠的动人画面。”这是爱心午餐活动组委会对Chowbus在这次活动中作用的评价。在这场爱心午餐的接力赛中，Chowubus一端连接制作爱心午餐的十几家餐厅，一端连接着UW Virology、Bellevue Police等十几个一线医护、警察局以及移动防疫站，成为这场爱心午餐活动中最重要的桥梁。截止目前为止，Chowbus已经向一线医护、警察局等机构共计配送了5000多份爱心午餐，在接下来的一个多月时间中 ，还将继续用专业配送为受助机构奉献爱心。

在爱心午餐活动刚刚发起时，Chowbus就第一时间加入进来，Chowbus 负责人Michelle也担任了本次爱心午餐配送组组长的工作。Michelle说：“能参加这个活动完全是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。在几乎所有的人都安全在家时，此时医务工作者、警察这些人却需要坚守岗位，希望能给奋战在一线岗位的工作者一些关怀，让他们能在守护我们的同时感到一些温暖和陪伴。”


用配送服务连接餐厅和一线工作者


为了爱心午餐，Chowbus工作人员付出了辛勤汗水，而Chowbus公司更是舍弃自己盈利去做公益。据了解，疫情的发生让Chowbus自身业务短期内迅速增长。在保证提供给自己用户高质量服务的前提下，Chowbus不但增加雇佣司机、更是出动办公室工作人员，随时援助爱心午餐活动，保质保量完成任务。

每天，Chowbus都要完成几百份爱心午餐的配送任务。这数百份的爱心餐都需要Chowbus工作人员先分别去各个餐厅取餐，然后送往不同的医院、警察局、移动检测点。受捐机构都分布很分散，远些的医院去一趟往返路程加起来得一百多英里，一单任务从取餐到送餐完成的时间加起来至少花费三个小时。但是，Chowbu配送人员毫无怨言，再多的餐、再远的路他们都欣然接受。当有的医院对送餐时间、餐品温度有着严格的要求时，他们也能在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。当爱心午餐餐厅需要帮忙时，Chowbus的员工就会带上防护品，帮助餐厅打包、装车，带着热气腾腾的饭盒前往目的地。在此，Michelle 也向共同奋战的豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼、蓉城老火锅、沸腾鱼乡、刘一手等餐厅表示感谢，她说，正是因为大家的默契配合，才能让爱心餐及时送达。 


用平台连接用户和爱心午餐


一方面，Chowbus用配送服务连接餐厅和一线工作者 ；另一方面，Chowbus用自己的网络平台连接大众用户和爱心午餐。


当很多人看到“爱心午餐”的活动报道后，都纷纷表示自己也想捐助爱心午餐。为此，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道，用户可以选择捐一顿爱心餐给警察以及前线指挥热线、给ICU、ER的一线医护人员、捐给移动监测站、以及其他金额捐赠。捐赠爱心餐功能上线当天就收到用户们认可并纷纷解囊，甚至有位匿名用户一口气捐了几十份爱心午餐。平台上还收到用户们的3000多美金爱心捐款，Michelle本人也带头捐赠500美金，这些捐款都一并转给活动财务组，用来给一线工作人员们购买更多爱心餐。

每当医护人员、警察从Chowbus司机手中接过爱心餐时，脸上都洋溢着灿烂幸福的笑容，他们说，能收到这些“爱心午餐”内心很温暖，这给他们抗疫工作增添了更大的动力。就在上周，当Bellevue 警察局的警察们首次享用到爱心午餐时，开心地在Facebook发文感谢Chowbus、感谢餐厅！

在接下来的日子，Chowbus醒目的红色配送保温包还将频繁出现在警察局、医院和监测点，如果你也想让Chowbus的配送包里有你的一份爱心午餐，现在就下载Chowbus  APP，给你想致谢的保卫西雅图家园的一线工作者们捐赠一份爱心午餐！

As communications technology moves into the 5G era, many industries hope to use social platforms to promote their products worldwide, improving customer satisfaction and achieving a win-win for businesses and customers alike. American Express Financial is exactly that kind of financial services company — using internet platform technology to connect with high-quality global asset management firms, bringing alternative investment opportunities once reserved only for institutions to everyday individual investors, helping them achieve diversified asset allocation.

She holds FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses, and a dual bachelor's degree in Financial Mathematics and Economics from Binghamton University, SUNY.

items.title_zh: 第五期CCCWA“每周一星”做客嘉宾张铭 （MZA建筑设计事务所）分享《美国房地产开发投资和设计流程》
items.body_en:
Ming Zhang, FAIA is the founding Partner of MZA Architecture headquartered in Seattle. He is a award winning designer that specialized in large scale Mixed-use and High-rise building design. His work has covered the US, Asia and Middle East. He is a sought-after speaker, particularly in the topics of high-rise building design, urban design and overall culture and design. He has presented and written essays for international academic organizations such as CTBUH, AIA, and over 30 International Design conferences and Universities. He is NCARB certified and has a Master of Architecture from Illinois Institute of Technology. 
MZA is an internationally-renowned architectural design firm with offices located in Bellevue, Washington and Shanghai, China. We provide innovative architecture, design, interiors, and planning services. For local developers and Chinese investors in the Puget Sound area, we buildprojects ranging from custom single-family homes to mid and high-rise office buildings, apartments, condominiums, retail centers, and hotels. For clients in China, we design large-scale, mixed-use building projects that can reach as high as 500 meters.
items.body_zh:

  1. 投资Seattle和Bellevue房地产需要注意的要点

  2. 投资Seattle和Bellevue房地产开发设计的主要流程和两个城市对设计要求的区别
