items.title_en: The "Caring Lunch" Press Conference Was Held Successfully, and Participants' Stories of Love Moved Seattle
items.title_zh: “爱心午餐”新闻发布会成功举行，参与者爱心故事感动西雅图
items.body_en:
Food with Love Promotion

Restaurants including The Dolar Shop, IJ Sushi Burrito and Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant — the original initiators of this campaign — alongside delivery platform Chowbus, each shared touching stories behind their decision to join the Food with Love initiative.

The Dolar Shop: Spreading Kindness from Local Communities to Hospitals

Bruce, the person in charge, explained that The Dolar Shop was the very first restaurant to launch the complimentary meal service. After witnessing numerous police officers, security guards and delivery drivers left without access to meals amid the pandemic, the restaurant began handing out free lunches outside its storefront for anyone in need. Later, upon learning that medical workers faced far greater hardship, the restaurant expanded its meal donation coverage from local communities to hospitals.

IJ Sushi: We Will Keep Going Despite Doubts and Criticism

IJ Sushi: We Will Keep Going Despite Doubts

“When the pandemic hit, most of us stayed safely at home. Yet frontline workers could not isolate themselves; instead, they had to remain on duty for far longer hours, taking huge risks and bearing immense pressure every day. I kept thinking: these medical workers protect all of us, so what can we do to support them? I first shared the idea of delivering free meals to healthcare staff via WeChat. Unexpectedly, many people questioned our motives and doubted we would actually follow through. But now the Food with Love campaign is fully underway — not only have we delivered on our promise, we also stand side by side with numerous like-minded restaurants carrying out this mission together,” said Kevin, owner of IJ Sushi.

Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant: Doors May Close, But Kindness Never Stops

A representative from Yiheyuan Seafood Restaurant shared that the restaurant group it belongs to operates forty-eight locations across China, all of which were forced to shut down amid the pandemic. Revenue plummeted drastically, yet the group still faced steep rent payments and staff payroll costs.

Even amid such severe financial hardship, the group’s owner made an unhesitating decision to provide free meals for Seattle’s medical workers upon learning local hospitals were in urgent need of support. Their generous contributions during this tough time stem from a deep sense of social accountability and moral duty.

Chowbus: Through Wind and Rain, We Always Deliver

Chowbus was among the first enterprises to join the Food with Love campaign, shouldering the critical delivery work for all donated meals. Michelle, Chowbus’s representative and lead of the campaign’s delivery team, shared, “I was deeply inspired by the restaurants’ selfless charity work, and I wanted to leverage our platform’s resources and strengths to help achieve this shared mission alongside everyone.”

The delivery operation faced numerous practical hurdles. First, hospitals enforced strict delivery standards, including precise drop-off times and mandatory food temperature requirements, meaning every meal had to arrive hot and fresh right on schedule. Second, as more restaurants joined the donation drive and the number of frontline medical recipients grew, the delivery workload expanded drastically. Every day, Chowbus couriers picked up meals from multiple restaurants before distributing them to a wide range of medical facilities, many far beyond regular delivery zones. At the time Michelle spoke, Chowbus drivers were out on a grueling route collecting food from four restaurants to deliver to eleven hospitals. The farthest facility was in Everett, a one-hour one-way drive alone. Despite all these obstacles, Chowbus fulfilled every single delivery commitment without fail.

To raise funds supporting the Food with Love program, Chowbus opened dedicated donation portals on its official website and mobile app. The platform raised over $3,000 in initial public donations. Leading by example, Michelle personally contributed an additional $500, and both sums were transferred to the campaign’s finance team to fund more complimentary meals for frontline workers. To date, Chowbus has delivered more than 2,000 charity meal boxes, and its fleet will continue transporting heartfelt meals to frontline responders throughout the rest of the campaign.

Beyond the restaurants featured at the press conference, three other eateries — Frying Fish, Rongcheng Old Hot Pot, and Liuyishou Hot Pot — also provided free meals to support medical staff on the pandemic frontlines.

Frying Fish: Doing Our Utmost to Share Our Love

Liuyishou Hot Pot: Delicious Dishes to Cheer Up Medical Workers

Financial & Legal Backing for the Campaign

This Food with Love initiative boasts solid legal and financial support. At the press conference, lead legal counsel Attorney Qing Cai stated: “A larger-scale campaign brings greater accountability. We aim to carry out this charity program smoothly while mitigating all potential risks. We conducted inspections of hygiene standards at all participating restaurants and drafted commitment letters to eliminate hidden hazards, allowing everyone to contribute their kindness without worry.”

Xiaoyan Li, the finance lead, shared an update on fundraising progress: “Our overall fundraising goal for this campaign is $400,000. So far, six partner restaurants have pledged a total of 14,150 meals valued at $242,000, out of which 4,145 meals worth $77,050 have already been delivered. During our press conference, Mr. Lai Huiwu, President of 505 Group, learned about our cause and donated $2,000 to show his support.”

Update: As of press time on the 16th, total cash donations received have reached $30,499.

Gratitude from Healthcare Workers

Medical Staff Express Their Thanks for the Food with Love Meals

Recipients among medical staff were deeply grateful for the donated meals and often expressed their appreciation to the campaign organizers in various ways. Some sent thank-you emails and text messages, while others posted photos of the meals on social media. Upon learning about the upcoming press conference, busy medical workers took time out of their packed schedules to record a short video with a heartfelt message: “Thank you all. We fight the pandemic on the front lines, and you stand firmly behind us to support us.”

Hospitals Receiving Food with Love Donations
Food with Love: We Welcome You to Join Us

The Food with Love Campaign: A Magnet Drawing Compassionate Hearts

This Food with Love initiative acts like a powerful magnet, attracting an ever-growing number of kindhearted participants and gaining support from partner community associations. Rhea, the volunteer in charge of all English communications, was moved to tears after learning the campaign’s touching story. She volunteered to manage all updates across the campaign’s Facebook, Twitter accounts and official English website.

The Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, another official partner of the program, was deeply touched by the initiative’s appeal and stepped forward to offer full support to the charity drive.

The press conference lasted just over an hour, yet the words “love” and “dedication” echoed throughout the whole event. While the entire community was weighed down by the hardships of the pandemic, this press conference served as a positive, heartwarming sharing session that brought comfort to everyone present. Inspired by these moving stories, we hope more people will join hands to do whatever we can to support our community and our beloved Seattle. We eagerly look forward to Seattle regaining its joy and liveliness soon.

items.body_zh:
“爱心午餐”宣传


关于餐厅为何参与到“爱心午餐”中，最先发起本次活动的餐厅豆捞坊、IJ Sushi、颐和园海鲜酒楼，以及送餐平台Chowbus分别分享了各自背后令人感动的故事。


豆捞坊：从社区到医院，爱心在扩大

负责人Bruce介绍，豆捞坊是最早一家开始送爱心午餐的餐厅，当看到疫情发生后很多警察、保安、司机没有吃饭的地方，他们便在饭店门口发放免费午餐，让这些需要帮助的人能随时获得。后来当得知医护人员更急需帮助后，他们的爱心午餐覆盖范围也从社区扩大到医院。


IJ Sushi：即使被质疑，也会做下去

“当疫情发生后，我们都安安全全待在家里，但一线人员不但不能待在家里，反而需要在工作岗位待命更长时间，他们需要顶着很大风险和压力去工作。我想，这些医护人员在守护我们，而我们又能为这些医护人员做些什么？一开始我先通过微信渠道发出想给医护人送免费餐的消息。没想到这个消息竟然收到质疑，很多人不相信我们会这么做。而现在爱心午餐活动的进行，不但证明我们做到了，而且还有很多志同道合的餐厅和我们一起在做！” IJ Sushi 老板Kevin说。


颐和园海鲜酒楼：

门店可以关  爱心不能断

颐和园海鲜酒楼负责人说，颐和园餐厅所在的集团在国内还有四十八家门店，因为受疫情影响都关闭了，不但营业额大幅下滑，还要支付不菲的房租和员工工资。然而在自身都受影响严重的情况下，当集团老板得知西雅图这边需要援助医院时候，还是义无反顾决定用爱心午餐支援医护人员。在艰难时刻还能慷慨解囊，是心中的一份责任与担当。


Chowubus:  风雨兼程 使命必达


作为担当爱心餐运输重任的Chowbus是最先参与到本次活动的企业之一，本次活动配送组组长、Chowbus负责人Michelle说，“能参加这个活动是被餐厅义举所感动，也想用自己资源和优势和大家一起实现这个目标。” 据了解Chowbus在送餐中确实遇到不少挑战：首先，医院对送餐标准有着严格的要求，比如送达时间、餐品温度等，要在规定时间将符合温度标准的食物送到。其次，随着捐助餐厅、受助医护人员的增多，让配送任务更为繁重。每天，Chowbus需要从不同餐厅出发送往不同医院，有的远远超出送餐范围。就在Michelle发言当时，Chowbus的司机正在赶在送餐的路上，要从4家餐厅取餐送到11个医院，而最远的一家医院在Everett，仅单程就需要1个小时车程。面对这些挑战，Chowbus都一一克服使命必达。为了给“爱心午餐”筹集捐款，Chowbus在网站和APP上也开通捐赠通道并将首批捐款3000多美元，除了这些捐款，Milchelle 自己也身体力行，率先捐款500美金，她已将这两笔捐款交给财务组。现在，Chowbus已经送出2000多份爱心盒饭，在接下来活动中还将继续带着爱心餐上路。


其实，除了参加新闻发布会的餐厅外，还有沸腾鱼乡、蓉城老火锅、刘一手这三家餐厅也都分别用爱心午餐来支援一线医务人员。


沸腾鱼乡：尽最大力  献一份爱


刘一手：用精美餐品给医护人员加油

财务和法律后盾


本次爱心午餐活动也有强大的律师和财务后盾。新闻发布会上，法律负责人蔡青律师说：“活动越大责任就越大，既要把爱心活动做好，又要把潜在风险降低。通过对加盟餐馆的卫生条件进行考察，并起草承诺函等，将潜在风险点一一排除，让大家更能踏踏实实献爱心。”财务负责人李晓艳也介绍了活动的捐赠情况：“本次活动目标筹款40万美金，截止目前为止，6家餐厅总捐赠14150份套餐的金额是24.2万美金，已经捐出的4145份餐食价值77050美金，就在新闻发布会进行中，得知消息的505集团总裁来辉武先生也捐款2000美金表示对活动的支持。”


更新：在16日发稿当日，目前已经收到现金捐赠30499美元。” 


来自医护人员的感谢

医护人员感谢“爱心午餐”


爱心午餐让受捐助的医护人员感激不尽，他们经常用自己不同的方式来表达对活动组织方的感激，有的发Email和短信来致谢，有的在社交媒体上分享自己的爱心午餐。当医护人员得知要召开这次新闻发布会时，他们特意在百忙之中制作了小视频说：“感谢你们，我们在前线抗疫，你们在背后守护我们。”

“爱心午餐”受捐医院


爱心午餐 期待你的加入


这场“爱心午餐”活动就像一块磁力极强的磁铁，吸引了越来越多有爱心的人加入，也得到兄弟协会的支援。负责英文文宣的志愿者Rhea了解了这个爱心故事后差点落泪并主动承担起本次活动Facebook、Twitter 、英文网页等所有更新工作。而西雅图创业协会作为本次活动的合作伙伴在看到爱心午餐倡议书被感动，也发挥一臂之力帮助本次活动。


短短一个多小时的发布会，听到最多的就是爱和奉献，当大家都在被疫情而困扰时，这个新闻发布会就像是一个正能量的故事分享会，让所有人都感到温暖。在为之动容之际，也希望能有更多人参与进来，齐心协力，尽我们所能，为社区和我们生活的地方贡献一份力量，期待西雅图早日恢复往昔的欢声笑语！

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Joins All Sectors of Society in Actively Fighting the Pandemic
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会基金会联合社会各界积极抗疫
items.body_en:
English Translation

Since the donation portal of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation (hereinafter referred to as CCCWA Foundation) launched on March 20, the foundation has formed a task force together with the Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle, Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni Chapter and member enterprises of the Chamber. Within just one week, the team raised nearly $39,000 in cash donations from all walks of life, alongside supplies valued at almost $100,000. On the very launch day of the donation drive, medical supplies donated by Systimmune Inc. were delivered to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center.

The entire fundraising campaign gathered countless acts of kindness time and again, demonstrating unprecedented unity within the Chinese-American community. As soon as the fundraising appeal was released, nearly a hundred people joined the official CCCWA Foundation donation group. Meanwhile, the Xiamen University and Zhejiang University Seattle alumni chapters mobilized their respective alumni networks to raise funds, bringing the total number of participants to over 300.

Donors spanned a wide spectrum: Chinese-funded enterprises based in Seattle, renowned entrepreneurs, local government officials, industry professionals, as well as numerous local organizations and compassionate individual residents. Many individuals and businesses had already made multiple prior donations yet chose to contribute once more. All participants shared one unified mission: stand united to fight COVID-19 and safeguard our community.

At a time when courier services faced massive backlogs and international shipping routes were severely disrupted, the CCCWA Foundation task force raced against the clock to coordinate with all relevant parties, strictly verifying the quality and safety of all medical supplies. With support from professional foreign trade partners, the team expedited shipments to Seattle as rapidly as possible. To date, CCCWA Foundation has delivered donations to 14 facilities, distributing 82,000 face masks and 1,500 sets of personal protective equipment (including medical gloves, disposable coveralls and goggles). Large batches of additional supplies remain in transit. All recipient institutions expressed sincere gratitude and recognition for the donations. The inspiring image of the united Chinese community struck a chord with the broader public, and the campaign was featured by mainstream local media including KIRO 7 TV.

On March 27, the task force delivered supplies to Issaquah Swedish Hospital, where hospital staff distributed the gear directly to medical teams working in the ICU. Frontline medical workers described the donations as a much-needed lifeline amid crisis, and thanked the Chinese community for their care and support.

On March 31, representatives from the CCCWA Foundation team delivered donations to Virginia Mason Medical Center, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, as well as the Bellevue Police Department and Bellevue Fire Department. Gary Kaplan, CEO of Virginia Mason Medical Center, sent a personal letter to express his gratitude to the CCCWA Foundation.

From April 1 to 3, representatives of the CCCWA Foundation team rushed nonstop to deliver donations to UW Valley Medical Center, Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Medical Center, ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic in the International District, and Highline Medical Center in Burien.

Burien Mayor Jimmy Matta personally sent a letter to express gratitude to the CCCWA Foundation, writing emotionally: “As COVID-19 ravaged our community, your support gave us a glimmer of light at the end of the tunnel. Our entire community is thankful for you.”

As the pandemic situation in Washington State gradually stabilizes, this positive outcome stems not only from the selfless dedication of medical workers and cooperation from all sectors of society, but also from the unified dedication and support of the entire Chinese-American community. Many of us are first-generation immigrants. We pool strengths from our homeland to support our current home, for we hold this land deep in our hearts. Many a little makes a mickle; small acts of kindness combine to lift up our community. The CCCWA Foundation will continue to unite people from all walks of life to carry out donation efforts until victory is declared in the fight against the pandemic!

(Report with texts and photos: Carrie Wang, CCCWA Foundation)

items.body_zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会基金会（以下称CCCWA Foundation）捐赠通道自3月20日启动以来，联合厦门大学西雅图校友会（Xiamen University Alumni Association in Seattle）、浙江大学北美西雅图校友会（Zhejiang University North America Seattle Alumni）、总商会会员单位组成工作组，在短短一周内共筹集来自社会各界的资金捐赠近3万9千美金以及价值近10万美金的物资，并在通道启动当天将百利药业（SystimmuneInc）捐赠的物资送达Everett Providence Hospital及Overlake Medical Center.


整个筹款过程一次又一次凝聚了数万的爱心，见证了华人空前的团结。倡议书一经发出就号召聚集了百人加入CCCWA Foundation捐赠群，同时厦门大学西雅图校友会及浙江大学北美西雅图校友会分别在其校友群中进行号召和筹款，总参与人数超过300人。


此次捐赠者中不仅有西雅图地区的中资企业、知名企业家、政要、来自各行各业的精英，还有众多本地机构、组织和爱心人士，其中许多个人和单位已经几度捐款，但依旧再次献出爱心；所有的努力都因为我们有着共同的目标和心愿：团结一心、抗击新冠、保护社区！


在快递爆仓，航路不畅的特殊时期，CCCWA Foundation工作组争分夺秒对接各单位，确保物资的质量及安全性。并在专业外贸公司的协助下尽可能以最高的速度送达西雅图地区。截至日前，CCCWA Foundation共前往14家机构，捐出8万2千个口罩及1500套防护物资（含医用手套、防护服及护目镜）, 仍有大批物品还在运送途中。捐赠得到了受赠单位由衷的感谢和肯定，华人众志成城的形象深入人心，并被主流媒体：如KIRO 7电视频道报道。


3月27日工作组将物资送达Issaquah Swedish Hospital, 并由医院工作人员直接送至ICU的医护手中。医护人员都称这真是雪中送炭，感谢来自中国社区的关爱和保护。

3月31日CCCWA Foundation工作组代表前往Virginia Mason Medical Center、Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center及Bellevue市警察局、消防局进行捐赠。Virginia Mason的CEO Gary Kaplan特别发信致谢CCCAW Foundation。 4月1日至3日，CCCWA Foundation工作组代表马不停蹄前往UW Valley Medical Center、Evergreen Hospital、Overlake Medical Center、中国城ICHS International District Medical and Dental Clinic、Burien Highline Medial Center进行捐赠。Burien市长Jimmy Matta亲自致信感谢CCCWA Foundation，并动情地写到：“在新冠病毒COVID-19肆虐我们社区的时候，你们的帮助让我们看到了隧道尽头的希望之光。我们整个社区都感谢你们。”

目前华盛顿州疫情趋于稳定，这不仅因为医生们奋不顾身的努力和社会各界的配合，更因为有整个华人社区一致的奉献与支持。我们中许多人是第一代移民，我们汇聚来自母国的力量共同支援现在的家园，因为我们深爱这片土地。滴水汇江河，绵力助社区。CCCWA Foundation将继续团结社会各界进行捐赠，直到抗疫之战吹响胜利的号角！

(图文报道：王洋Carrie Wang-CCCWA Foundation)

items.title_en: The 3rd Guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' Series: We Specially Invited CCCWA Chief Legal Counsel Lani Cao to Present on 'Recent Policy Changes to Visas and Green Cards Available to Multinational Companies in the US'
items.title_zh: 第三期CCCWA“每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了CCCWA 法律总顾问曹霄鹤律师介绍'跨国公司在美国可以使用的签证和绿卡近期政策变化"
items.summary_en: Attorney Cao will introduce the types of visas and immigration pathways available to multinational companies in the US: Investment immigration (EB-5), extraordinary ability immigration (EB-1A), entrepreneur visas and green cards (L-1/L-2, EB-1C), employment-based immigration (EB-1/EB-2/EB-3), and E1/E2, TN visas for nationals of Canada, New Zealand, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and other countries/regions.
items.summary_zh: 曹律师将介绍跨国公司在美国可以使用的签证和移民种类：  投资移民：EB-5 特殊人才移民：Eb-1A 企业家签证及绿卡：L-1/L-2， Eb-1C 职业移民：EB-1/ EB-2/...
items.body_en:
Attorney Cao will introduce the types of visas and immigration pathways available to multinational companies in the US: Investment immigration (EB-5); extraordinary ability immigration (EB-1A); entrepreneur visas and green cards (L-1/L-2, EB-1C); employment-based immigration (EB-1/EB-2/EB-3); and E1/E2, TN visas for nationals of Canada, New Zealand, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and other countries/regions. We hope Attorney Cao's expert lecture will be helpful for everyone's work and life in the US.

Attorney Cao earned her undergraduate degree from China University of Political Science and Law, followed by a Master's in Public Policy from Japan's National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies and a J.D. from Seattle University School of Law. While practicing law in China, she focused on Chinese business law and served as legal counsel to a major Chinese fuel company. She has also co-authored publications on Chinese law. After immigrating to the US and earning her J.D. from Seattle University School of Law, she began her US legal practice. Whether in immigration law, family law, business law, or estate planning, Attorney Cao brings extensive experience, tailoring immigration strategies to each client's needs to help them achieve the American dream — including investment immigration (EB-5 direct investment and regional centers), employment-based immigration (EB-1, EB-2, EB-3), family-based immigration, various nonimmigrant visa applications (H-1B, etc.), and corporate law services. Attorney Cao is also active in numerous Seattle Chinese community activities. She has been invited to host a legal advice segment on Seattle Chinese radio and writes an immigration law column for The China Press, providing legal guidance on immigration matters to Chinese community members across the greater Seattle area.

How to join: This event is livestream-only. To watch the livestream, please click the following link: Friday, April 10th, 8:00–9:30 PM Pacific Time (Saturday 11:00 AM–12:30 PM Beijing Time). Join Zoom Meeting https://zoom.us/j/4696970869 Meeting ID: 469 697 0869
items.body_zh:
曹律师将介绍跨国公司在美国可以使用的签证和移民种类： 投资移民：EB-5特殊人才移民：Eb-1A企业家签证及绿卡：L-1/L-2， Eb-1C职业移民：EB-1/ EB-2/ EB-3加拿大，新西兰，台湾，香港等国家或地区： E1/E2, TN 希望曹律师的专业讲座对大家在美国工作和生活带来帮助。

曹律师早年在中国政法大学获得大学学士学位，并先后在日本国立政策研究院和西雅图大学法学院获得公共政策硕士以及法学博士学位。在中国从事律师执业期间，她主要集中于中国商务法，并在中国一家大型燃料公司担任法律顾问。曹律师也曾与他人一起合著关于中国法律方面的著作。 移民美国后，曹律师在西雅图大学法学院获得法学博士学位后开始了在美国的法律实践。无论是移民法，家庭法，商业法或是遗产规划，曹律师都有非常丰富的经验,根据不同的需求，更加全面地为客户量身定制移民策略，帮助客户实现美国梦,包括投资移民（EB-5直投、区域中心）、工作移民（EB-1，EB-2， EB-3）、亲属移民、各类非移民签证（H-1B等）的申请以及公司法等服务。 曹律师也积极参加众多西雅图华人社区活动。她受邀担任西雅图中文电台曹律师信箱；侨报移民法律栏目的撰稿人，为大西雅图地区的华人朋友们提供关于移民方面的法律咨询。

items.summary_en: This episode's guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' series was Frances Chen, adSage's US Marketing Director, who introduced the business value of digital advertising powered by communications and digital media technology, along with the current state and outlook for digital advertising in China and the US.
items.summary_zh: ​ 本期CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会 “每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了adSage美国市场营销总监Frances...
items.body_en:
This episode's guest for CCCWA's 'Star of the Week' series was Frances Chen, adSage's US Marketing Director, who introduced the business value of digital advertising powered by communications and digital media technology, along with the current state and outlook for digital advertising in China and the US. Amid the current global pandemic, many company employees have been forced to work from home and retail stores have shut down — in these extraordinary times, digital online marketing has shown its remarkable power, letting businesses across every industry reach their audiences and buyers across borders. Frances introduced several platforms and ad formats well suited for this.

Frances Chen shared with online attendees the services of adSage, a globally leading digital marketing company, introducing its major clients including Amazon, Microsoft, Vipshop, Uber, Ashford, Blue Nile, and GoDaddy, giving everyone a broader understanding of the development of the internet advertising industry.

items.body_en:
The 'Fighting COVID-19 Love Lunch Fundraising Drive,' initiated by CCCWA and led by The Dolar Shop (jointly with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito, has received an enthusiastic response from across Seattle. Over the past few days, organizations on the front lines of the pandemic response that have received love lunches include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital. This drive carefully selected trusted, reliable restaurants and food delivery partners, strictly following Washington State food safety standards for preparation and transport, delivering nutritious, delicious love lunches directly to medical staff. All purchased food is coordinated closely with local medical institutions at every level, maintaining point-to-point contact with recipient hospitals.

The Love Lunch fundraising call received an enthusiastic response, with organizations such as the Seattle Entrepreneurship Club providing strong support and assistance. Following the lead of The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito, as of the evening of April 2nd, four more restaurants — Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory, Frying Fish, and Liuyishou — have joined as donors, together pledging to fully fund 14,150 lunches, with 1,515 love lunches already prepared and delivered to medical staff, community service workers, and community members in need. $21,085 in cash donations have been raised.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State calls on more restaurants, organizations, companies, and individuals to join in, to help more medical workers and community members in need. Our fundraising drive is fully transparent, strictly complies with US law, and strictly follows nonprofit financial regulations — donation amounts and donated food will be published on an ongoing basis in real time. Let's all take action! No act of love is too small — let's show, through real action, our courage and shared responsibility in fighting this epidemic together across all communities.

Supporting organizations for this event: The Dolar Shop (contact via email), Asian Family Market, IJ Sushi Burrito (contact via email), Chowbus Inc., Imperial Garden, Chengdu Memory, Frying Fish, Liuyishou Hot Pot, Seattle Entrepreneurship Club, Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center, Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association, Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, Issaquah Highlands Chinese Heritage Club, Jing Wei LLC, SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404), Cai & Cai Associates, Create World America Real Estate Inc., Pacific Sunrise International Corp

items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _April 1, 2020 07:39_ Founded in 2007, adSage (Adsage Technology Co., Ltd.) is known for big-data mining and precision marketing. Headquartered in Beijing, with branch offices in Shanghai, Wuxi, Shenzhen, Seattle, Los Angeles, and elsewhere, the company is dedicated to providing clients with one-stop integrated "brand-plus-performance" marketing services in the digital media marketing field. Advertising is information, serving both brand communication and demand conversion, and all advertising is measurable. Good ads that fit the audience's interests and ads that can be measured both require continuous, cutting-edge technology investment. adSage firmly believes technology can transform marketing, and we continuously invest substantial R&D effort into this great work to better serve our clients. **Innovation + Execution:** Innovation is the foundation of a technology company's existence and the engine of its growth, but innovation must be put into practice, not remain merely a concept—so execution is the key element that ensures innovation is realized. In this fast-developing tech era, digitizing products and services has become a necessary process. Especially amid this pandemic outbreak, many companies have been forced to work from home, and many traditional retailers have been hit hard, forced to close or lay off staff, with some even going bankrupt. How can you reach your audience and buyers across distances and borders during special times? This is where digital online marketing works its magic. Today we'll introduce some platforms and ad formats well suited to everyone. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State has invited adSage's U.S. marketing director Frances Chen to introduce the business value of digital advertising driven by communication and digital media technology, and the current state and outlook of digital advertising in both China and the U.S. Since joining the company in 2017, Frances has helped many clients such as Blue Nile, Zillow, and TD Ameritrade expand their global market share, drawing on her skills and experience in brand management, building partnerships, and performance marketing. **Frances manages adSage's media partners | OnlineTimes Corporation,** **including Tencent, North America's Money Saving Express, TikTok, Baidu, and more. Everyone is welcome to register!** Registration: This event is livestream only. To watch this livestream on Zoom, please click the link below: Join Zoom Meeting https://zoom.us/j/292364477 Meeting ID: 292 364 477

自2017年加入公司以来，Frances凭借其在品牌管理，建立伙伴关系和绩效营销方面的技能和经验，已帮助BlueNile，Zillow，TDAmeritrade等众多客户扩大了全球市场额。 **Frances管理adSage的媒体合作伙伴| OnlineTimesCorporation，** **包括腾讯，北美省钱快报，Tiktok，百度等。欢迎大家报名参加！**

items.body_en: Original CCCWA CCCWA _March 31, 2020 09:04_ **COVID-19 has now become a disaster faced by people around the world. Washington State—our second hometown where we live—has begun to see shortages of medical supplies such as masks and protective suits. Many restaurants have closed, and frontline medical staff are overloaded with work, sometimes with no time even to eat.** At this once-in-a-century moment of crisis, CCCWA (the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State) and several other organizations, after their campaign to raise funds and purchase medical supplies, have once again launched a charitable campaign to deliver free caring lunches to frontline medical staff. CCCWA will join with several organizations and mobilize the strength of all sectors to select safe, reliable food and delivery businesses, produce and transport the food in strict accordance with Washington State food safety standards, and deliver nutritious, delicious caring meal boxes into the hands of medical staff; in staffing, in donation channels, and in the use of funds, it strictly complies with U.S. donation law. All food purchased is coordinated closely with local medical institutions at every level and delivered through point-to-point contact with the recipient hospitals. **This campaign is led in donations by The Dolar Shop Chinese restaurant (together with Asian Family Market) and IJ Sushi Burrito Japanese restaurant:** 1. The Dolar Shop, together with Asian Family Market, pledged $120,000. 2. The Dolar Shop separately pledged an additional $84,000. 3. IJ Sushi Burrito pledged $108,000. 4. Chowbus Inc.'s professional delivery service pledged $30,000. Recipient organizations already lined up include: UW Virology, Swedish Hospital, Overlake Hospital, and Evergreen Hospital. This campaign plans to raise $400,000 within one month and make 30,000 caring lunches to deliver into the hands of medical staff at healthcare institutions, community service workers, and community members in need. Encouragingly, even before the proposal was issued, Attorney Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Firm and Ms. Sylvia Chin did a great deal of work in the campaign's early stages; the Washington Chamber has received over $10,000 in cash donations from Li Ruoyao and Zhang Shuo of Jing Wei LLC and from other businesses and individuals; and The Dolar Shop and IJ Sushi Burrito had already provided a week of free caring lunches to all sectors of society, to an enthusiastic response. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State calls on more restaurants to join, and on more institutions, companies, and individuals to join, to help more medical staff and community members in need. Our fundraising campaign is completely open and transparent, strictly complies with U.S. law, and operates strictly according to nonprofit financial regulations; donation amounts and donated food will be published in real time. Though mountains and rivers separate us, we share the same moon and sky. We love our motherland thousands of miles away, and we also love this land beneath our feet. Fellow Washingtonians, let us cheer on our second hometown—this is the home where we work and live, the happy land where our children grow up healthy. Now we need to stand together with Americans of all ethnicities, work with one heart, and fight the pandemic together. We will do our utmost to give back to the community and express the love and dedication of us Chinese Americans to our second hometown. May heaven bestow compassion and grant peace; may the world be well and humanity harmonious. Let's all take action! Love is not measured by size, nor by amount—let us use concrete action to express the courage and responsibility of our people of all ethnicities to fight the pandemic together and share the burden together! **Host of This Event: CCCWA (Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State)** **Supporting Organizations for This Event:** Asian Family Market; Seattle Real Estate Investment Club; Seattle Chinese New Immigrants Center; Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association; Jing Wei LLC; Cai & Cai Associates; SC Intl Realty (206-228-9404). **Donation Receiving Account:** Bank account transfer: Cathay Bank. If donating through a company donation website: please also search for Sunshine Youth Culture and Education Development Association. Check mailing address: 325 118th AVE SE #100, Bellevue, WA 98005 (Attn: Xiaoyan Li). **Donors, please be sure to note your name, address, email, and contact phone number so we can promptly provide your tax-deductible donation receipt.** **Volunteer group contacts for this event:** **For restaurant donation participation and institutional cooperation, please contact:** Overall commander: CCCWA President Lily Lyu, email: lvlili0219@sina.com, WeChat: lili2999. Chief attorney: Cai Qing of Cai & Cai Law Firm, email: Alex.cai@cai-law.com, Tel: 425-753-5188. Delivery group leader. **To donate funds as a company or individual, please contact** finance group leader Li Xiaoyan (Sunshine Youth Education Foundation / Seattle Real Estate Club), eli@create-world.us. **Medical institutions needing caring meal boxes, please contact** the outreach group leader. **For media and CCCWA chamber matters, please contact:** Lei, email: info@ccc-wa.org, WeChat: gloriachatting.

items.title_en: First Episode of CCCWA's "Star of the Week" Hotline Launches! Mr. Xia Yinglin Shares a Special Presentation on "Differences and Communication in Chinese and American Corporate Culture"
items.title_zh: 首期CCCWA“每周一星“热线开播！夏映林先生为大家专题分享《中美企业文化的差异与沟通》
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _March 28, 2020, 13:12_ **CCCWA's weekly video sharing series officially launched on March 23. Member companies and enterprise representatives from home and abroad shared professional knowledge and introduced their company's products and services through an online platform.** **The guest for the first episode of CCCWA's (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) "Star of the Week" was Mr. Xia Yinglin, who has extensive work and entrepreneurial experience in China, Japan, Canada, the United States, and many other countries around the world. He gave a special presentation on "Differences and Communication in Chinese and American Corporate Culture." Mr. Xia systematically shared his understanding of what constitutes good and effective communication within American culture, covering topics such as culture and personality, teamwork, in-person and phone meetings, and how to write emails and work reports, and answered practical questions about Chinese-American cultural communication and business cooperation. Drawing on his extensive work experience and real-world case studies, this professional promptly addressed questions raised by attendees, and the nearly 40 participants online were inspired in many ways. Everyone looks forward to CCCWA continuing to host various themed lectures in the future, in order to receive the latest industry information from professionals. CCCWA hopes to get to know more members and provide everyone with a platform for exchange, sharing, and cooperation — working together for a win-win 2020!**
items.body_zh:
CCCWA CCCWA 

**CCCWA 每周视频分享于3月23日正式开播了，会员单位和海内外的企业代表通过网络平台 分享专业知识 、介绍公司产品与服务。** 



第一期 CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会“每周一星“的做客嘉宾，我们特别邀请了在中国、日本、加拿大、美国等世界多个国家都有丰富工作和创业经验的夏映林先生，为大家专题分享《中美企业文化的差异与沟通》。夏先生从文化与个性、团队合作、面对面会议和电话会议，如何写电子邮件和工作报告等几个方面，为大家系统分享他理解的什么是好的和有效的美国文化沟通，并 解答有关中美文化与沟通、商业合作中遇到的实际问题。

**专业人士结合丰富的工作经历和实际案例的分享，及时解答了参会者提出的一些疑问，近40位在线参会人员受到多方面的启发。大家非常期待CCCWA今后继续举办各类专题讲座， 以便获得专业人士提供的最新业内信息。CCCWA 希望能了解更多会员，为大家提供交流、分享、合作的平台、共赢 2020年 ！**

items.title_en: CCCWA Foundation Officially Launches COVID-19 Donation Channel
items.title_zh: 华盛顿州中国总商会基金会抗击新冠捐赠通道正式启动
items.body_en: Original CCCWA CCCWA _March 24, 2020, 06:00_ As COVID-19 spreads worldwide, the number of confirmed cases and deaths in Washington State is rising sharply by the day. Frontline hospitals fighting the epidemic, such as Evergreen Hospital, Overlake Hospital, Swedish Hospital, and Seattle Children's Hospital, have all experienced severe shortages of basic protective supplies such as masks and hand sanitizer. To support community public health and relieve the urgent needs of frontline medical institutions, the CCCWA Foundation (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation) urgently formed a donation task force, racing against time to mobilize resources from all sectors of society, and issued a call for donations to Chamber member companies, alumni associations, and other organizations to overcome this challenge together. On March 20, the day the donation channel officially launched, the CCCWA Foundation received a donation from member company SystImmune Inc. (Baili Pharmaceutical) of 2,000 3M N95 masks, 2,000 medical-grade masks, 400 protective goggles, and 100 sets of protective suits, and delivered them that same afternoon to Everett Providence Hospital and Overlake Medical Center. **The donation channel is now open, and details of donors, donated items, quantities, and recipients will be transparently disclosed to the public on an ongoing basis.** **Please stay tuned for further updates on the CCCWA Foundation's donation efforts.** **"Every drop joins the river; every small effort helps the community."** Ways to donate funds: 1. Zelle Quick Pay to CCCWA Foundation, e-mail: info@ccc-wa.org 2. Online wire transfer/ACH: To: CCCWA Foundation, checking account number: 1381 2768 3476, Routing number: 125000024, Address: Bank of America, 2830 80th Ave SE, Mercer Island, WA 98040 Ways to donate supplies: Please contact any of the following task force member organizations to coordinate further: 1. CCCWA Foundation Working Group: info@ccc-wa.org, Phone: 206-661-8187 2. Xiamen University Seattle Alumni Association: xmuaainseattle@gmail.com, Phone: 302-358-0366 Text and images courtesy of: CCCWA Foundation (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State Foundation)

items.title_en: United as One to Fight the Epidemic; A Global Community Working Together for Relief! CCCWA Member Companies Mobilize Resources Across China and the US to Combat the Outbreak!
items.title_zh: 四海同心举力抗疫；全球一体协助救援！CCCWA单位集结中美两国资源鼎力防控、奋战抗击疫情！
items.body_en:
Original CCCWA CCCWA _February 14, 2020, 04:20_ The China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) is a nonprofit organization voluntarily founded by Chinese-invested enterprises in Washington State. The Chamber aims to provide a platform for Chinese-invested enterprises to communicate in the United States, promote trade cooperation between China and the Pacific Northwest, and support and help more Chinese-invested enterprises invest and develop in the United States. At the same time, CCCWA is also committed to advancing social welfare causes; in the past, CCCWA has held special charity auctions of children's artwork at Chamber dinners, donating the proceeds to relevant welfare organizations in the United States to support activities helping Chinese-American children who were adopted at a young age and now live in the US to return to China to search for their birth parents. In the face of the sudden outbreak of the novel coronavirus pneumonia epidemic, CCCWA members across various fields have demonstrated a strong sense of corporate social responsibility, actively coordinating with their branches at home and abroad to procure relevant supplies and donate them free of charge to severely affected areas in need. CCCWA Board member companies are currently mobilizing resources across China and the United States to fight the epidemic:

- SystImmune Inc. (Baili Pharmaceutical), the company's Seattle office, has spared no effort in seeking procurement channels across North America, and has raised surgical masks, N95 masks, medical goggles, and medical protective suits, with the first batch of supplies already arriving in stages at designated recipient hospitals (Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, West China Second Hospital of Sichuan University, Wenjiang District People's Hospital in Chengdu, Leshan People's Hospital, Mianyang 404 Hospital, Wuhan Children's Hospital in Hubei, and Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital).
- Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) swiftly allocated more than RMB 30 million in cash to ensure the orderly operation of transportation, hospitals, and other essential services, and, through an expedited approval process, provided approximately RMB 1.6 billion in financing to enterprises involved in epidemic prevention and control.
- iSoftStone donated RMB 10 million to the city of Wuhan.
- Modern Land (MOMΛ) has donated RMB 2 million to Wuhan and established a charitable fund pool with a RMB 10 million allocation. Other CCCWA member companies have also been providing assistance to compatriots back home through various channels. The virus is merciless, but the world is full of love; let us stay firm in our resolve to fight the epidemic and win this war without gunsmoke. ## Options for High School Students to Take College Courses: How Does the Running Start Program, Compared with AP/IB, Select Outstanding Washington State High School Students to Advance Directly into College? ## Recently, CCCWA (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) invited special guest Mr. Lei He, Assistant Director of International Education at Bellevue College, to introduce the community to one of the options for local high school students to take college courses: Running Start. The Running Start program began in 1990, sponsored by the Washington State government with assistance from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, with the goal of selecting outstanding Washington State high school students to advance directly into college. For students participating in Running Start on a full-time basis, they no longer take high school classes but instead use college coursework to fulfill the corresponding high school credit requirements; second, full-time participating students can enter college at age 16 and complete their bachelor's degree by age 20, saving 1-2 years of study time; third, students participating in Running Start do not need to pay college tuition, saving 1-2 years of college costs; fourth, students who complete the program enter directly as juniors, giving them a relatively higher acceptance rate than applying as freshmen. Over the past 30 years, the Running Start program has continued to grow, and now at Bellevue College alone, more than 2,500 Running Start students are enrolled, mostly from local high schools on the East Side, having cultivated a large number of outstanding talents for Washington State.
items.body_zh:
华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA），是由华盛顿州的中资企业自愿发起组成的非营利性组织。商会旨在为中资企业在美国的交流提供平台，促进中国和美西北地区贸易合作，支持和帮助更多的中资企业对美投资和发展。同时，CCCWA也致力推动社会公益福利事业，过去CCCWA在商会举办的晚宴中特设儿童作品义卖，将所得善款捐赠给美国相关福利机构以资助在美国生活、从小被领养的华裔儿童回到中国寻找亲生父母的活动。面对当下突如其来的新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情，华盛顿州中国总商会会员在各个领域发挥出了企业社会责任感，积极协调公司海内分支机构进行相关物资采购，并无偿捐赠给有需求的疫情严重的地区。目前CCCWA理事会单位集结中美两国资源奋力抗击疫情：

- 百利药业Systimmune西雅图公司，倾力在北美寻求采购途径,已筹集到医用外科口罩和N95口罩、医用护目镜、医用防护服等，第一批物资已经陆续到达定点捐赠医院(四川省人民医院、四川大学华西第二医院、成都市温江区人民医院、乐山市人民医院、绵阳404医, 湖北武汉市儿童医院和武汉亚洲心脏病医院)

- 工商银行（ICBC）迅速调拨人民币3000多万元现金，保障交通运输、医院等有序运行，同时通过绿色通道，为疫情防控领域相关企业提供融资约16亿元.

- 软通动力（iSoftStone) 向武汉市捐款人民币1000万元.

- 当代置业（MOMΛ）已经向武汉捐赠人民币200万元，并设立1000万元慈善基金额度资金池.

CCCWA其他单位也已经通过各种渠道方式为国内同胞们提供帮助。病魔无情，人间有爱，坚定信心对抗疫情，打赢这场没有硝烟的战争。

## 高中生学习大学课程的选择：与AP/IB 相比较，Running Start项目如何选拔华盛顿州优秀的高中生跳级直入大学.

##

近期， CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会特邀嘉宾Bellevue College 国际教育部主管 Mr Lei He (Assistant Directorof International Education from Bellevue College)为社区介绍本地高中生学习大学课程的选择项目之一：Running Start.

Running Start项目始于1990年，由华盛顿州政府主持、比尔盖茨基金会协助，目的是选拔华州优秀的高中生跳级直入大学.参加RunningStart项目，如果是全日制，学生就不再上高中课程，而是以大学课程抵相应的高中课程；2是全日制参与的学生完全可以做到16岁入大学，20岁本科毕业，节省学生1-2年的学习时间；3是参与RunningStart项目，学生无需支付大学学费，节省1-2年大学费用；4是学生完成学习直入大三，比申请大一录取率相对高。30年以来，RunningStart项目规模不断扩大，现在仅在贝尔维学院，就有超过2,500名Running Start项目学生就读，主要来自本地东区(EastSide)的高中学生，为华州培养了大批优秀人才.

items.title_en: Standing Together Against the Epidemic, United in Overcoming Hardship
items.title_zh: 齐心协力抗疫情，众志成城渡难关
items.body_en:
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) is a nonprofit organization voluntarily founded by Chinese-funded enterprises operating in Washington State. The chamber serves as a communication platform for Chinese companies conducting business in the U.S., facilitates trade and cooperation between China and the Pacific Northwest of America, and supports Chinese firms investing and expanding their operations in the United States. Meanwhile, CCCWA is committed to advancing social welfare initiatives. At its annual galas, the chamber has hosted charity auctions featuring children’s artworks, with all proceeds donated to U.S. welfare agencies to fund programs that help Chinese-American adoptees raised in the U.S. travel back to China to reunite with their birth parents.

When the sudden COVID-19 outbreak struck, member enterprises of CCCWA demonstrated robust Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) across all industries. They coordinated their domestic and overseas branches to source medical supplies and donated them free of charge to severely affected regions in China.

At present, council member organizations of CCCWA have pooled resources from both China and the U.S. to mount a united fight against the pandemic:

  1. Systimmune Inc. (Seattle Branch) The company made every effort to secure procurement channels across North America, sourcing surgical masks, N95 respirators, medical goggles, disposable protective coveralls and other PPE. Its first batch of supplies has been delivered sequentially to designated recipient hospitals: Sichuan Provincial People’s Hospital, West China Second University Hospital, Wenjiang District People’s Hospital of Chengdu, Leshan People’s Hospital, Mianyang No.404 Hospital, Wuhan Children’s Hospital and Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital.
  2. ICBC USA Industrial and Commercial Bank of China rapidly allocated over 30 million RMB in cash to maintain the smooth operation of transportation networks and medical facilities. Via dedicated green financing channels, the bank also extended approximately 1.6 billion RMB in credit to enterprises supporting epidemic prevention and control work.
  3. iSoftStone iSoftStone donated 10 million RMB to Wuhan for pandemic relief.
  4. Modern Land (MOMΛ) Modern Land contributed 2 million RMB to Wuhan and set up a dedicated charity fund with a total reserve of 10 million RMB.

Other CCCWA member organizations have also provided assistance to communities in China through a wide range of channels.

The virus is merciless, yet humanity is boundless in compassion. Let us stand firm in our resolve to combat the coronavirus and win this all-out battle without gunpowder.

items.title_en: CCCWA Delegation Visits San Francisco
items.title_zh: CCCWA代表团访问旧金山
items.body_en:
On November 18, 2019, a delegation from the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) visited San Francisco to hold talks with the Chinese Enterprises Association of Northern California.

Mr. Kang Jiande, President of the Chinese Enterprises Association of Northern California and West Market Head of ICBC USA, introduced the development of the association. He stated that the association currently boasts 197 corporate members spanning finance, real estate, transportation, telecommunications, technology, logistics, legal services, new energy, media and other sectors. It operates six specialized committees: Real Estate Committee, Finance Committee, New Energy Committee, High-Tech Committee, Municipal Institution Alliance, and Infrastructure Committee. Dedicated to supporting Chinese enterprises in Northern California and its surrounding regions, the association builds platforms for dialogue and exchange and consistently expands its local influence.

Mr. Zhang Zailing, General Manager of China Youth Travel Service USA and a two-term former president of the Chinese Enterprises Association of Northern California, alongside Mr. Liu Yang, Branch Manager of Bank of Communications San Francisco and representative of a member enterprise, shared insights on the governance and sustainable development of the non-profit association. Member representatives from both sides engaged in in-depth discussions covering the growth of Chinese companies operating in the U.S., organizing member events for non-profit organizations, and resource sharing among Chinese-American entrepreneurs in Seattle and San Francisco.

Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA, presented an overview of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State and its future development roadmap. She expressed hopes for cross-regional collaborative growth with the Chinese Enterprises Association of Northern California. By leveraging their respective influences, the two organizations aim to elevate the positive public image of Chinese enterprises and deliver tangible outcomes to advance bilateral trade and economic ties between China and the United States.

That same day, the delegation from the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA) and the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club also visited the headquarters of Propriis Real Estate Development Company and held an exchange forum with the Sand Hill Real Estate Investment Club of Silicon Valley on-site.

During the forum, Mr. Carlson Chan, President of Propriis Real Estate Development Company, walked attendees through the projects currently under the firm’s development and management. Ms. Ocean Pan, CEO of Sand Hill Real Estate Investment Club, gave an overview of the club’s operations. All participants engaged in in-depth discussions on hot-button real estate investment and development topics, including land pricing, capital costs, and development expense control.

Ms. Lili Lü, President of CCCWA, introduced two high-end apartment developments under construction by Create World America Real Estate Management: The Emerald and Mira Flats. She also analyzed investment returns for land acquisition projects led by Create World America’s real estate fund, including development parcels in Bellevue and land adjacent to the University of Washington.

Local San Francisco developers and investors expressed strong interest in real estate opportunities across the Greater Seattle Area. They believed land values in the region still hold substantial upside potential and hoped to schedule site visits and investment tours in Seattle in the future. The two clubs reached an agreement to host their next cross-party resource matching forum in Seattle.

2019年11月18日，CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会代表团一行到访旧金山与北加州中国企业协会进行会谈。

 

北加州中国企业协会会长、中国工商银行（美国）美西市场负责人康建德先生介绍了北加州中国企业协会的发展。康建德先生提到，北加州中国企业协会目前共有会员企业197家，涉及金融、地产、交通、通讯、科技、物流、律所、新能源、传媒等多个行业，下设6大专业委员会：房地产委员会、金融委员会、新能源委员会、高科技委员会、城市机构联盟以及基础设施委员会。协会致力于为北加州及领区中国企业提供服务，搭建沟通和交流平台，不断提升协会在当地的影响力。

 

曾在北加州中国企业协会担任两任会长的美国中青旅总经理张再龄先生和会员单位代表交通银行旧金山分行行长刘洋先生，分享了关于北加州中国企业协会作为非营利组织治理与发展的管理心得。双方会员代表就中国企业在美发展、非营利组织的会员活动组织、西雅图与旧金山两个城市的华裔企业家资源共享等问题进行了深度的沟通交流。

 

CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了华盛顿州中国总商会的基本情况和未来发展方向，希望未来能与北加州中国企业协会跨区域联合发展，共同发挥各自影响，进一步树立中国企业良好形象，以实实在在的工作，为中美两国经贸关系发展贡献力量。

当日，华盛顿州中国总商会及西雅图房地产投资俱乐部代表团还到访Propriis房地产开发公司总部，并在这里与硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部进行了交流座谈。

 

座谈会上，Propriis房地产开发公司总裁Carlson Chan先生介绍了公司正在开发管理的项目。硅谷沙丘地产投资俱乐部首席执行官Ocean Pan女士介绍了沙丘地产投资俱乐部的基本情况，大家对房地产投资及开发过程中的土地价格、资金成本、开发成本控制等热点问题进行了深度交流。CCCWA华盛顿州中国总商会会长吕莉莉女士介绍了拓宏美国开发管理公司正在开发中的The Emerald及Mira Flats两个高端公寓项目，也从投资回报分析的角度介绍了拓宏美国房地产基金主导收购的Bellevue开发土地、华盛顿大学开发土地等项目。旧金山当地的开发商及投资人均表示对大西雅图地区的房地产项目有浓厚的兴趣，认为大西雅图地区的土地价格仍有较大的上涨空间，希望未来有机会到大西雅图地区考察投资。两个俱乐部约定将在西雅图举行下次双方资源对接座谈会。

items.title_en: CCCWA Delegation Attends China-US Agricultural Resources Matchmaking Forum in California
items.title_zh: CCCWA代表团赴加州参加中美农业资源对接论坛活动
items.body_en:
On November 19, 2019, the CCCWA (China Chamber of Commerce in Washington State) delegation participated in the China-US Agricultural Resources Matchmaking and Food Safety Policy Exchange Forum in Sacramento, jointly hosted by the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco, the California Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development, and the City of Sacramento. The forum aimed to strengthen the exchange of food safety experience and policy between California and China, promote trade exchange in agricultural products between California and China, and build a bridge for people-to-people exchange between California and China. Commercial Counselor Yang Yihang of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco attended the forum. The Director of the California Department of Food and Agriculture, a California State Assembly member, and a Senior Advisor for International Affairs and Trade at the Governor's Office of Business and Economic Development (GO-Biz) introduced the state of California's agricultural development and California-China agricultural trade. Dr. Wang, a food safety policy expert at UC Davis, was invited to introduce California's food safety policies and their implementation. The exchange forum also featured business matchmaking activities between major California agricultural producers and Chinese-invested enterprises. After the forum concluded, the delegation was invited to visit local companies for on-site inspections. (The CCCWA delegation poses for a photo with Commercial Counselor Yang Yihang) (The CCCWA delegation is invited to tour local companies) (The CCCWA delegation poses for a group photo in front of the venue)

items.title_en: CCCWA Council Member Seattle Real Estate Investment Club Celebrates Its 4th Anniversary
items.title_zh: CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部成立四周年庆典
items.body_en: CCCWA CCCWA _November 1, 2019, 06:50_ On October 26, 2019, the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club — a CCCWA council member organization — held a celebration marking its 4th anniversary. In addition to numerous club members, guests at the celebration included friends from the Washington State China Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA), the 808 Golf Club, the Seattle Entrepreneurs Club, and other associations and organizations. The Seattle Real Estate Investment Club was founded in 2015 as a nonprofit organization registered in Washington State. Its membership consists of real estate investors, development and management companies, design firms, attorneys, accountants, real estate brokers, and other professionals across the real estate industry's supply chain. In the four years since its founding, members have voluntarily teamed up on the club's platform to successfully invest in a number of commercial real estate projects. The celebration was co-hosted by rotating club chairs Ms. Li Xiaoyan and Ms. Zhang Xiaohong. During the event, several members shared the achievements and lessons they had gained over the past year. The Seattle Real Estate Investment Club is also actively engaged in community charitable work; at the celebration, attorney Cai Qing introduced the Eastside Arts Center charitable project. The celebration proceeded in a warm and friendly atmosphere, with attendees expressing how much they enjoyed the opportunity — and how grateful they were — to make new friends and business partners through the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club's 4th anniversary. All extended their wishes for continued success for both the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club and the Washington State China Chamber of Commerce (CCCWA), and for their continued delivery of quality support and service to members.
items.body_zh:
CCCWA CCCWA 

2019 年 10 月 26 日， CCCWA理事单位西雅图地产投资俱乐部举行了成立四周年庆典活动。参加此次庆典活动的嘉宾除了众多俱乐部会员以外，还有来自华盛顿州中国总商会（ CCCWA ），808 高尔夫球俱乐部，西雅图创业协会等协会和单位的会员朋友们。

西雅图房地产俱乐部成立于 2015年，是在华盛顿州注册成立的非盈利机构；其会员由房地产投资人、开发管理公司、设计公司、律师、会计师、房地产经纪人以及地产专业上下游从业人士组成。俱乐部成立四年以来，会员们已经在其平台上自愿组合，成功投资了多个商业地产项目。

西雅图地产投资俱乐部轮值主席李晓艳女士、张小红女士共同主持此次庆典。庆典活动过程中，多位会员分享了在过去一年中取得的成就和收获的心得。

西雅图房地产投资俱乐部还积极参与社区公益事业，庆典当日蔡清律师介绍了东区艺术中心公益项目。

整场庆典活动在友好和热烈的气氛下进行，参与庆典的嘉宾们纷纷表示很享受也很感谢能够通过西雅图房地产投资俱乐部成立四周年这个契机结交到新朋友和商业合作伙伴。共同祝愿西雅图房地产投资俱乐部和华盛顿州中国总商会（CCCWA ）协会平台越办越好，为会员朋友们持续提供优质帮助与服务。

items.body_en:
Opening Ceremony of Seattle WASA International Art Center — 'Qi Wind, Lu Charm': An Exhibition of Contemporary Shandong Masters

On September 10th, 'Qi Wind, Lu Charm — An Exhibition of Contemporary Shandong Masters' opened at the newly established WASA International Art Center in Seattle! Attendees at the opening ceremony included Cultural Consul Xiao Xiayong of the Chinese Consulate-General in San Francisco, Wang Wei of the Shandong Provincial Publicity Department and Department of Culture, Zhang Wang, director of the Shandong Art Museum, and other artists, Bellevue City Councilmember Conrad Lee, Washington State Arts Commission Chairman Paul Manfredi, CCCWA President Honghua Zhou, Chamber advisor Attorney Cai Qing, and Eastside Art Center event chair Cathi Hatch, along with other figures from across the greater Seattle community.

WASA International Art Center is located in the beautiful city of Bellevue in the greater Seattle area. This event was an active effort to bring the 4th 'Across the Pacific — China Art Festival,' championed by Consul Xiao Xiayong of the San Francisco Consulate-General, to the Seattle area. In his remarks at the opening ceremony, Consul Xiao emphasized that Seattle already enjoys close exchange with China across trade, technology, education, and many other fields, and that cultural exchange also holds broad potential — he hoped the opening of WASA International Art Center could become a platform for a series of US-China art events in the greater Seattle area.

Bellevue Councilmember Conrad Lee remarked that multiculturalism is a defining social characteristic of the greater Seattle area, and that its inclusive, welcoming environment allows people from all over the world to live and work together in harmony.

Zhang Wang, director of the Shandong Art Museum, introduced the highlights of the exhibition, hoping it would showcase, from one perspective, the creative strength and artistic character of the Shandong painting community, and help deepen American audiences' understanding of contemporary Chinese art. The exhibition featured 40 works by contemporary Shandong artists spanning diverse subjects, rich content, and varied styles, including Shan Yinggui's 'People of Yimeng Mountain,' Kong Weike's 'Jiang Ziya Fishing,' and Pan Lusheng's 'Flowers Blooming in All Four Seasons.'

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State congratulated WASA International Art Center and announced that the newly established CCCWA Foundation would strongly support local cultural and artistic activities as a way of giving back to the community, and also announced that the Foundation had received a generous $50,000 donation from Chamber advisor Attorney Cai Qing to support the construction of the Bellevue Eastside Art Center.
items.body_zh:
西雅图华尚国际艺术中心开业典礼-"齐风鲁韵 "- 山东当代名家精品展

9月10日，“齐风鲁韵--山东当代名家精品展”在新开张的西雅图华尚国际艺术中心开幕！中华人民共和国驻旧金山总领事馆文化参赞肖夏勇先生，山东省文化厅，山东省委宣传部王伟先生，山东美术馆馆长张望先生等艺术家， 贝尔维尔市议员李瑞麟、华盛顿州艺术委员会主席Paul Manfredi，华盛顿州中国总商会周红华会长，商会顾问蔡清律师以及Bellevue东区艺术中心活动主席Cathi Hatch 等大西雅图地区各界人士出席了开幕典礼。 WASA华尚国际艺术中心坐落在大西雅图地区的美丽城市贝尔维尤（Bellevue）。本次活动是旧金山总领事馆文化参赞肖夏勇先生倡导支持的第四届“跨越太平洋--中国艺术节”在西雅图地区推广的积极尝试。肖参赞出席开幕典礼时强调：西雅图在经贸，科技，教育等各个领域与中国已经有密切的交流， 文化互动也潜在广阔的前景，希望 WASA华尚国际艺术中心的开幕可以成为大西雅图地区中美两国艺术系列活动的平台。 贝尔维尔市议员李瑞麟先生在贺词中表示多元文化背景是大西雅图地区的社会特点，广纳海川，相互接纳的人文环境让来自世界各地人们在这里安居乐业，和谐共处。 山东美术馆馆长张望介绍了此次精品展的特色，期待通过这个展览从一个侧面展示山东中国画坛的创作实力与艺术风貌，增进美国各界对中国当代美术发展的了解和认知。展览展出了单应桂《沂蒙山人》、孔维克《姜公垂钓图》、潘鲁生《花开四时》等40幅当代山东艺术家题材多样、内涵丰富、风格各异的作品。 华盛顿州中国总商会祝贺WASA华尚国际艺术中心，并表示已成立的华盛顿州中国总商会基金会将大力支持本地区的文化艺术活动回报社区，同时宣布基金会已经获得中国总商会顾问蔡清律师的5万美金的慷慨捐助用于Bellevue东区艺术中心的建造。

items.body_en:
Celebrating the Topping-Out of Tuohong Real Estate's Bellevue Project and the Launch of Its Seattle Project

Tuohong Real Estate Development Group operates across mainland China, Hong Kong, Europe, Singapore, and North America. In 2014, Tuohong Group set its sights on the greater Seattle region. Seattle offers unique regional advantages — the shortest flight time to mainland China along with multiple nonstop routes, and strong economic momentum driven by its cutting-edge tech sector that has fueled population, employment, and income growth, all of which have drawn the attention of overseas real estate investors. Tuohong's US subsidiary is developing the Meilidu and Meili'an luxury apartment projects located right in the investment hotspots of downtown Seattle and downtown Bellevue.

Recently, Tuohong's US subsidiary held a reception in Seattle to celebrate the successful topping-out of the Meilidu apartment project and the smooth launch of the Meili'an project. At the reception, the company's president shared updates on its US development: over the past three years, Tuohong has established itself in Seattle, successfully investing in five premium real estate development projects, making it the largest Chinese real estate investment and development group in the Seattle area. As a board member and secretary-general unit of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, Tuohong's US subsidiary actively works alongside CCCWA and other major Chinese-invested enterprises to participate in community-building activities, building a strong reputation for overseas investors and serving as a pioneer for more domestic companies looking to expand internationally.

items.summary_en: June 8th marked the one-year anniversary of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, celebrated with a small reception at the ICBC Seattle business center. Over the past year, through the dedicated efforts of its leadership and members, the Chamber built a high-caliber platform for Chinese business exchange from the ground up.

items.body_en:
June 8th marked the one-year anniversary of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State, celebrated with a small reception at the ICBC Seattle business center. Over the past year, through the dedicated efforts of its leadership and members, the Chamber built a high-caliber platform for Chinese business exchange from the ground up, with remarkable results.

Founded in the fiercely competitive Seattle market, the Chamber received support from many Chinese enterprises, fully showcasing the strength of outstanding entrepreneurs. Well-known American firms such as Davis Wright Tremaine LLP and Deloitte also joined as members, expanding the Chamber's platform for exchange with local businesses and extending its influence across Greater Seattle. Seattle has also been a hotspot for Chinese enterprise investment in the US, and Chinese-invested companies saw smooth development over the past year. The Chamber's value lies in serving as a bridge for US-China development — mutually beneficial for both sides, building friendships through trade, and providing broad opportunities for exposure and information exchange. Through the several expert lecture series the Chamber has hosted, businesses across industries have had the chance to efficiently connect with and learn from many outstanding companies, bringing everyone new ideas and opportunities for shared growth.
items.body_zh: 6月8日华盛顿州中国总商会成立一周年，商会为此日前在中国工商银行西雅图业务中心举行了小型庆祝酒会。商会过去一年里在管理骨干和全体会员的积极努力下，从无到有，打造了一个高素质的华人企业交流平台，成绩斐然。 商会在群雄争霸的西雅图地区成立，得到各中方企业的帮助，各方面充分展示了优秀企业家的实力。同时也有像Davis Wright Tremaine LLP和Deloitte等著名的美资企业加入会员，扩展了商会与本地企业的交流平台，推广了商会在大西雅图地区的影响力。同时西雅图市场是中资企业在美国投资的热点，过去一年中资企业发展顺利。成立商会的价值在于使其成为中美发展的桥梁，双方互惠互利，通过经贸往来，建立友谊，为大家提供广泛接触和信息交流的机会。通过商会举办的几次专业知识讲座，各行各业有机会与众多优秀企业有效率地沟通了解，为大家带来共同发展的新思路与新机遇。

In early June, representatives from consulates of 35 countries and select chambers of commerce closely tied to the City of Seattle were invited to the Mayor's 'Seattle Innovation City Day Tour,' visiting world-class institutions, companies, and universities in Seattle including Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, Amazon, and the University of Washington, hearing updates on their latest developments. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State was invited to attend and had in-depth exchanges with Mayor Murray and other guests. A news link about the event is below.

items.body_en:
Over the past two years, Seattle's rise as a cloud computing hub has drawn large numbers of tech talent, driving an all-around economic boom including real estate. Population growth has translated directly into housing demand, and Seattle home price growth has consistently led the nation. On May 25th, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State invited Zillow Senior Economist Aaron Terrazas to Zillow's conference room, with its stunning waterfront views, to walk attendees through professionally analyzed data on the national real estate landscape, with a focus on the Greater Seattle market, helping everyone understand and share in the latest local real estate trends.

[https://www.zillow.com/research/](https://www.zillow.com/research/)
